raw.title: Remote Pharmacist - Overnight
raw.excerpt: Mixlab is the first modern pet pharmacy that focuses on creating high-quality, custom medications and delightful experiences for pets, their parents and veterinarians.
raw.description:
Mixlab is the first modern pet pharmacy that focuses on creating high-quality, custom medications and delightful experiences for pets, their parents and veterinarians. By putting service at the heart of everything we do, we're able to provide the best personalized care for our furry friends, as well as those who care for them. Mixlab is proud to be a PCAB-accredited compounding pet pharmacy. Check us out on Instagram or see our 5 star reviews on Google, Yelp and Facebook!

About the role

Mixlab, the fast-growing veterinary compounding pharmacy, is hiring an Overnight Care Pharmacist to keep our service running while most of the country sleeps. We are looking for someone who is obsessed with quality, passionate about personalized care for pets and their people, and driven to #MakeItHappen for our furry (and scaly!) friends no matter what.

This is a remote, overnight role. You will answer after-hours calls from veterinarians and pet parents live, then work through our eScript and Kustomer queues so the Care team starts every morning with a fresh slate. You will help make Mixlab a 100% dependable resource for customers and veterinarians alike, at any hour.

Location and Schedule:

  • This is a fully remote role. You must have a quiet, private workspace and reliable high-speed internet.
  • Shifts run Monday through Friday nights, 8:00 PM to 4:30 AM ET and 5:00PM PT TO 1:30AM PT, including a 30-minute meal break.
  • Your first [2 to 3] weeks of training are on day shift with the Care team before you move to the overnight schedule.
  • Occasional schedule adjustments may be requested to cover peak volume or staff absences.
  • Flexibility to work holidays on a rotating basis is required.

What you'll do

After-hours calls

  • Be the live voice of Mixlab after hours:
  • Answer every call routed to the after-hours line from veterinarians, practice staff, and pet parents
  • Take new prescriptions by phone and enter orders into our proprietary workflow system with extreme attention to detail
  • Triage clinical urgency, including adverse reactions, dosing questions, missed doses, and medication errors, and escalate per protocol
  • Counsel clients on medications, administration, and instructions
  • Document every interaction in Kustomer and flag items that need day-team follow-up
  • Explain Mixlab's policies, procedures, and values, and help prospective customers understand why vets and pet parents choose Mixlab
  • Process payment information and schedule deliveries based on Mixlab's delivery schedule and customer preference

Overnight queue work

  • Work through the eScript and Kustomer queues so the Care team starts each morning fresh:
    • Complete pharmacist review on eScripts received after hours so clean orders release to the lab at open
    • Work open Kustomer conversations oldest first, resolving or advancing prescriber and client requests within service level targets
    • Contact veterinary practices by email or message when additional information, clarification, or authorization is needed
  • Flag orders that need lab, supply chain, or day-team action
  • Leave an end-of-shift handoff note for the morning Care lead covering escalations, pending DVM callbacks, and open items

Across the shift

  • Serve as the overnight point of contact for urgent pharmacy questions, escalating to the on-call lead when needed
  • Work closely with lab, supply chain, logistics, and Care teams so orders are accurately scheduled and delivered on time
  • Work independently with minimal real-time supervision, using SOPs and escalation protocols
  • Provide subject matter expertise to internal teams on processing, compounding, clinical solutions, and workflows
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and uphold Mixlab values
  • Communicate effectively with your supervisor and own corrective action from 1:1 feedback

About you

Required:

  • Active pharmacist license in at least one U.S. state, in good standing with all State Boards of Pharmacy (Preference given to CA or NY license)
  • Willingness to obtain additional state licenses within [6] months of hire, as needed for Care coverage
  • Ability to work Monday through Friday overnight shifts, 8:00 PM to 4:30 AM ET, from a quiet, private remote workspace
  • Impeccable attention to detail and very high standards for accuracy and quality
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to stay calm, empathetic, and supportive in difficult conversations
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly to changing software and platforms
  • Flexibility to work holidays and occasional schedule changes

Preferred:

  • Additional state licenses, especially NY, FL, TX, WI, and CA
  • 2+ years of veterinary compounding experience
  • Overnight, telepharmacy, or remote pharmacist experience
  • Experience in a customer-facing pharmacy role (call center, telepharmacy, or retail)

Who you are

  • Collaborative and eager to work in a team-oriented, fast-paced, startup environment
  • Self-directed, resourceful, and comfortable owning the shift without real-time oversight
  • All-hands-on-deck attitude; you remain calm and excel under pressure
  • Comfortable switching between live calls and focused queue work
  • You LOVE PETS and their people!

What we offer

  • 100% employer-paid health, dental and vision insurance for our employees, effective on the first of the month following your start date
  • Paid time off for vacation, holidays and sick time, with the ability to accrue more vacation time with increased tenure
  • Competitive starting wages with the opportunity for rapid career growth, promotion, and wage increases
  • Company Stock Options
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits, dependent care, HSA and FSA
  • Employer-paid short and long-term disability leave, parental leave, and life insurance
  • 401k with $300/year match
  • Referral bonus payouts of up to $1,000 for a successful referral
  • Human and pet wellness benefits, including $650/year allowance for routine pet care through Wagmo
  • Discounts on many items through Perkspot
  • And more!

Ready to Lead, Inspire, and Make an Impact? Join Us at My IT Crew.

At My IT Crew, leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about impact. Since 2016, we’ve been redefining what it means to deliver IT services, with a focus on empowering people, solving problems, and creating a culture where both our clients and team members thrive.

Our customer satisfaction rating? A steady 97%.
Our growth? Relentless, fueled by innovation and teamwork.
Our culture? Transparent, collaborative, and committed to high performance.

Now, we’re looking for a Service Manager who can raise the bar even higher, someone who can inspire a team, guide our clients, and make sure every hour spent delivers real value.

Position: Service Manager

Location: Remote

Department: Service Delivery

What You’ll Do

As Service Manager, you’ll be the heartbeat of our operations, keeping the team focused, clients happy, and performance on track. You’ll:

  • Act as an escalation point for critical client issues, owning communication and resolution.
  • Manage scheduling, workload, and utilization to make sure every hour counts.
  • Review and manage service backlogs, keeping priorities clear and moving.
  • Track key metrics, spot trends, and proactively improve performance.
  • Mentor and motivate your team through one-on-ones, coaching, and clear feedback.
  • Handle employee reviews, hiring, and staff development.
  • Take ownership of major incidents, leading coordination and stakeholder communication.
  • Collaborate across departments to maximize client satisfaction and operational efficiency.
  • Lead by example, upholding accountability, morale, and excellent customer service.

What You Bring

We’re looking for someone who’s not just a manager, but a leader with vision, grit, and a people-first approach. You’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of technical IT experience.
  • 3+ years in management or leadership roles.
  • Hands-on expertise with Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Firewalls, VPNs, Routing/Switching, Virtualization, and LAN/WAN.
  • Strong background in IT service delivery, incident/problem/change management, and client relationship building.
  • ITIL knowledge (V3/V4 Foundation strongly preferred).
  • Excellent communication skills, you can build trust, present clearly to leadership, and defuse tough situations with calm confidence.
  • A proven track record of meeting KPIs and driving team performance.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • A culture where leadership is about coaching, not micromanaging.
  • Real influence on strategy, performance, and customer success.
  • Tools, training, and processes that evolve with the industry.
  • A company that rewards initiative, values growth, and supports your leadership journey.
  • A team that listens, learns, and collaborates to win
    together.

If you’re ready to step into a role where your leadership directly shapes client outcomes and team growth, then this might be your next big move.

Let’s talk. My IT Crew isn’t just a place to work, it’s a place to grow, lead, and thrive.

Salary: $90,000 - $110,000

Understanding how organizations provision hardware, negotiate carrier contracts, and handle day-to-day administration helps improve enterprise mobility tools. During this remote voice interview, you will walk us through your typical process for managing corporate mobile lines and hardware. We will ask you to detail how you provision new devices, handle carrier relationships, and troubleshoot fleet issues. You will also react to common management scenarios and discuss your preferred administrative tools. The session focuses entirely on your practical, day-to-day workflow.

Who This Is For

We are looking for IT professionals and telecom managers who actively oversee corporate mobile device fleets. We welcome Systems Administrators, IT Managers, Mobility Specialists, and Telecom Analysts. Candidates should have direct experience interacting with business mobile carriers and managing end-user hardware deployments.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android Developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Australia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Australia.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
We're looking for a Business Development Representative to take AI Live Insight, our real-time video analytics product, to organizations that run large camera estates. You'll open the conversations that become pipeline and book qualified first meetings for our Business Development Managers and partners.

About VIDIZMO

VIDIZMO is an enterprise AI platform company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, with more than 100 customers in production across government, public safety, transportation, manufacturing, utilities, healthcare, education and gaming. Our platform treats video, audio, documents and other unstructured data as sources of intelligence, and customers run it in their own cloud, on-premises or fully air-gapped.

About AI Live Insight

AI Live Insight makes the cameras an organization already owns intelligent, without replacing hardware. It connects to existing IP cameras and VMS platforms over RTSP and ONVIF and detects people, vehicles, weapons, gunshots, crowd surges, unattended objects, PPE and unsafe behavior as situations develop. Alerts go to the people and systems that can act, from dispatch to work-order systems.

What You'll Do

  • Research target accounts in transit, DOTs and smart cities, public safety, manufacturing and utilities, education, casinos and gaming, and commercial real estate.
  • Map the people who own cameras, security operations and safety outcomes.
  • Run multi-touch outreach by email, phone and LinkedIn, built around specific problems such as weapons on campus or unsafe work on a plant floor.
  • Qualify interest: camera count, VMS, deployment needs (cloud, on-premises or air-gapped), budget path and timeline.
  • Book discovery meetings for the BDM with clear notes.
  • Support outreach to security integrators, VMS and camera partners, and distributors.
  • Work trade shows such as ISC East, ISC West and GSX, from pre-event outreach to same-week follow-up.
  • Keep HubSpot current with every activity, contact and next step.

What We're Looking For

  • Required: hands-on experience with a major camera manufacturer or VMS platform, whether you worked for one, sold their products, or sold through their partner channel.
  • Required: the ability to learn and demo VIDIZMO products, including AI Live Insight, within your first two weeks.
  • 1 to 3 years in a BDR, SDR or inside sales role in physical security, video surveillance or related B2B technology.
  • Comfort with cold calling and the persistence to follow up well.
  • Clear, plain writing and curiosity about how cameras, VMS platforms and AI detection fit together.
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and sequencing tools.

Strong Pluses

  • Familiarity with the security integrator channel.
  • Experience with public sector buyers.

How We Measure Success

  • Qualified meetings booked and accepted by the BDM each month.
  • Pipeline created from those meetings, including partner-sourced opportunities.
  • Activity quality and CRM accuracy.

How You're Paid: A competitive base and commission plan tied to the meetings and pipeline you create.

Benefits: Our benefits differ by location.

Working Hours: Standard hours are 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern. Stable internet and a quiet home office are required.

How to Apply

Apply with your resume and, in your cover letter, a short note on the camera, security or video analytics deals you have worked on, the partners or customers you know in this market, and why AI Live Insight interests you. Shortlisted candidates will have a screening call with HR, then interviews with the business development team and a short role-play.

VIDIZMO is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

For out-of-state residents, clinical rates range from $58.50 to $85.00/hour based on location.

About You

  • Willing and motivated to become licensed in other states. We'll cover the entire cost.
  • 2+ years of clinical experience with adults (18+), 6+ months of teletherapy experience, proficiency with clinical assessments (e.g., PHQ-9), and comfort with EHR systems.

About the Role

  • Deliver remote, evidence-based therapy to adult clients (18+), practicing modalities like CBT, DBT, ACT, MBCT, TLDP, IPT, EFT, and MI.

    • Available for manager check-ins (1 hour/week during your first 6 weeks, followed by 30 minutes/month.
  • Use data to drive effective treatment and adjust your approach based on client progress.
  • Collaborate with other mental health providers as needed and refer clients when appropriate.
  • All documentation to be completed, signed, and locked in EMR within 48 hours of client contact.

About Two Chairs

Two Chairs is setting a new standard in mental health care with seamlessly integrated therapy and psychiatry delivered by highly trained clinicians, powered by smart technology, and measured for real impact. By combining timely access, personalized care, and proven outcomes — we’re creating a system that works — for patients, providers, health plans, and clinicians alike. With that, we're excited and honored to have been recognized as a 2025 Great Place to Work and 2025 Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare.

One of our company values is "Embrace Differences" and diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are the principles guiding how we build our business and teams. We encourage interested candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't think they meet some expectations of the role.

What to Expect After Applying: Our Interview Process

Once you complete your interviews and sign your offer, you can begin onboarding in as little as 7 days!

raw.title: Fractional Marketing Demand Generation Leader
raw.excerpt: About the companyiSpeedToLead is the #1 lead marketplace in the US for real estate investors.
raw.description:
About the company

iSpeedToLead is the #1 lead marketplace in the US for real estate investors.

Investors, wholesalers and agents buy phone-verified seller leads like products in an online store.

For us, growth means paying buyers who buy again. It does not mean clicks or sign-ups.

Who we're looking for

An operator who ships, not a consultant who recommends.

Someone who sees a problem on Monday and has a fix live by Wednesday.

Bold. You’d rather launch, measure and kill something than wait for permission.

Self-driven. Nobody will manage your to-do list or approve your copy.

You write from the customer’s pain, not from our feature list.

You pivot fast. When the data says something isn’t working, you change course within days, not weeks.

Who you'll market to

  • Investors burning cash on cold calling, mailers and lists that don’t convert.
  • Wholesalers with empty pipelines and no predictable deal flow.
  • Agents chasing leads that turn out to be junk.

If you can’t make a wholesaler feel that pain in one headline, this isn’t your role.

What you'll be doing

  • Holiday campaigns, starting immediately: Black Friday, Cyber Monday and a year-end / “start Q1 with deals” push.
  • Each campaign gets an offer, ads, landing page, email and SMS. Each one has a cash goal and a written readout afterward.
  • Retargeting across Google and Meta, segmented by intent:

– Site visitors who didn’t sign up

– Sign-ups who haven’t bought

  • First-time buyers who haven’t bought again

– Lapsed buyers

  • Each segment gets its own message, offer and frequency.
  • Google (Search, PMax, YouTube) and Meta budgets. Cut what doesn’t pay back. Scale what does.
  • Pain-point-led creative and copy across ads, landing pages, email and SMS.
  • Weekly scorecard: paying buyers by source, CAC, payback and repeat-buyer rate.
  • Tracking fixes with our data team: UTMs, Conversions API, offline conversions.
  • Direction for the in-house marketing team (paid, social, email, content).

How you'll use AI

We expect you to use AI daily. We care how you use it, not whether.

Use it to move faster: customer research, competitor teardowns, data analysis, creative variants for testing, reporting.

Do not use it to flood channels with generic, interchangeable copy. We’ll spot it, and so will our buyers.

AI gives you the volume. Your judgment, specificity and voice decide what ships.

How you'll work

You have authority to launch campaigns, write copy and move budget within agreed limits.

No copy approval cycle. You own the result.

Guardrails only: a monthly spend cap, CAC limits and TCPA / CAN-SPAM compliance.

Weekly Slack update: what you killed, what you pivoted and why.

First 30 days

Week 1: Black Friday / Cyber Monday campaign live, with retargeting audiences built.

Week 2: Tracking audit with gaps listed, and holiday results readout.

Week 4: Year-end campaign live, segmented retargeting running, and a channel-by-channel readout comparing spend with the cash it returned.

What makes you a strong fit

5+ years in performance or growth marketing, with ownership of paid budgets across Google and Meta.

Hands-on experience building segmented retargeting and lifecycle campaigns.

A track record of pivoting a campaign or channel based on data, with results to show for it.

Proof you’ve written direct-response copy that sold to a US audience.

Strong measurement skills: GA4, Conversions API, UTMs, offline conversions.

Fluent English and the ability to write natural, persuasive copy for US real estate investors.

Availability for at least 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central business hours.

Bonus if you have

Real estate investing, proptech or lead generation experience.

SMS marketing with TCPA compliance (opt-in, quiet hours).

Marketplace or repeat-purchase small-business products.

When this role may be a poor fit

You need approval before you ship.

You measure success by clicks, impressions or sign-ups.

You write polite, feature-led copy.

You’ve only managed agencies or one channel.

Engagement details

Contract: Hourly, roughly 25–40 hours per week, for 60–90 days with possible extension.

This role starts as a fractional engagement with the potential to transition to a full-time role.

Start: As soon as possible.

Remote. Communication runs through Slack.

An NDA is required before account access.

How to apply

Skip the generic proposal and answer these four things:

Tell us about a campaign you pivoted mid-flight: what the data showed, what you changed and what it returned in cash.

Write one Black Friday retargeting ad for a wholesaler who signed up but never bought. Give us the headline and the first line of body copy.

raw.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude.

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

The Role

Black Semiconductor is looking for a Strategic Procurement Manager (f/m/d) or Category Manager (f/m/d) to strengthen our growing team in Aachen, Germany. In this role, you will lead strategic sourcing and supplier management activities for materials critical to semiconductor manufacturing. You will ensure continuity of supply, optimize total cost of ownership, and maintain quality compliance while adapting to evolving technology requirements and market conditions.

To join our team, you should be excited to take ownership of:

  • Develop and execute global sourcing strategies for semiconductor materials, including wafers, photoresists, CMP slurries, specialty gases, chemicals, and other critical materials.

  • Identify, qualify, and manage strategic suppliers while ensuring alignment with technology roadmaps, quality standards, and production requirements.

  • Negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms to achieve cost targets while securing reliable supply.

  • Monitor semiconductor material markets, supplier performance, pricing trends, and supply chain risks to identify opportunities and mitigation strategies.

  • Collaborate with R&D, process engineering, quality, and manufacturing teams to align material requirements with technology and production needs.

  • Support new product introductions by sourcing materials that meet emerging process requirements and scalability targets.

  • Manage procurement performance, supplier relationships, and reporting activities to support business objectives.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in supply chain management, engineering, physics, materials science, business, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management, preferably within semiconductors, electronics, or advanced manufacturing.

  • Proven experience negotiating contracts, managing suppliers, and driving cost optimization initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of semiconductor materials and processes, including wafers, specialty gases, chemicals, photoresists, lithography, etching, and metallization materials.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience using ERP/procurement systems and data analysis tools.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with fluent English; German language skills are considered an advantage.

  • Willing to work on-site at our Aachen office at least once a week.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreThe Alliance for Decision Education (the Alliance) is a national nonprofit and field builder with the mission of improving lives by empowering K-12 students with essential skills and dispositions for making better decisions.
raw.description:
Who We Are

The Alliance for Decision Education (the Alliance) is a national nonprofit and field builder with the mission of improving lives by empowering K-12 students with essential skills and dispositions for making better decisions. Founded in 2014 and backed by experts in decision sciences, business, and education—including several Nobel laureates—the Alliance believes that better decisions lead to better lives and a better society.

As a field builder, the Alliance partners with teachers, academic and business leaders, families, and community members to raise awareness and lead the growing call to have Decision Education taught in schools across the country.

The Alliance is committed to an inclusive, supportive, and collaborative culture. Our diverse team comprises educators, researchers, subject matter experts, and other professionals dedicated to our mission. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

What We Offer

The Alliance offers a comprehensive total rewards package, inclusive of competitive compensation.

Annual Salary:

  • $140,000 - 160,000 per year, commensurate with experience and qualifications*

Benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance (100% employer-paid)
  • Basic life insurance and AD&D (100% employer-paid)
  • Short-term disability insurance (100% employer-paid)
  • Long-term disability insurance (100% employer-paid)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with up to a 5% employer match (100% vested)
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care)
  • Up to 20 days of Paid Time Off per calendar year (prorated the first year based on hire date)
  • Unlimited paid sick time
  • Hybrid work schedule
  • Paid lunch stipend while working on-site

*Salary range is a good-faith estimate based on external benchmarking, internal equity, and industry standards and may vary based on qualifications and experience. Benefits are subject to change at the organization’s discretion.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Director of State and District Policy is a senior role responsible for advancing the Alliance’s state and national policy agenda through state and district engagement, policy-aligned outreach, and coalition and stakeholder activities that advance Decision Education. This position focuses on building awareness and scaling Decision Education implementation through network expansion, policy development, relationship-building, and communication with policymakers, external partners, and internal teams.

This role will report to the Director of Public Policy within the Public Policy Department.

LOCATION AND SCHEDULE

This full-time role requires an 8-hour workday and a 40-hour workweek. It is an exempt position under the FLSA and is not eligible for overtime pay.

This position is open to local and remote candidates. Local employees follow the Alliance hybrid schedule, working onsite at our Bala Cynwyd, PA, headquarters every Tuesday and Wednesday and remotely on Monday, Thursday, and Friday. Fully remote employees are expected to maintain a productive home-based workspace and stay engaged with the team during Eastern Time business hours. Leadership-level remote employees are expected to be onsite once every month on both designated in-office days. The role requires 15-30 percent travel for state and district leadership engagements, national and regional conferences, and internal and all-staff meetings at organization headquarters.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

State and District Engagement

  • Lead state and district engagement efforts to advance the adoption and implementation of Decision Education in K–12 schools nationwide.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with superintendents, curriculum directors, state education officials, and other education leaders to expand implementation opportunities and build a pipeline of state and district leaders.
  • Collaborate with the Education team to design and pilot multiple pathways for integrating Decision Education into classroom instruction across subject areas, including mathematics, career and technical education (CTE), college and career exploration, social studies, and English language arts.
  • Develop and execute state and district engagement strategies, including a ladder of engagement that supports education systems at varying levels of readiness for implementation and scale.
  • Co-design state and district policies to codify Decision Education in K-12 systems and collaborate with the Deputy Director of Public Policy, Legislative Engagement to ensure policies are adopted through necessary state and district channels.
  • Represent the Alliance at state, regional, and national convenings of education system leaders, building awareness of and interest in the Alliance and classroom implementation of Decision Education.
  • Establish and apply criteria for prioritizing state and district engagement based on implementation readiness, existing relationships, demonstrated interest, and alignment with current education policies.
  • Identify opportunities to align Decision Education with state and district priorities, curriculum frameworks, and existing educational initiatives.
  • Engage current and past Policymaker Fellows in the design and implementation of legislation, regulations, and pilot programs in collaboration with the Senior Manager, Public Policy.

Strategic Planning and Management

  • Build state and district policy and pilot implementation plans with the Director of Public Policy, Education team staff, and national and regional partners.
  • Support the development and monitoring of department-level Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) related to state and district policy development and adoption.
  • Collaborate with the Communications team, the Director of Public Policy, and other teams to design research briefings and public-facing toolkits that shape the national narrative around the importance of Decision Education in K-12 education policy.
  • Support senior‑level relationship management with key strategic policy leaders, including preparing for, aligning, and following up on high‑value engagements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure public policy activities are aligned, supported, and communicated effectively.
  • Represent the Alliance at events, conferences, and in key coalitions and coordinated advocacy campaigns.

These responsibilities may change or expand over time, consistent with the organization’s needs and initiatives.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive experience leading education policy, public policy formulation, and state and district education initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in state and district education processes and governance, standards-aligned education, and educator professional development.
  • Experience contributing to strategic planning and organizational alignment.
  • Experience managing complex cross-sector initiatives, education policy campaigns, and district- and state-wide initiatives.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience tracking goals and metrics.
  • Ability to represent the Alliance at conferences, executive-level meetings, and national events.
  • Experience using a CRM system.
  • Excellent communication, judgment, and organizational skills.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience in a national nonprofit or mission‑driven organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with policymakers, district staff, and education leaders.
  • Experience navigating complex education policy initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Interest in decision science, behavioral economics, psychology, cognitive science, or related fields.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship‑building skills
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem‑solving ability, and sound judgment
  • Effective leadership skills with the ability to guide, mentor, and collaborate across teams
  • Respectful, collegial, and highly collaborative working style
  • Intellectually humble, open‑minded, innovative, strategic, and adaptable
  • Growth‑minded, intellectually curious, and committed to continuous learning
  • Highly organized, diligent, reliable, professional, and efficient
  • Demonstrated initiative, independence, and the ability to work productively with minimal oversight
  • Strong time‑management skills and the ability to meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment
  • Passionate about the mission and motivated to contribute to organizational success
  • Detail‑oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
  • Reflects the Alliance’s core values and standards:
    • Humanism: valuing others as human beings
    • Rationality: thinking and skills to help answer “What is true?” and “What to do?”
    • Education: growth mindset; dedication to developing knowledge and skills
    • Conscientiousness: diligent work ethic; professionalism; high‑quality work
    • Initiative: owners’ and founders’ mentality; leadership skills
    • Mission Alignment: dedication to the organization’s mission and goals

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Employment is contingent upon completing Form I‑9 and verifying authorization to work in the United States, as required by federal law.
  • Successful completion of the pre‑employment screening process.
  • Compliance with all organizational policies and procedures.
  • Ability to understand and demonstrate safe work practices to ensure a safe work environment.
  • Complete special projects and other duties as assigned.

Physical and Environmental Demands

  • Primarily desk‑based work involving sitting at a workstation
  • Occasional walking, standing, or lifting/carrying up to 10 lbs
  • Frequent hand and finger dexterity for typing, writing, and handling objects
  • Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to travel 15–30 percent, including overnight travel, for state and district engagements, conferences, and headquarters meetings, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • The Alliance is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions, including the use of assistive technologies

This role is based in the United States. Applicants must have authorization to work in the U.S. and must not require current or future visa sponsorship.

The Alliance for Decision Education is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment based on merit, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, ancestry, or veteran status.

Employment with the Alliance for Decision Education is at will, meaning either the employee or the organization may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

raw.excerpt: About UsAt Quartermaster AI, we leverage cutting-edge AI and robotics technology to enhance maritime domain awareness.
raw.description:
About Us

At Quartermaster AI, we leverage cutting-edge AI and robotics technology to enhance maritime domain awareness. Our mission is to become the eyes, ears, and brain of the ocean by enabling every vessel to collaboratively sense, compute, and communicate. Quartermaster is a venture-backed Maritime Domain Awareness company providing near real-time insights to government and commercial partners via our SmartMast™ product. SmartMast™ is a COTS sensor system consisting of a camera, a software defined radio, and a proprietary onboard AI component installed on vessels worldwide and managed by Quartermaster.

About the Role

As a Launcher for Asia, you will carry out Quartermaster's market entry across one of the world's busiest and most strategically important maritime regions. Reporting to the Head of Launch, Asia, you will turn regional strategy into results on the ground: obtaining regulatory approval for deployment, securing vessels, and getting SmartMast™ hardware deployed. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role that sits between our regional leadership, local partners, and Field Operations. Success in this role is measured in markets opened, and SmartMast™ units installed, activated, and reporting across Asia's waters.

What you'll own

Regulatory & Compliance Support

  • Government & Regulatory Liaison: Support the Head of Launch in building relationships with national maritime authorities, coast guards, and port authorities, and manage day-to-day working contacts with them.

  • Compliance Execution: Prepare and track the filings, permits, and approvals each launch requires, working with Legal and Compliance on customs, trade, spectrum and equipment type-approval, data handling, and maritime safety requirements.

  • Regulatory Monitoring: Track policy changes across the region's regulatory regimes pertinent to operation of SmartMast™.

Market Entry Execution

  • Playbook Execution: Carry out market entry playbooks in assigned markets, adapting them to local conditions and reporting what works and what does not.

  • Import & Logistics: Manage the import, customs, and logistics steps that bring SmartMast™ hardware into target markets, including warehousing and staging ahead of deployment.

  • Vendor Management: Source, vet, and manage local installers, fabricators, and port-side vendors to Quartermaster's quality and safety standards.

Maritime Stakeholder Engagement

  • Vessel Sourcing: Identify and engage commercial fleet operators, fishing fleets, independent vessel owners, and port authorities suitable for SmartMast™ deployment, and build a pipeline of vessels.

  • Agreement Support: Prepare and negotiate partnership and space-use agreements (the right to mount and operate our hardware on a vessel), closing deals within the terms set by the Head of Launch.

  • Partner Onboarding: Move signed partners to installation, coordinating with Field Operations so vessels are ready and deployments run without delay.

  • Relationship Management: Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for fleets, ports, and vendors in assigned markets, keeping partners engaged after installation.

Reporting & Coordination

  • Launch Tracking: Maintain accurate records of pipeline, agreements, installs, and activations, and report progress to the Head of Launch.

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with product, engineering, legal, and marketing teams to resolve issues that block launches in assigned markets.

  • Market Intelligence: Gather local insight on regional dynamics, technical requirements, and localized risks to inform regional strategy.

What you need

  • Experience: 5+ years in operations, market entry, business development, or government relations roles, ideally within maritime, logistics, defense, or other highly regulated sectors.

  • Regional Expertise: Working knowledge of the political, regulatory, and commercial landscape across Asia's ports and maritime economies.

  • Stakeholder Skills: Experience working with government agencies, port authorities, or fleet operators, and building trust with local partners.

  • Commercial Skills: Track record of sourcing and closing B2B agreements, vendor contracts, or fleet partnerships.

  • Execution Focus: A bias for action. Comfortable managing several launch workstreams at once, in the field and at a desk.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel frequently across the region, including to ports and vessels.

  • Language Skills: Fluency in English is required. Professional proficiency in Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Tagalog, or Vietnamese is highly preferred.

Compensation Range: $170K - $200K

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a UI Designer to craft intuitive, elegant and high-performing interfaces for BJAK's AI and financial products.

This role is for someone who obsesses over visual quality, interaction details and usability. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to design mobile-first experiences that make complex financial products feel simple, trustworthy and enjoyable to use.

What You'll Own

  • Design polished, user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products.

  • Transform product requirements into wireframes, user flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI.

  • Build intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial services.

  • Maintain and evolve BJAK's design system to ensure consistency across products.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to deliver pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Iterate designs using user feedback, analytics and usability testing.

  • Ensure accessibility, responsiveness and visual consistency across different devices and platforms.

  • Contribute to improving overall product usability, interaction patterns and visual language.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, interaction design and UI craftsmanship.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design workflows.

  • Strong understanding of mobile-first design principles, platform guidelines (iOS & Android) and responsive layouts.

  • Good understanding of UX principles, information architecture and user-centred design.

  • Ability to simplify complex user journeys into intuitive interfaces.

  • High attention to detail with strong visual hierarchy, typography and spacing.

Design Tools

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout & Components

  • Design Tokens

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in complete user journeys, not just beautiful screens.

  • Designers who focus only on aesthetics without considering usability.

  • Individuals who require extensive direction before making design decisions.

Our process is designed to move fast:

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

raw.excerpt: Overview Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm.
raw.description:
Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.


Responsibilities

Are you ready to drive impressive growth in a dynamic market? As our next Sales Leader, your primary purpose is to be the engine of territory growth. You will achieve this by leveraging comprehensive market knowledge and utilizing effective agent sales consulting to dramatically enhance the customer experience and meet diverse needs. This role is crucial for fostering a culture of high engagement and adaptability within the sales territory, helping to position our independent contractor agents to capture every bit of market potential. If you are passionate about leadership, growth, and building winning teams, we want to hear from you!

In this job you are primarily responsible for:

  • Driving Territory Results: Using in-depth market knowledge and effective sales strategies to meet customer needs and deliver exceptional experiences
  • Business Coaching: Coaching agents on aspects of business management to evolve with customer demands and meet their business objectives
  • Agent Placement and Development: Overseeing the process of strategically placing and developing agents to maximize market opportunities

Location: Iowa Hawkeye East Sales Territory

The Hawkeye East Sales Territory spans southeast-central Iowa and includes Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, the Quad Cities, and surrounding communities. The territory offers a diverse market, blending vibrant metropolitan areas, growing suburban communities, and rural markets supported by strong industries including healthcare, education, manufacturing, agriculture, and technology. Home to the University of Iowa and several major employers, the region continues to experience residential and commercial growth, creating meaningful opportunities to deepen customer relationships and expand market share. The territory is supported by a mix of experienced and newly appointed Agents, making it an excellent opportunity for a leader who is passionate about developing talent, building strong agency relationships, and driving sales results. Hawkeye East Sales Territory is consistently a top performing sales team and territory.


Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in insurance, financial services or sales leadership, showcasing strong expertise and a genuine passion for the insurance and financial services industry.
  • Strong track record of coaching and influencing sales professionals and implementing organizational and territory strategies that drive growth and customer service.
  • Expertise in identifying and pursuing innovative approaches to enhance insurance and financial services outcomes.
  • Ability to recruit and select entrepreneurs looking to own their own business while contributing to the success of our organization.
  • Strong ability to build and maintain relationships with sales professionals, senior field leaders, and key business partners to leverage knowledge and expertise to enhance your ability to drive results.
  • Ability to coach and consult with sales professionals in hosting needs-based conversations covering a spectrum of customer needs.
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial mindset with proven track record of successfully launching, managing, or growing a business or startup utilizing innovation, strategic planning, and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, interpersonal, and coaching skills.
    • Presentation skills - effectively conveys information in a clear and professional manner to internal and/or external individuals/groups.
    • Ability to effectively communicate and negotiate with others to reach mutually beneficial solutions with both internal and external individual/groups.

Additional Details

  • Candidates will need to successfully complete the Sales Leader Approval process and have previously passed the FINRA SIE exam to be eligible to post for the Sales Leader role.
  • Selected candidates will be required to possess and/or obtain a Series 6 license, and Series 63, Series 65 or equivalent, Life/Health, Variable, and Property and Casualty Licenses.
  • Fingerprint, credit check and background check are required for sponsorship of FINRA licensing.
  • Employees must successfully obtain all other applicable licensing and certifications for role including, but not limited to, LTC Certification, Annuities Certification and potential state securities licensing, as applicable.
  • Employees may be required to sign the Acknowledgement of Policy on Personal Account Transactions
  • Must work flexible, non-standard hours, including weekends and holidays, based on operational needs and workload
  • Selected employees must maintain a valid license to lawfully operate vehicles as requested by the company. MVR check will be completed as part of the pre-employment process.
  • Requirements subject to change at State Farm discretion based on a business need.

**Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H-1B Visa) or future need for this opportunity**

***Last date to apply: 11/24/2026 at 11:00pm, CST***


Our Benefits

The annual salary for this role is $200,000 and employees are not eligible for annual merit increases. Employees may be eligible for a biweekly geographic differential based on the location from which an employee is working.

Employees may be eligible to participate in incentive programs, including a quarterly bonus and an annual bonus. Incentive compensation is not guaranteed, and eligibility is contingent upon successful completion of all applicable licensing and securities registration.

Remote Work Arrangement: The Sales Leader role is a remote position which requires the selected candidate to work out of his/her home and will require periodic travel to conduct/attend meetings and/or seminars, training, conferences.

Licensing
This position requires you to obtain/maintain all applicable FINRA licensing exams (Securities Industry Essentials, Series 6, Series 63, and Series 65 or equivalent), sponsorship from State Farm VP Management Corp (SFVPMC) and State Farm Investment Management Corp. (SFIMC), and that you become registered and remain in good standing as required by SFVPMC, SFIMC and FINRA. To confirm eligibility for sponsorship, you will complete a contingent credit check and fingerprints. This is in addition to the pre-employment background check. You will be required to sign a Securities Registration Agreement upon hire.

This position requires you to obtain/maintain state insurance licenses and certifications, and all other applicable licensing and certifications for the role including, but not limited to, LTC Certification, Annuities Certification and potential state securities licensing as applicable.

If you do not currently hold all applicable licensing, certifications, and registration, they must be obtained within approximately 3 months of your start date. During this time period, you will be placed in a temporary Licensing Candidate – UNS job in a non-exempt status while obtaining your required licensing, securities registration, and certifications. Once all required licensing, securities registration, and certifications are complete and verified, you will be placed into the Sales Leader job at the start of the next pay period.

At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!

  • Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more!
  • Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring.
  • Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union!
  • Take a Little “You” Time! You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you!
  • Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund.
  • Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary.

Visit our State Farm Careers page for more information on our benefits, locations, and the hiring process of joining the State Farm team!

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Poland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Poland.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.excerpt: Be Part of an Amazing StoryMacy’s is more than just a store.
raw.description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Product Manager brings a high-energy approach to developing customer & colleague-centric experiences and features that grow the customer base, drive user engagement, and improve the overall site store experience. The role develops and owns execution of the product roadmap for the assigned product area and collaborates with cross functional partners across design, engineering, analytics, and business throughout the product lifecycle, from ideation through execution. The Product Manager works in an agile environment focused on continuous improvement, where ideas and feedback are encouraged, and is empowered to make decisions that create memorable, loyalty-building experiences for every Macy's customer & colleague.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and maintain a product roadmap aligned to business goals and product strategy by delivering key milestones and achieving defined KPIs.
  • Communicate product vision, roadmap, and progress to partners across Macy’s.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve customer & colleague experiences through cross-functional collaboration, data analysis, and deep understanding of customer & colleague needs.
  • Define product and customer/colleague experiences through clear, detailed, and timely artifacts, including product requirements and user stories.
  • Collaborate with design, engineering, analytics, and other product managers to design, build, and launch product features that drive growth and engagement.
  • Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog of well-groomed, insight-driven user stories.
  • Partner with engineering scrum teams and technical leads to refine requirements that support simple, intuitive user experiences.
  • Define success metrics, ramp plans, and measurement criteria.
  • Design and run experiments to test hypotheses and identify solutions that improve conversion, engagement, customer loyalty, and colleague adoption.
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.
  • In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: Proven ability to define, maintain, and execute product roadmaps that align with business goals, product strategy, and KPIs while delivering measurable customer and commercial impact.

Customer-Centric Product Thinking: Deep commitment to understanding customer & colleague needs and behaviors, translating insights into intuitive & efficient, loyalty-building store experiences that improve engagement and satisfaction.

Analytical Thinking & Data-Driven Decisions: Strong analytical rigor and first-principles problem-solving skills, with the ability to define success metrics, run experiments, interpret data, and apply insights to optimize conversion, engagement, and retention.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and collaborate effectively with design, engineering, analytics, and business partners across the full product lifecycle.

Execution Excellence in Agile Environments: Strong execution skills with experience managing backlogs, grooming user stories, partnering with scrum teams, and delivering high-quality outcomes in an agile, fast-paced environment.

Business Acumen & E-commerce Expertise: Solid understanding of retail and e-commerce economics and business strategy frameworks, with the ability to balance customer value and commercial outcomes.

Technical & Product Development Fluency: Working knowledge of technical concepts, agile methodologies, and modern product development practices to effectively partner with engineering teams and make informed trade-offs.

Innovation & Emerging Technology Awareness: Ability to stay ahead of emerging technologies and leverage them to build differentiated, scalable store experiences.

Communication & Stakeholder Influence: Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate product vision, progress, and trade-offs to cross-functional partners and senior leaders.

Continuous Learning & Growth Mindset: Curiosity-driven, adaptable learner who actively seeks new methodologies, industry trends, and feedback to continuously improve products and ways of working.

Who You Are

  • Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. Previous work experience related to product strategy, product management, design, engineering, site merchandising, or management consulting preferably in a retail or ecommerce company required.
  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.
  • Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
  • Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.
