raw.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

The Sr Implementation Manager is responsible for the strategic organization and execution of all tactical tasks related to the implementation, including funding arrangements, plan design and technical integration associated with each deployment. This person should possess great cross-functional leadership and teamwork skills all the while providing exception customer service to internal and external clients. Using a consultative approach, this person will onboard our midsize clients, develop and document a plan design to meet their business requirements, create and maintain a formal project plan, and deliver on quality execution and employer satisfaction. This person will be required to move projects forward amidst ambiguous client expectations. This person will assist with the standardization of tools and processes used by the team and contribute to team trainings, documentation and lead departmental initiatives. The combination of product, program and system knowledge, interpersonal communication, social skills, a strong sense of initiative and drive to get the job completed will be critical.

What you’ll be doing

  • Identify client nuances, plan requirements, and contractual commitments to create non-standard solutions.
  • Implementation manager is responsible for coordinating and planning with all levels of internal and external partners including cross-functional teams, clients, Third Party Administrators, brokers, and external partners.
  • Lead client advocate throughout the implementation while maintaining project management standard methodologies to keep leadership and key partners informed of progress, risk assessments and executive summaries, as appropriate. Proactively identify factors jeopardizing the project and leverage internal resources, and client contacts to assess and mitigate further issues before looping in internal leadership.
  • Develop unique project specifications and objectives from initiation to delivery for implementation projects of moderate complexity with standard and non-standard solutions for both new and existing clients.
  • Own the discussion through a consultative approach and suggest solutions with key partners for standard and customized plan design. Collaborate with clients and/or cross-functional teams to produce functional specifications, design documents, and other blueprints for the project. Define scope of efforts required to meet objectives and create comprehensive project timelines. This includes analyzing, reviewing, and forecasting project expenditures and mitigating scope creep.
  • Responsible to drive project team and partners down the critical path by preparing and regularly maintaining project plans after aligning on necessary project steps, activities, the sequence of events, critical success paths, dependencies, and the duration of tasks with all partners.
  • Identify and acquire appropriate resource needs, ensuring availability to support and complete project deliverables. Manage resources within respective departments, other internal departments, outside service providers as well as materials committed to the projects. This may include collaboration with functional department managers to assemble project teams.
  • Identify, assign, and align on project responsibilities ensuring that activity, integration, and productivity are employed in the most efficient manner while still meeting project targets. Manage resources within respective departments, other internal departments, outside service providers as well as materials committed to the projects to ensure that project breakthroughs are met and completed on time.
  • Perform various implementation tasks including plan requirement completion, business and technical data gathering, complete system configuration, communications strategy consultation and materials delivery, and web-based system demonstrations and training sessions.

What you will need to be successful

  • 3-7 years of client service experience; benefits industry
  • 1-4 years of experience with special projects, possesses project management skills and effective project tracking
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • Experience with project management tools required, such as Workfront and Monday.com
  • Direct client facing and implementation/project management delivery experience
  • Always maintains a professional composure
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high stress and high-demand environment especially during peak times
  • Multi-tasking ability with an attention to detail
  • Capable to develop and maintain strong relationships
  • Passionate and dynamic about making a difference for our clients in their health plans
  • Adept at learning new products and services to deliver remarkable results consistently
  • Ability to transition quickly to new responsibilities and changes in process
  • Active listener, ability to ask probing questions and capable of influencing
  • Effective in written and verbal communications, able to offer professional coaching to our clients on effective use of our online tools
  • Capable to work independently, self-motivated and organized and can problem-solve complex problems
  • Prioritizes to accomplish work in a timely and successful manner

This is a remote position.

Salary Range

$60000.00 To $90000.00 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • HSA contribution and match
  • Dependent care FSA match
  • Uncapped paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) match
  • Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs
  • Ongoing education & tuition assistance
  • Gym and fitness reimbursement
  • Wellness program incentives

Onboarding & Travel

This is a remote role, with an in-person onboarding training component. New team members must participate in Trailhead, HealthEquity’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

This role may begin with a virtual, self-paced onboarding experience, followed by a mandatory onsite Trailhead session at a later date.

HealthEquity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to team members with qualifying disabilities. Should you be selected for this role and require an accommodation, we will put you in touch with our Benefits Team so you can begin the accommodation request process.

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. We are passionate about providing a solution that allows American families to connect health and wealth. Join us and discover a work experience where the person is valued more than the position. About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Portugal. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Portugal.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Role Title: English Language Expert (Canada)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Canada, Remote

micro1 is engaging English Language Experts (Canada) to contribute to a customer's audio annotation project focused on Canadian English. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. This engagement is ideal for those with extensive experience in language-related fields such as teaching, transcription, editing, translation, or journalism—any background that demonstrates a deep familiarity with the nuances of Canadian English.

Scope of Work

  1. Listen to and analyze multi-speaker conversational audio samples featuring a range of Canadian English dialects and accents.
  2. Tag audio and speaker metadata, including aspects such as audio quality, background noise, dialect, accent, age, and speaking style.
  3. Edit and correct automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts using Canadian English spelling, vocabulary, and conventions.
  4. Identify and annotate region-specific linguistic features, idioms, slang, and phonological phenomena like Canadian raising.
  5. Ensure all annotations are accurate, consistent, and align with project guidelines emphasizing Canadian English distinctions.
  6. Collaborate with project team members through written and verbal channels to clarify guidelines or resolve linguistic ambiguities.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Fluent proficiency in Canadian English, with a strong command of its regional varieties.
  2. Background in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or related fields.
  3. Demonstrated ability to distinguish between Canadian English dialects (e.g., Atlantic Canadian, Quebec, Ontario, Prairie, West Coast).
  4. Familiarity with Canadian English vocabulary, idioms, slang, and spelling conventions (including British and American influences).
  5. Meticulous attention to detail and a keen ear for subtle linguistic differences.
  6. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity, accuracy, and collaboration.
  7. Experience in audio annotation or ASR transcript editing is an asset, though not required.

raw.description:
Redox is on a mission to accelerate healthcare’s transformation with useful data. Redox Engine, a flexible interoperability platform, connects and powers real-time healthcare data exchange. With just one connection, data can be orchestrated across a growing network of 12,000+ systems and organizations, including 100+ electronic health record systems (EHRs). Redox processes over 1.2 billion messages per month across our health tech vendor, provider, payer, EHR, and life sciences customers.

Opportunity & Impact

Redox is on a mission to accelerate healthcare’s transformation with useful data. The Redox Engine, a flexible interoperability platform, connects and powers real-time healthcare data exchange. With just one connection, data can be orchestrated across a growing network of 12,000+ systems and organizations, including 90+ electronic health record systems (EHRs). Redox processes over 1.6 billion messages per month across our health tech vendor, provider, payer, EHR, and life sciences customers.

We’re a fully remote team within the U.S. that operates with radical transparency and a strong bias toward ownership.

Impact on Team:

    As Interim Chief Financial Officer for a venture-backed health tech company, you will lead the finance function while we search for our permanent CFO. Your job is to keep finance running smoothly, give the CEO and leadership team accurate, timely financial insight, and keep momentum on our growth and cash priorities. This is a hands-on role: you will lead a small, capable finance team and work alongside them, not just oversee the work. You will also set the function up for a smooth handoff to the permanent CFO.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Financial Operations and Reporting: Own the monthly close, financial statements and management reporting. Keep reporting accurate, timely and compliant with applicable standards.

  • Cash Management and Forecasting: Manage cash and maintain a rolling forecast. Give the CEO a clear, current view of the business and the trade-offs between growth investment and cost.

  • Budgeting and Planning: Finalize and manage the annual operating plan and budget with the CEO and executive team.

  • Board of Directors (BOD) Engagement: Prepare board financial materials and present financial results and analysis at board meetings.

  • Team Leadership: Lead and support the finance team, including pricing and FP&A, through the transition. Keep priorities clear and the team engaged.

  • Deal and Pricing Support: Work with Sales and the CEO to price and structure complex customer deals.

  • Audit, Tax and Compliance: Coordinate the annual audit, tax filings and other compliance requirements with external partners.

  • Transition to Permanent CFO: Document key processes, priorities and open issues, and onboard the permanent CFO once hired.

What You'll Bring:

  • Proven track record as a CFO or senior finance leader at a SaaS or technology company, including interim or fractional engagements.

  • Experience at venture-backed, growth-stage companies, and comfort with a fast-moving, scrappy environment.

  • Background in health tech, ideally with exposure to data interoperability or provider, payer and health tech vendor markets.

  • Ability to step in quickly, learn the business within weeks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information.

  • A hands-on style: comfortable running the close, building models and pricing deals yourself.

  • Experience preparing board materials and presenting to boards and investors.

  • Strong command of cash management, forecasting and SaaS metrics.

  • A creative, solutions-oriented approach: you bring options, not just constraints.

  • Clear communication and the executive presence to work with a direct, debate-oriented leadership team.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day work, and the ability to bring AI into how you and the finance team operate.

  • CPA, or a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field.

  • MBA (preferred, but not required)

Who You'll Be Engaging With:

  • CEO and the executive leadership team

  • Board of Directors and investors

  • Finance team, including pricing and FP&A

  • Sales team, on complex customer deals

  • External audit, tax and compliance partners

  • The permanent CFO, during the transition

You’re good at:

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Mobile developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What Will You Build

  • Build mobile features across Android, iOS or cross-platform flows depending on your strength.

  • Create clean journeys for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX and AI-assisted features.

  • Work from product problem to shipped mobile experience, not just assigned screens.

  • Collaborate with backend, design, product and AI teams to launch reliable customer-facing features.

  • Improve app quality through production feedback, analytics, crash reports and user behaviour.

  • Help raise the standard for mobile UX, reliability and speed across the product.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Experience shipping production mobile apps used by real users.

  • Good product sense, UX judgement and attention to edge cases.

  • Able to work across APIs, releases, debugging and production issues.

  • Hands-on builder who can take ownership without heavy guidance.

  • Clear evidence of shipped work: app links, GitHub, screenshots or project explanations.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Thailand. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Thailand.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.title: Senior General Ledger Accountant (w/m/d)
raw.excerpt: Übernimm Verantwortung für unser General Ledger und gestalte unsere Finance-Strukturen mit.
raw.description:
Übernimm Verantwortung für unser General Ledger und gestalte unsere Finance-Strukturen mit.

Black Semiconductor wächst international und baut seine Finance-Organisation für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter aus. In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du im Team Verantwortung für unser General Ledger und den Closing-Prozess und sorgst gleichzeitig dafür, dass unsere Accounting-Prozesse mit unserem Wachstum Schritt halten.

Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, bestehende Prozesse zuverlässig auszuführen. Du bringst Deine Erfahrung ein, entwickelst Strukturen weiter und gestaltest gemeinsam mit unserem Finance-Team den Aufbau unserer deutschen und niederländischen Gesellschaften mit.

Warum diese Rolle?

Ownership für General Ledger & Closing: Du übernimmst gemeinsam mit dem Team Verantwortung für die Hauptbuchhaltung sowie Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse und bist eine wichtige Säule für die Qualität unseres Accountings.

Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du arbeitest nicht nur mit bestehenden Strukturen, sondern entwickelst Accounting- und Closing-Prozesse aktiv weiter und schaffst Strukturen, die mit unserem Wachstum skalieren.

Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst Deine Erfahrung einbringen, Prozesse hinterfragen und gemeinsam mit dem Finance-Team Standards und Strukturen weiterentwickeln.

Internationale Perspektive: Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Strukturen im Zuge unseres Wachstums mit.

Hands-on & abwechslungsreich: Du bist nah am operativen Geschäft und kannst Deine fachliche Expertise dort einbringen, wo sie gebraucht wird.

Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit unserem Wachstum können auch Deine Verantwortlichkeiten wachsen – perspektivisch mit weiteren Aufgaben rund um internationale Gesellschaften und gruppenweite Finance-Strukturen.

Scale-up mit Corporate-Anspruch: Du verbindest die Dynamik eines wachsenden Unternehmens mit anspruchsvollen Finance-Themen und der Möglichkeit, Strukturen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

Verantwortung für unser General Ledger: Du übernimmst gemeinsam mit dem Team die Hauptbuchhaltung und stellst eine zuverlässige und qualitativ hochwertige Finanzbuchhaltung sicher.

Closing & Abschlüsse: Du verantwortest die Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse und sorgst für einen strukturierten und effizienten Closing-Prozess.

Operative Accounting-Exzellenz: Du übernimmst operative Accounting-Aufgaben, führst Kontenabstimmungen durch und stellst eine hohe Qualität unserer Finanzdaten sicher.

Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du hinterfragst bestehende Accounting-Prozesse, entwickelst sie weiter und schaffst gemeinsam mit dem Finance-Team effiziente und skalierbare Strukturen.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im General Ledger Accounting, in der Finanzbuchhaltung oder im Closing

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse der deutschen Rechnungslegung und relevanter HGB-Anforderungen

  • Erfahrung in der operativen Buchhaltung sowie Freude daran, Verantwortung für das Tagesgeschäft zu übernehmen

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Freude daran, bestehende Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Strukturen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir Dir bieten

Entwicklung: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch mit zusätzlichen Verantwortlichkeiten für unsere europäischen Tochtergesellschaften und der Möglichkeit, den Aufbau unserer globalen Finance-Organisation aktiv mitzugestalten.

Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens.

Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. einem Tag pro Woche in Aachen.

Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits.

Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll.

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du Dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.

Kannst Du Dich in dieser Rolle und in unserem Unternehmen wiederfinden? Let's connect.

At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose. We champion the power and potential of nonprofits, igniting next-level impact with the team and technology built for purpose. Our powerful giving platform and stellar support enable tens of thousands of nonprofits to raise more, recruit more, and retain more, fueling maximum impact and raising the bar on what’s possible for the nonprofit sector. That's why, even as the nonprofit sector sees declines in giving, Bloomerang customers raise more year over year.

We're also in the business of creating thriving employees. Join a mission-driven culture built on our core values of Simplify, Care and Act. We know our people are the key to our success, and we're proud to be home to some of the most innovative and skilled individuals in the workforce today. Come feel invigorated and unstoppable with us!

The Role

You will lead a team of Account Executives (AEs) to drive net new business at Bloomerang. This role is an integral part of the sales organization. You will be responsible for shifting the team from 'Feature Dumpers’' to 'High-Velocity Value Sellers' by providing coaching on connecting technical features to financial outcomes and business objectives. As the Sales Manager, you will teach the AE’s to act as the CEO of their own business and enable them to successfully execute a sales plan and exceed quota by mastering the 'Value Selling' framework, ensuring every AE can identify the prospect’s 'Business Objective' (Revenue Goal) and the cost of inaction.

What You Will Do

  • Beat the Plan by leading a high-performing sales team to surpass revenue targets and maximize market share
  • Coach AEs to move beyond being 'Tour Guides' who sell features; instead, train them to lead with 'Business Outcomes' (e.g., hitting fundraising goals) to maintain high-velocity deal momentum.
  • Identify risk within deals to overcome obstacles and forecast with more precision
  • Foster an environment and culture centered around self development and accountability
  • Champion a data-driven culture by leveraging analytics and insights to inform decision-making, and follow our qualification frameworks (IMPACT) to eliminate 'Happy Ears' and ensure pipeline accuracy based on confirmed pain, business objectives, and timelines.
  • Build and maintain a 'Hunter' culture by recruiting and onboarding AEs who demonstrate high grit, own their results without excuses, and can translate technical pain into financial risk and opportunity costs.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 1+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience with 3+ years of people leadership experience, preferably in a high-velocity, consultative sales environment
  • Takes a team-centric approach to winning. Collaborates with other sales managers to standardize a value-based sales motion that prioritizes 'Outcome Selling' over 'Feature Selling' across the organization.
  • Proven track record of managing 'High-Velocity Value Sellers' in a high-inbound environment, with a focus on maximizing every 'at-bat' through revenue-focused discovery.
  • Experience utilizing Salesforce, Outreach and other sales tools to audit discovery calls, ensuring reps are 'Peeling the Onion' to find the business objective rather than just identifying technical and superficial pain.

Benefits

Health + Wellness

You’ll have access to generous health, vision, and dental insurance options as well as HealthiestYou, a healthcare service that offers convenient, confidential access to quality doctors 24/7, anytime, anywhere.

Time Off

You’ll get a competitive PTO package that includes 20 PTO days, 3 flex days, 4 optional volunteer days, 12 paid holidays, as well as paid parental leave. More is more!

401k

You’ll receive a 401k match to help invest in your future.

Equipment

Everything you need to be successful, shipped right to your door. You got this. We got you.

Compensation

As this is an incentive compensation role, there is a base salary with annual on target earnings of $155,000-235,000 OTE. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, as well as applicable employment laws.

Location

This is a permanent, full-time, fully remote position. Employees living in Indianapolis, IN are welcome to work from our company headquarters. We do not offer Visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

Accommodations

Applicants who require accommodations may contact to request an accommodation in completing an application.

Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

Ready to be the engine behind accurate, timely stop loss filings that protect clients and recover real dollars?

Why This Role Matters

Stop loss reimbursement doesn't happen automatically — it takes someone who knows how to move a claim from eligibility assessment to filed submission to recovered dollars, without dropping the ball along the way. As a Stop Loss Specialist, you're the operational core of the filing process, managing spec claimants, tracking reimbursements, and keeping carriers and internal teams aligned. The accuracy and timeliness of your work directly affects cash flow, client financial outcomes, and the integrity of Personify Health's stop loss operations. When you do this job well, clients get what they're owed — and the business runs the way it should.

What You'll Actually Do

  • Prepare and file stop loss claim submissions: Assess claim eligibility against excess loss policy terms, gather required documents, run reports, and submit spec claimant filings within established internal timeframes.
  • Build and maintain claimant files: Create and manage the initial specific file for each claimant, keeping records accurate, complete, and audit-ready throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Track and recover outstanding reimbursements: Monitor all reinsurance requests to confirm receipt, generate weekly outstanding reimbursement reports, and follow up directly with stop loss carriers to drive resolution.
  • Maintain the reimbursement database: Keep the database of specific reimbursement requests current and accurate, ensuring leadership and teammates have reliable data to work from.
  • Serve as the liaison between PBMs and internal clients: Coordinate communication between pharmacy benefit managers and internal stakeholders as it relates to stop loss claimants, keeping all parties informed and aligned.
  • Escalate open and disputed items: Keep your supervisor informed of unresolved, disputed, or at-risk items in a timely manner so issues get addressed before they compound.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education & Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED required; additional education in healthcare, business, or a related field a plus
  • Minimum 3 years of related experience in stop loss, claims, or healthcare operations; equivalent combination of education and experience considered
  • Knowledge of medical terminology, CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes

Technical Skills:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret financial reports, legal documents, and stop loss contract terms
  • Experience working with claims databases or reimbursement tracking systems
  • Ability to apply mathematical and statistical reasoning to financial data and reimbursement calculations

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $22.65 - $25.00, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment: Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

Join as a Senior Power Systems Engineer and lead the delivery of power system generation, merchant transmission and load interconnection services across ERCOT. Operating with minimal supervision, the position manages complex technical studies, oversees interconnection processes and guides a team of power system engineers. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in load and generation interconnection, advanced modeling capabilities, and strong client-facing communication skills. This role is central to shaping interconnection strategy, ensuring high-quality technical analyses and supporting the growth of the organization’s power systems practice.

The role also includes responsibility for managing a small number of direct reports, supporting their performance and development, and ensuring effective utilization and achievement of applicable performance objectives.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Lead load and generation interconnection efforts within the ERCOT footprint, serving as the technical expert for energy resource (generator and load) interconnection processes
  • Identify optimal grid interconnection strategies based on system impacts and grid capacity
  • Create and validate PSS/E, PSCAD, and TSAT plant models for load, Solar PV, BESS, Wind and conventional projects.
  • Perform interconnection modeling, due diligence, analysis and specialized grid studies including Reactive Power Compensation, SSR, protection coordination, arc flash and TOV(plus).
  • Review technical work and deliverables prepared by other engineers, provide technical direction and feedback, and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and quality of work prior to delivery.
  • Support business development and prepare scopes of work/proposals.
  • Independently lead technical discussions with clients, utilities, and other external stakeholders related to assigned work, including presenting study results and recommendations, responding to RFIs, addressing technical questions, and discussing technical requirements and existing project scope.
  • Identify potential additional client needs or work opportunities and communicate them to the appropriate Manager or business leader. Provide technical input, assumptions, scope, and effort estimates in support of proposals and scope changes as needed.
  • Monitor the technical, schedule, budget, and client aspects of assigned work and appropriately escalate significant issues, risks, scope changes, or other matters requiring higher-level involvement.
  • Serve as a technical resource to other engineers and provide technical guidance, mentoring, and training to support the development of less experienced team members.
  • Manage a small number of direct reports, including setting performance expectations and goals, conducting regular one-on-one meetings and performance reviews, supporting professional development, providing ongoing feedback and coaching, approving time and time-off requests as applicable, and addressing performance issues with appropriate management support when needed.
  • Monitor the workload, utilization, and applicable performance KPIs of direct reports and take appropriate actions to support achievement of established objectives.
  • Participate in the interview and selection process for positions within the team, including providing input on candidates being considered for direct-report positions.
  • Contribute to improvements in technical processes, tools, scripts, methodologies, and study execution to support increased efficiency, quality, and consistency.
  • Represent EPE at technical meetings and conferences.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering; master's degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years professional experience as a Power Systems Engineer supporting generation, transmission and/or load interconnection
  • Well-versed in the interconnection process of ERCOT from the initial filing of the interconnection application through commercial operations; other ISOs area plus
  • PSCAD and PSS/E modeling experience, generation-focused (load modeling is a plus)
  • Hands-on ERCOT Model Quality Testing (MQT) experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently perform and lead complex engineering analyses, interpret results, develop technical solutions, and make sound technical recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply independent engineering judgment to complex or non-routine technical issues.
  • Ability to lead assigned tasks and smaller or standard projects while managing technical quality, schedule, budget, resource allocation, and efficient execution.
  • Ability to review technical work and deliverables prepared by other engineers and provide effective technical direction and feedback.
  • Experience leveraging AI and automation tools responsibly to improve quality, productivity and innovation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to independently communicate and present technical analyses, results, recommendations, and project requirements to clients, utilities, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Have high standards in producing quality reports ad products that he/she shall own with pride
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentoring, coaching, and development support to less experienced engineers.
  • Ability to effectively manage a small number of direct reports and support their performance, development, workload, utilization, and achievement of applicable performance objectives.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments, project responsibilities, and priorities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Collaborative attitude with the ability to work effectively across project teams and provide technical support beyond immediate assignments when needed.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and integrity when handling sensitive project, employee, client, and company information.

Lead the Change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

How we support you:

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you
  • Generous PTO and paid holidays
  • MyShare Employee Ownership Program
  • Work with industry leaders
  • 401K, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1)

Location: This position will be remote US

Travel: Occasional travel may be needed (10% or less)

In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing Release Management and Environment/System Administration functions within the Policy Administration System (PAS) program. You will lead and mentor a team of Release Managers and System Administrators, set standards for deployment and environment governance, and serve as the primary escalation point for release readiness, infrastructure stability, patch compliance, and SDLC adherence across all OIPA environments. This role reports to the Director of IT Application Development.


This is a remote / work-from-home position.


What You Will Do:


  • Manage, coach, and evaluate PAS Release Management and System Administration team members, including conducting performance appraisals and providing ongoing mentoring and professional development guidance.
  • Assign work, set priorities, and monitor workloads across both functional areas.
  • Lead project meetings with technical and business stakeholders and train team members on OIPA release and environment best practices.
  • Review and approve invoices for resources provided by external vendors.
  • Establish standards and guiding principles for the release management process across all strategic in-flight PAS initiatives.
  • Coordinate with enterprise change control processes and attend weekly production Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
  • Review and approve change control documentation for migrations to each environment, assign version tracking, and maintain a complete audit trail via the enterprise ticketing system.
  • Track production incidents and create required emergency change control documentation for off-cycle migrations; close incidents after verifying successful resolution.
  • Coordinate PAS configuration and BPM deployment activities, including IVS cross-track deployments and the copying of tables between environments.
  • Maintain the release calendar in partnership with Business and Technology leads for all major and minor release windows.
  • Define guidelines for assessing deployment readiness and coordinate post-deployment validation and verification testing.
  • Track release-related risks, issues, and dependencies across in-flight projects.
  • Maintain communications and distribution lists to coordinate releases across legacy and ancillary applications.
  • Provide direction to resources performing configuration migrations via Oracle Rules Palette (OIRP).
  • Manage PAS System Administration resources across multiple data centers and monitor OIPA Application and Database Servers to ensure optimal performance.
  • Review daily environment health checks and resolve performance or capacity concerns.
  • Coordinate database and application server tuning, including recommendations for clustering, CPU, memory, and thread pool configuration.
  • Coordinate new environment builds, complex deployments, migrations, and OIPA major and minor product upgrades.
  • Coordinate the application of Oracle Exa patches, YUM updates, OIPA base code updates, and OIRP updates.
  • Attend weekly vulnerability review sessions and coordinate timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities; act as the primary point of contact for PAS Information Security exceptions.
  • Review SSL certificate status and coordinate replacements prior to expiration.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Oracle ASR hardware monitoring, Service Express, and My Oracle Support access.
  • Maintain PAS and BPM ticket categories, resource assignments, and on-call resource listings in Cherwell.
  • Work closely with internal OIPA Configuration teams and Oracle Development to manage OIPA Service Requests.


What You Can Bring:


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in IT application development or operations roles.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a lead, supervisory, or management capacity.
  • Experience with OIPA Components Deployment with WebLogic.
  • Experience with Oracle Linux system administration and WebLogic administration.
  • Experience with Oracle System Administration Tools including OEM, Admin Server, and Data Guard.
  • Experience with OIPA Database and Application upgrades and OIPA Release Management.
  • Experience with database backup tools such as Rubrik and RMAN.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable a cross-functional technical team.
  • Strong understanding of IT SDLC processes and Agile project methodologies.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities under pressure while ensuring environments meet established SLAs.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and business audiences.
  • Proficiency with enterprise ticketing systems such as Cherwell or ServiceNow.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Insurance Policy Administration (OIPA) and Oracle Insurance Rules Palette (OIRP).
  • Experience with Oracle Exalogic and Exadata is a plus.
  • Experience with Oracle Admin Server and the OIPA nightly Cycle is a plus.
  • OIPA implementation experience for multiple clients is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Oracle IVS, Oracle SOA, MuleSoft, and BPM is a plus.
  • Knowledge of AWS and Oracle OCI cloud computing is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of insurance life and health products across individual, group, and worksite markets is a plus.

Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

  • Reliable and predictable attendance of your assigned shift.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

  • Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

  • Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Optimize interfaces for usability, accessibility and platform guidelines.

  • Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback.

  • Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work.

  • Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.

  • Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design.

  • Excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour and visual hierarchy.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Auto Layout

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • iOS Human Interface Guidelines

  • Material Design

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks mobile-first.

  • Obsesses over visual polish and interaction quality.

  • Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do.

  • Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

  • Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products.

  • Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding.

  • People who design without considering real user behaviour.

  • Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

  • Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers.

  • Candidates who cannot explain the rationale behind their design decisions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the US. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the US.

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Portfolio review

  2. Practical design task (if applicable)

  3. Role-specific interview

  4. CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

About Endpoints News Media Company, LLC.

Endpoints News, founded in 2016, is a leading B2B media company with a clear mission: to deliver the best news product in biopharma and become an essential read for industry leaders globally. Now a part of the Financial Times family, Endpoints News continues to grow its reach, delivering breaking news, in-depth analysis, and live journalism.

Endpoints News fosters a culture of benevolent collaboration, pragmatic results-oriented approaches, and direct communication. These values shape how we work across teams, solve problems, and execute with impact, ensuring alignment with our mission and goals.

The Opportunity

Endpoints News is hiring a biotech journalist to cover how advanced therapies and drug technologies turn into the medical products of tomorrow.

The right candidate is business-savvy and science-minded. In this job, you’ll write about clinical trials, startups and the business of science. You’ll be responsible for helping set the agenda on a busy beat of breaking news, while also looking for enterprising ideas that can put major trends in context.

The exact role will be shaped by the candidate. We seek to hire talent first and build coverage around it. But prior experience covering the industry is a must, as is a strong list of sources and ideas for how to cover the beat. Successful candidates will have four to eight years of experience and clips that show strong writing as well as scoops of news and thought.

This role will report to one of our deputy editors and collaborate closely with the rest of the newsroom. This is a work-from-anywhere role, and candidates must be confident operating independently in a digital-first environment. The team works an East Coast schedule.

Endpoints is an ambitious, award-winning specialty news publication that covers the world of biopharma, healthcare and technology, chronicling the people, money, companies and regulations that drive those industries.


Compensation

Total compensation opportunity: $75,000-$100,000 plus annual bonus.

It's important to note that salary information provided in job descriptions is subject to change and may be dependent on a variety of factors such as location, experience, and qualifications. The salary range provided is meant to give potential applicants an idea of the compensation they can expect, but it is not a guarantee of a specific salary. Actual salary may vary based on individual factors and negotiations. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on salary history or other personal factors.

Why Join Us?

🌍 Work From Anywhere!

👥 Positive, Supportive, and Collaborative Work Culture.

🌴 Paid Time Off: Generous PTO is offered annually, plus 12 company holidays and 2 floating holidays!

🩺Medical Insurance: Endpoints pays 70% of premiums for employee, spouse, and/or dependents.

🦷Fully-Paid Benefits for Employees: Dental and Vision insurance, Short-Term and Long Term Disability, Basic Life and AD&D Insurance - 1x salary up to $150,000, and our Employee Assistance Program.

📁 Additional Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident Insurance: Offered through Guardian.

🩹 MDLIVE: See a doctor, mental health professional, nutritionist, or dermatologist on your time and online!

👪 Family Leave: All employees are eligible for fully-paid Primary or Secondary Caregiver Leave for the birth or adoption of a child.

💪 Paid Volunteer Days: Provides employees with the opportunity to engage in community service & volunteer activities.

💸 401K: Endpoints will match 100% of the first 3% of an employee's contribution; followed by 50% match of the next 2%.

💻 Equipment Provided: Laptop, monitor, and additional equipment needs.

📱WFH Stipend: $75 per month to cover the costs of working from home.

🏠 Home Office Stipend: $500 annually to help you create your dream office.

💊 Benefits Marketplace: We’ve partnered with Bennie to provide discounted products for employees such as other insurances, family planning & support, behavioral health, wellness, pet insurance, and financial wellness.

💼 MetLife Legal: We’ve partnered with MetLife Legal Services to provide a discounted legal plan for our employees.

Endpoints News is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse backgrounds and thoughts and welcome everyone to apply for employment with us. We are committed to fostering an environment that is inclusive, transparent, and collaborative. Mutual respect is central to how Endpoints News operates, and we believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills. We embrace our differences and know that we are stronger working together.

Build the compliance function of a new securities business from the outset, with direct access to the board and a real say in how the product is designed.

raw.description:
Location: e123 is a Work From Anywhere company based in southern California with an entirely remote workforce from all over the US.

Why join e123?

e123 is transforming the distribution of health insurance in the United States while creating a new insurtech category. e123 helps businesses manage the complex world of health insurance distribution. We handle $3B in annual premium billings through a network of nearly 400,000 agents. We deliver a single, easy to use platform for clients to distribute and market insurance and benefits products at all levels. We are rapidly expanding our product suite to to address major pain points for enterprise carrier and distribution customers in this market vertical.

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to fix a broken system, making it easier and more reliable for millions of people to protect themselves against the unexpected by enabling insurance providers to better match individuals with the right health insurance solutions. This in turn enables accelerating growth for our clients. At e123, we deliver a powerful, widely-used core SaaS product in a premier position central to our industry, and our team knows as much as anyone about the complexities of the United States healthcare insurance distribution network.

Job Summary

The Financial Analyst is e123’s core FP&A analyst and will prepare the monthly management, board, and lender reporting that leadership and our investors rely on. You will sit inside Finance, reporting to the Senior Director of Finance, and working with the Senior Accountant. You will also own e123’s planning and forecasting cycle, including the annual budget, monthly reforecasts, and the multi-year financial model. You will conduct other analyses as needed in support of various business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Management, Board, and Lender reporting

  • Build the monthly management reporting package: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, ARR, and other SaaSs KPIs
  • Draft variance analysis commentary that explains changes over time and differences to plan
  • Prepare the quarterly board package and recurring reporting for our private equity sponsor
  • Prepare the supporting schedules for the monthly lender compliance certificate and quarterly covenant calculations

Forecasting and budgeting

  • Maintain the monthly re-forecast and the multi-year financial model, including detailed revenue forecasting
  • Track forecast-to-actual accuracy and explain the drivers of misses
  • Run the annual budget process with department heads, planning headcount and non-headcount expenses and conducting analysis as needed to support the plan

Analysis and decision support

  • Build ad hoc analyses for leadership, such as pricing scenarios, ROI cases for new investments, unit economics, and customer profitability
  • Research historical financial data to answer questions from leadership, the board, and outside parties
  • Conduct client-specific performance analysis in support of Account Management or other business needs
  • Support the 409A valuation, audit, tax, and PE data requests with schedules and analysis

Process and tools

  • Build reliable, agile, and auditable financial models
  • Identify manual, recurring reporting work and automate it using Excel or AI-assisted tools

Qualifications & Experience

Required:

  • 3-5 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or related role
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • Strong accounting foundation: understanding of GAAP and 3-statement financial integration
  • Excellent ability to quickly and deeply understand the business context underpinning the financial analysis, and connect the analysis back to this business context
  • Advanced Excel skills, including building clean, auditable, driver-based models and monthly reporting files from scratch
  • Experience conducting analysis with AI-assisted tools
  • Experience working with a planning tool like Drivetrain, Cube, etc.
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Highly organized and able to execute work with rapid response as needed

Preferred:

  • Experience at a private equity-backed or venture-backed company, preparing board, investor, or lender reporting
  • Exposure to SaaS metrics: ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, and bookings
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online, a billing platform, or a CRM such as HubSpot
  • SQL, BI tools, or experience automating reporting with scripts or AI-assisted tools
  • Experience working on a lean team, owning recurring deliverables on a deadline

About Perle

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. With experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Perle is hiring a freelance transcriptionist fluent in Sesotho for a remote transcription role. This is a paid contract position open to qualified contributors worldwide.

1. Role Overview

You will transcribe 2-speaker, channel-separated audio recordings in Sesotho. Each file has two clearly separated speakers. Your job is to produce a clean, accurate, sequentially ordered transcript with speaker labels and timestamps.

2. What You Will Do

  • Listen to 2-speaker audio recordings in Sesotho
  • Type out what each speaker says, accurately and in full
  • Label each speaker turn as Speaker 1 or Speaker 2, matching the audio channel
  • Add timestamps at the start of each speaker turn (format: HH:MM:SS)
  • Ensure transcripts are sequential with no unexplained gaps

3. Requirements

  • Native or near-native fluency in Sesotho (spoken and written)
  • Strong written Sesotho — accurate spelling, punctuation, and grammar
  • Ability to work independently and meet daily output targets
  • Access to a computer with a stable internet connection
  • Availability for at least 4 hours per day
  • Prior transcription experience is a plus but not required — all contributors must pass a qualification test

4. Quality Standard

  • Word Error Rate (WER) of 5% or less on all delivered transcripts
  • Zero speaker label errors — Speaker 1 must always correspond to Channel 1
  • Transcripts reviewed on a rolling basis; feedback provided promptly
  • Files that do not meet the quality threshold will be returned for correction

5. Project Details

Detail

Information

Language required

Sesotho

Project type

Audio transcription (manual)

Commitment

~at least 4 hours/day (remote, flexible schedule)

Start date

As soon as qualified — rolling onboarding

6. How to Apply

Submit your application through the Perle platform. You will be asked to complete a short qualification task — a 5-minute audio transcription sample in Sesotho. Applicants who pass the qualification test will be onboarded immediately and assigned to production tasks.

Perle is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Why join Doit

Build the compliance function of a new securities business from the outset, with direct access to the board and a real say in how the product is designed.

raw.excerpt: About usWe see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility.
raw.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a skilled Senior High-Speed Analog/RF System Architect at Black Semiconductor to own the analog, RF, and high-speed SerDes architecture of the CMOS SoCs powering our graphene photonic interconnect technology. You will define the electrical architecture at the boundary between electronics and photonics, including PLLs, TIAs, drivers, equalizers, ADC/DACs, and CDRs, translating system-level performance targets into scalable and manufacturable SoC solutions.

Working closely with the Photonics Circuit Designer, Package Electrical/SI Architect, analog design, and digital/EIC teams, you will drive architecture decisions across the complete electrical-to-optical channel. You will own system-level trade-offs across bandwidth, power, reach, cost, and manufacturability, while engaging directly with customers and product teams to translate deployment requirements into architectures and evaluate the impact and ROI of future features.

To join our team, you should be excited to

  • Own the analog/RF and high-speed SerDes architecture for optical transceiver SoCs, defining solutions for drivers, TIAs, equalizers, ADC/DACs, PLLs, and CDRs targeting 112G/224G+ PAM4 and next-generation interconnects.

  • Define and maintain Analog Product Requirement Specifications (PRS) per product, including architecture, verification plans, and performance, power, and area (PPA) estimates.

  • Drive system-level link budget closure across the complete electrical-to-optical channel, accounting for transmitter impairments, channel loss, reflection, crosstalk, and receiver noise for Integrated Graphene Photonics (IGP)-enabled optical links.

  • Own the Analog IP roadmap, aligning architecture direction with technology capabilities, EDA flows, and contractor/external design partnerships.

  • Partner with the Photonics Circuit Designer, Package Electrical/SI Architect, and SoC design teams to reconcile analog/RF architecture decisions with PIC layout, package electrical constraints, and system requirements.

  • Define Customer Requirement Documents (CRDs) for customer engagements and collaborate directly with customers to ensure architecture choices meet deployment requirements.

  • Lead SoC concept and feasibility studies by exploring architectural options, driving system-level trade-offs, recommending final architectures, and supporting product teams in modeling use cases and ROI for candidate architectural features.

  • Track and incorporate relevant interconnect standards, including PCIe, UCIe, CXL, and emerging die-to-die and optical standards, into architecture decisions.

Your Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 8+ years of relevant experience (or equivalent demonstrated impact).

  • Proven experience owning high-speed SerDes and analog/mixed-signal system architectures, including PLLs, TIAs, drivers, equalizers, ADC/DACs, and CDRs for 56G/112G/224G+ PAM4 systems in advanced CMOS technologies (FinFET/GAA).

  • Strong system-level architecture experience, including taking heterogeneous SoCs from concept through architecture sign-off, ideally involving advanced packaging technologies such as 2.5D/3D integration.

  • Expertise in electrical-optical link budget analysis, including transmitter impairments, channel loss, reflection, crosstalk, and receiver noise considerations.

  • Hands-on experience characterizing high-speed analog/RF designs using modern lab equipment, including BERTs, high-speed oscilloscopes, and VNAs.

  • Strong understanding of high-speed interconnect standards, including PCIe, UCIe, and CXL, and their influence on analog/RF architecture decisions.

  • Ability to collaborate across domains, working closely with photonic circuit designers, package engineers, digital designers, product teams, and customers to resolve complex architecture trade-offs.

  • Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to translate customer deployment requirements into architecture specifications and communicate complex design decisions across technical and business stakeholders.

  • Experience with analog/mixed-signal design, system modeling, and architecture tools, including Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, MATLAB/Simulink, Keysight ADS, HSPICE, Ansys HFSS/SIwave, Python-based modeling and automation workflows, and high-speed lab measurement environments.

  • Experience with silicon photonics or electro-optic interface design, analog design team leadership, system-level SerDes/optical link modeling, or semiconductor product development including reliability and qualification requirements is considered a plus.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

If your application results in an employment relationship, your Applicant Data will be transferred to our personnel records and processed in accordance with applicable legal requirements; otherwise, your Applicant Data will be retained for up to six (6) months after completion of the recruitment process. Read more about our privacy policy here.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship full product features across frontend, backend, APIs and databases.

  • Create customer and internal workflows for onboarding, accounts, payments, rewards, travel, FX, support automation, KYC and risk.

  • Turn ambiguous product problems into working systems with clean UX and reliable backend logic.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI engineers to launch fast and improve after release.

  • Build internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and help teams operate at scale.

  • Own your work beyond release: monitor, debug, learn and improve.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong full stack engineering experience with real shipped products.

  • Comfortable across frontend, backend, APIs, databases and production debugging.

  • Good frontend execution using React, Next.js, Vue or similar modern stack.

  • Good backend fundamentals around APIs, data models, authentication, integrations and reliability.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify messy workflows.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and own outcomes end-to-end.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer.

  • People who need complete specs before starting.

  • Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact.

  • Candidates who avoid production support.

  • People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Korea. We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in Korea.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
