Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details


Job Description

Ce poste s'inscrit dans le cadre des services d'accompagnement des patients et des professionnels de santé ainsi que des services de commercialisation pharmaceutique proposés par Cencora au Canada, par l'intermédiaire de notre division Innomar Strategies.


This role is in support of Cencora's patient and provider support and pharma commercialization services in Canada marketed through our Innomar Strategies business.


Responsabilités:

  • Coordonner et gérer tous les aspects requis afin d'obtenir la couverture de médicaments d'ordonnance pour les patients;
  • Coordonner les cas avec les compagnies d'assurance, les cabinets de médecins et les professionnels de la santé afin de maximiser les solutions de remboursement;
  • Coordonner les documents, les soumissions et tous les documents connexes aux compagnies d'assurance, programmes de financement public/fédéral;
  • Mettre en œuvre le test de moyens financiers tel que requis dans le but de maximiser la couverture des médicaments d'ordonnance du patient
  • Coordonner les processus de pharmacie requis lorsque le financement a été obtenu; et
  • Acquérir une connaissance approfondie des mécanismes de financement public/privé et fédéral.
  • Responsable de signaler tous les événements indésirables aux départements concernés.
  • Le/la spécialiste de remboursement sera également affecté(e) à d'autres fonctions et tâches au besoin de temps à autre.

Responsibilities:

  • Daily and ongoing communication with Program Manager / Associate Program Manager for new and existing projects;
  • Demonstrate in depth knowledge of rare disease program offerings, including the pathophysiology of the disease/product, therapeutic area, disease process, and mechanism of action; and how to apply rare disease SOPs;
  • Exhibit in depth knowledge of public/private and federal funding mechanisms as well as Rare Disease funding bodies (US and Canada).
  • Coordinate cases with physician and healthcare professionals in order to prepare submission meeting specific specifications/criteria set by public/private payers.
  • Coordinate and manage all aspects required in order to obtain prescription drug coverage for patients;
  • Coordinate cases with insurance companies, physician’s offices and healthcare professionals in order to maximize reimbursement solutions;
  • Navigate through the complex lobbying process to obtain prescription drug coverage and reimbursement for these life-saving and costly medications;
  • Coordinate documents, submissions and all related paperwork to insurance companies, public/federal funding programs;
  • Implement Financial Means Test as required in an effort to maximize patient’s prescription drug coverage
  • Coordinate pharmacy processes required once funding has been obtained;
  • Responsible to report all Adverse Events to the assigned units/departments;
  • The Reimbursement Specialist will also be assigned other duties and tasks as required from time to time.

Niveau d’éducation:


  • Éducation post-secondaire ou l'équivalent dans une discipline connexe;

Expérience:


  • Minimum de 1 ans d'expérience en service à la clientèle, dans un environnement de bureau;
  • Solide maîtrise des applications Microsoft (Outlook, Word, Excel);
  • Manières professionnelles/courtoises/efficaces au téléphone;
  • Capacité éprouvée à organiser le temps, fixer les priorités et à accomplir de multiples tâches afin de respecter les diverses échéances de travail concurrentes;
  • Le candidat doit avoir de solides compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles;
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et dans un environnement d'équipe;
  • Souci du détail;
  • Expérience dans l'industrie des soins de santé, des produits pharmaceutiques ou de l'assurance est un atout; et
  • Le bilinguisme, français/anglais est requis.

Compétences et Connaissances:


  • Connaissance avancée de l'industrie de la distribution pharmaceutique
  • Connaissance pratique du système automatisé d'opération d'entrepôt
  • Solide sens des affaires et sens financier
  • Compétences analytiques et mathématiques solides
  • Capacité à communiquer efficacement oralement et par écrit
  • Compétences interpersonnelles et de leadership efficaces
  • Sens de l'organisation; souci du détail
  • Capacité à respecter systématiquement les échéances
  • Excellentes aptitudes de résolution de problèmes; Capacité éprouvée à résoudre les problèmes avec efficacité et efficience
  • Excellentes aptitudes de présentation
  • Connaissance de Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint et d'autres programmes Office

Work Experience:


  • Minimum of 1 years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, insurance or healthcare-related industries;
  • Previous experience in reimbursement and Knowledge of public, private and federal reimbursement is required;
  • Minimum of one(1) years’ experience in a Customer Service setting;
  • Professional / courteous / efficient telephone manner;
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft applications (Outlook, Word, Excel);
  • Proven ability to organize time, set priorities and multi-task in order to meet various competing work deadlines;
  • Candidate must have strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate with patients in a healthcare setting on extremely sensitive topics;
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment;
  • Attention to detail; and
  • Bilingualism, French/English is required.

Skills and Knowledge:


  • Advanced knowledge of pharmaceutical, or insurance industry
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Strong analytical and mathematical skills
  • Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing
  • Effective interpersonal and leadership skills
  • Effective organizational skills; attention to detail
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Excellent problem-solving skills; ability to resolve issues effectively and efficiently

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more.

Full time

Equal Employment Opportunity

Cencora is committed to providing equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or membership in any other class protected by federal, state or local law.

The company’s continued success depends on the full and effective utilization of qualified individuals. Therefore, harassment is prohibited and all matters related to recruiting, training, compensation, benefits, promotions and transfers comply with equal opportunity principles and are non-discriminatory.

Cencora is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the employment process which are consistent with legal requirements. If you wish to request an accommodation while seeking employment, please call 888.692.2272 or email . We will make accommodation determinations on a request-by-request basis. Messages and emails regarding anything other than accommodations requests will not be returned

Accessibility Policy

Cencora is committed to fair and accessible employment practices. When requested, Cencora will accommodate people with disabilities during the recruitment, assessment and hiring processes and during employment.

raw.excerpt: At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen.
raw.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Team Leader

__

Job Summary

In this role, you will execute service and maintenance activities in accordance with ABB standards, quality requirements, and safety procedures. You'll work closely with customers across a variety of industrial sectors, delivering technical knowledge, diagnosing complex electrical system issues, and ensuring the highest levels of customer satisfaction.

Our Team Dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

What’s in it for you?

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

Your Role and Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact.

Work model: Remote with travel to customer sites.

Proposed

  • Deliver field service activities across Low Voltage (LV) and / or Medium Voltage (MV) switchgear and related equipment, with specialized skills in either area.
  • Carry out preventative maintenance, installations, commissioning, retrofitting and equipment replacements, providing technical advice and support to customers.
  • Ensuring all service operations strictly comply with ABB technical procedures, commercial guidelines, and health, safety, and environmental standards.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues through effective troubleshooting and analysis, recommending corrective and preventative actions to provide a first-time fix wherever possible.
  • Conducting technical training sessions for customers both on-site and at ABB facilities.
  • Work closely with customers to understand their operational challenges and identify opportunities to improve equipment performance, reliability and efficiency.
  • Prepare service documentation, technical reports, material lists and equipment required to deliver service activities effectively and to uphold quality assurance and operational traceability
  • Promote health, safety, and quality standards by ensuring all work follows ABB procedures and industry best practices.

Qualifications for the Role

  • Electrical Trade Certificate or Electrical engineering degree or equivalent with relevant practical experience in power systems and/or electrical distribution.
  • 5+ years’ experience in field service, including installation and maintenance of LV/MV switchgear.
  • Demonstrated experience in testing and commissioning ABB and/or third-party switchgear and electrical equipment.
  • Solid technical knowledge of LV/MV systems, including protection relays, fault-finding, diagnostics and testing methods.
  • Good understanding of health, safety and environmental standards, including risk assessments and safe working practices.
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate service activities and build strong customer relationships.
  • Proficient using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside general IT systems.
  • Full and clean driving licence with willingness to travel

Benefits

As part of our dedication to our employees, ABB Ireland offers an attractive array of benefits which include

  • Competitive Salary
  • Private Medical Allowance for Yourself and Family
  • Commercial Van
  • Generous Bonus Scheme
  • Competitive Contributory Pension Scheme
  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan
  • Open Job Market (Internal Mobility Opportunities, Mentorships & Access To Projects Globally)
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Generous Employee Referral Scheme
  • 25 Days Annual Leave Plus Bank Holidays

More about us

Join ABB Ireland and be part of a dynamic team that is making a real difference. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment where you can grow your career, develop your skills, and contribute to impactful work that matters. Together, we are building a sustainable future for generations to come.

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. #RunWhatRunstheWorld.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's Android Software Engineer.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
Compensation:$65,000 to $75,000 based on experience and qualifications

Position Summary

The Digital Content Producer develops, writes, edits and optimizes compelling, audience-focused content that advances Rosalind Franklin University's brand, supports institutional priorities and strengthens engagement across digital communications channels. As a member of the Communications team within the Division of Marketing and Brand Management, the position translates complex academic programs, research, institutional initiatives and university priorities into clear, accessible and engaging content.

Reporting to the Director of Content Strategy, the Digital Content Producer collaborates with communications, marketing and digital team members, as well as academic and administrative partners, to produce content for the university website, landing pages, digital campaigns and other institutional communications. The position brings expertise in digital storytelling, web writing, search engine optimization (SEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), user experience and accessibility to ensure content is accurate, consistent, discoverable and aligned with the university's brand and editorial standards.

Our generous benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision plans; paid parental leave; short term and long-term disability plans; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; and a 403(b)-retirement plan which includes a 8% employer contribution after 2 years of service. RFUMS is committed to employee wellbeing and work-life balance. Full-time staff are eligible for 3 weeks of vacation/ personal leave, 15 sick days, and 9 paid holidays, paid winter break, plus two floating holidays.

This is a fully remote position.

Who We Are

Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science (RFU) is a graduate health sciences university committed to serving the population through the interprofessional education of health and biomedical professionals and the discovery of knowledge dedicated to improving wellness. The university embodies the spirit of inquiry and excellence modeled by its namesake Dr. Rosalind Franklin, whose Photo 51 was crucial to solving the structure of DNA.

Today, the university’s 6 colleges continue Dr. Franklin’s legacy through rigorous academics, pioneering research, and innovative community service. Our unique interprofessional education model allows students to learn from and with each other in a variety of settings, including our simulation labs, the student-led Interprofessional Community Clinic, and through partnerships with area hospitals and clinics. RFU is a national leader in interprofessional research and practices, and is nationally recognized for its research in areas including neuroscience, brain-related diseases, inherited disorders, proteomics, cancer cell biology and immunology, cardiac resuscitation, and gait and balance.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Content Development, Storytelling and Digital User Experience

  • Develop, write, edit and optimize compelling, audience-focused content for the university website, academic programs, institutional news, digital campaigns, landing pages and other communications channels.
  • Translate complex academic programs, research, institutional initiatives and university priorities into clear, engaging and accessible content for diverse audiences.
  • Collaborate with Communications team members to identify, develop and produce stories that advance the university's brand, institutional priorities, enrollment and engagement goals.
  • Work with faculty, staff, students and other subject-matter experts to gather information, conduct interviews and develop accurate, compelling content.
  • Apply user experience (UX) writing principles to improve website content, navigation, calls to action and other digital experiences.
  • Adapt and repurpose content for multiple communications channels, audiences and formats.
  • Ensure content aligns with the university's brand identity, editorial standards, and established voice and tone, including AP style and university editorial guidelines.

Digital Content Quality, Accessibility and Governance

  • Develop and maintain accurate, accessible and user-centered content across the university's digital platforms.
  • Apply established content governance standards, editorial workflows and quality assurance practices to ensure consistency, accuracy and usability.
  • Conduct content audits, inventories and reviews to identify outdated, redundant, inconsistent or ineffective content and recommend improvements.
  • Support the university's website renovation, content migration and ongoing digital initiatives through content development, editing, auditing and quality assurance.
  • Apply digital accessibility best practices and applicable standards, including Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA, to assigned content.
  • Collaborate with the Digital Experience team to support effective content organization, information architecture, metadata and navigation.
  • Work with campus content contributors to ensure information remains current, accurate and aligned with university standards.

Search Engine Optimization, Answer Engine Optimization and Content Performance

  • Apply search engine optimization (SEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) best practices to improve the visibility, discoverability and relevance of university content across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.
  • Conduct keyword research and identify audience search behaviors, questions and information needs to inform content development.
  • Structure and optimize digital content for search engines, AI-generated answers and user experience, including headings, metadata, internal linking and clear, authoritative information.
  • Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), search performance data and other analytics tools to evaluate content effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Monitor engagement, user behavior and conversion activity to inform content updates and optimization.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Content Strategy and Digital Experience team to implement SEO and AEO recommendations and support ongoing content improvement.
  • Use emerging technologies, including generative AI and AI-assisted content tools, responsibly to support content research, development and optimization in accordance with university policies and editorial standards.

Collaboration and Content Coordination

  • Collaborate with Communications team members to plan, develop and coordinate content that supports institutional priorities and integrated communications initiatives.
  • Work closely with designers and digital team members to develop cohesive, engaging communications.
  • Build collaborative relationships with academic and administrative units to gather information, develop content and support institutional storytelling.
  • Coordinate assigned content projects, production schedules, reviews and approvals to ensure accuracy, quality and timely delivery.
  • Provide editorial guidance and constructive feedback to campus content contributors to maintain consistency with university standards.
  • Support the Director of Content Strategy in implementing content priorities, editorial workflows and cross-channel communications initiatives.

Conditions of Employment

  • Must achieve satisfactory results from a background check.

Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, English, or a related field.
  • Three to five years of progressively responsible professional experience in digital content strategy, web content development, copy editing, UX writing, or a related area.
  • Demonstrated experience developing clear, concise, user-centered content for websites and other digital channels.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex information into accessible and engaging content for diverse audiences.
  • Working knowledge of digital accessibility principles and applicable standards, including Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA, as they relate to web content, headings, links, navigation, forms, and multimedia.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders and manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a complex organization.
  • Strong writing, editing, proofreading, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Expertise in digital content development, web writing, UX writing and digital storytelling.
  • Expertise in user-centered digital experiences, information architecture and principles of web usability.
  • Knowledge of search engine optimization (SEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), content performance measurement and digital analytics.
  • Knowledge of digital accessibility standards and best practices.
  • Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, agentic AI and emerging AI-assisted content development and optimization tools.
  • Excellent writing, editing, proofreading and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt content for different audiences, channels and levels of subject-matter expertise.
  • Ability to interpret analytics and translate data into practical content recommendations and improvements.
  • Ability to apply established editorial standards, content governance practices and workflows while maintaining productive relationships with campus content contributors.
  • Strong project management, organizational, collaboration and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities and work effectively in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and translate technical or specialized information into engaging, accessible content for diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in higher education, nonprofit, government, or another complex, decentralized organization.
  • Experience working with an enterprise-level content management system such as Drupal, WordPress, or Adobe Experience Manager.
  • Experience using Google Analytics 4 and other digital analytics platforms to evaluate content and user behavior.
  • Experience with SEO and related tools such as SEMrush, Moz, or Siteimprove.
  • Experience conducting website content audits, inventories, migrations, or large-scale redesign initiatives.
  • Experience developing content governance frameworks, editorial standards, workflows, or training programs.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams involving marketing and communications, IT, web development, academic units, and administrative departments.

raw.description:
Summary
We are seeking an experienced Accessibility Testing Expert to provide advanced expertise in evaluating the accessibility and usability of digital products, applications, and content.
This role serves as a subject matter expert in digital accessibility and is responsible for conducting comprehensive accessibility assessments, identifying barriers that may impact people with disabilities, evaluating conformance with applicable accessibility standards, and providing clear, actionable guidance to support remediation.

The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in WCAG standards, assistive technologies, manual accessibility testing, accessibility testing tools, and accessible design and development practices. This individual must be able to evaluate accessibility beyond automated testing, understand the real-world impact of accessibility barriers, and translate complex technical findings into practical recommendations for technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

The Accessibility Testing Expert will collaborate with developers, designers, quality assurance teams, product owners, vendors, and organizational stakeholders to integrate accessibility throughout the digital product lifecycle and support informed accessibility and compliance decisions.


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead comprehensive accessibility evaluations of websites, applications, and digital content to assess conformance with WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 standards and identify barriers that may impact users with disabilities..
  • This is a Remote (work from home) position.
  • Apply automated testing tools, assistive technologies, manual testing techniques, code inspection, and accessibility tree analysis to identify and validate accessibility barriers.
  • Assess the severity, user impact, and accessibility risk of identified issues to support remediation prioritization and informed decision-making.
  • Collaborate with developers, designers, QA, and product teams to provide clear remediation guidance, accessibility acceptance criteria, and recommendations that support accessible implementation.
  • Validate accessibility remediation across iterative development cycles and confirm that identified barriers have been effectively resolved.
  • Participate proactively in design and development reviews to identify accessibility risks early and embed accessibility throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Review VPATs and Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) and identify accessibility risks or gaps requiring further evaluation.
  • Communicate accessibility findings, risks, priorities, and recommended remediation strategies to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Support accessibility evaluations during procurement, implementation, and third-party vendor reviews.
  • Conduct accessibility evaluations of electronic documents, including PDF, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, against applicable WCAG, Section 508, and PDF/UA requirements.
  • Validate document remediation to ensure content is correctly structured and usable with screen readers, keyboard navigation, and other assistive technologies.
  • Contribute to organizational accessibility standards, testing methodologies, procedures, reusable best practices, training, and awareness initiatives.

Required Skills
  • Advanced knowledge of WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 Level A and AA, Section 508, applicable ADA accessibility requirements, and familiarity with WCAG 2.0 for legacy content.
  • Extensive hands-on experience testing with JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, and TalkBack.
  • Proficiency with Axe DevTools, Accessibility Insights, WAVE, Color Contrast Analyzer, Acrobat Pro, and other accessibility testing tools.
  • Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, semantic HTML, ARIA, WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices, and browser accessibility trees.
  • Expertise in comprehensive manual and automated accessibility testing, including keyboard, screen reader, focus management, contrast, zoom/reflow, text spacing, and dynamic-content testing.
  • Experience evaluating and remediating PDF, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel documents, including knowledge of PDF/UA.
  • Experience reviewing VPATs/ACRs and assessing accessibility risk.
  • Ability to map findings accurately to WCAG criteria, severity, and user impact and provide actionable remediation guidance.
  • Strong analytical, technical documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to explain accessibility requirements to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple accessibility assessments and collaborate effectively across development, design, QA, product, and business teams.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field preferred.
  • At least 8 years of professional experience performing accessibility testing and audits in web and mobile applications.
  • Trusted Tester Certification issued by DHS or a similar certification in accessibility is preferred.

raw.excerpt: About the jobThe SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center.
raw.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

About Refold AI

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. Our buyers don't come from paid ads — they come from the room. Practice leaders, integration architects, and product executives who trust each other more than they trust a vendor. This seat owns that room.

What you’ll do

  • Run the company operating rhythm: weekly leadership sync, quarterly goals, board and investor updates. You own the agenda and the follow-through.

  • Own the model and the metrics. Build and maintain the financial model, ARR and pipeline reporting, and the data pack for fundraising.

  • Take ambiguous 0 to 1 projects end to end: new market analysis, pricing changes, vendor and tooling decisions, a partnership that needs an owner.

  • Scale how we hire. Partner with the recruiting team on process, scorecards, onboarding, and the people policies we do not have yet.

  • Be the CEO’s proxy in the room when they cannot be, and the person who tells them what they are missing.

  • Write the memo. Decisions at Refold get made on clear written thinking, and you will author a lot of it.

What we’re looking for

  • 4 to 7 years in strategy consulting (ideally McKinsey, BCG, or Bain), investment banking, startup operations, or as a founder, with at least 2 years inside an early-stage company.

  • Strategic finance fluency. You can build a model from scratch, defend every assumption, and turn it into a board slide.

  • A track record of owning cross-functional projects nobody else would take, and shipping them.

  • An on-the-ground network in San Francisco. You know founders, operators, investors, and candidates here, and you can open doors for the company on day one.

  • Based in San Francisco. This is an in-office role, 5 days a week.

  • Bonus points

  • Tier-1 consulting background (McKinsey, BCG, Bain) with time spent on growth-stage tech or SaaS clients.

  • You have been a company’s first Chief of Staff or first BizOps hire.

  • You have supported a Series A or Series B raise from the inside.

  • You use AI tools in your own work daily and can show what you automated.

Why do you want to work here?

  • Impact: Fast-growing seed-stage company ($6.5M from Eniac Ventures & Tidal Ventures) with early Fortune 500-scale deployments and real, quantified customer outcomes

  • Speed: A blank calendar and a real budget, with founder-level authority to decide where we show up and why

  • Ownership: Cutting-edge AI solving a high-value enterprise problem nobody has cracked — backed by technical founders building a next-generation infrastructure platform

We welcome teammates of all backgrounds and don't discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. If you're excited by our mission, you belong here.

Job Description: Estimator and Takeoffs Specialist

Position Overview

The Estimator and Takeoffs Specialist is responsible for preparing accurate quantity takeoffs and cost estimates from architectural plans and specifications. This role requires advanced proficiency in PlanSwift software, strong analytical skills, and meticulous attention to detail. The specialist will collaborate with project managers, engineers, and contractors to ensure bids and budgets are based on precise calculations. Work hours are fixed at 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review architectural drawings, blueprints, and specifications to perform detailed takeoffs.
  • Quantify materials, labor, and equipment requirements with precision.
  • Utilize PlanSwift to generate digital takeoffs and maintain accurate records.
  • Prepare cost estimates and support bid submissions.
  • Identify discrepancies or omissions in plans and communicate findings promptly.
  • Collaborate with project teams to validate takeoff accuracy and provide input for budgets.
  • Maintain organized documentation and ensure compliance with company standards.
  • Use Google Sheets for data entry, reporting, and project tracking.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in estimation and plan takeoffs.
  • Proven expertise in PlanSwift software.

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in reading and interpreting architectural plans.
  • Advanced knowledge of construction materials, methods, and industry standards.
  • Competence in Google Sheets and other data management tools.
  • Ability to prepare accurate cost estimates and detailed reports.

Job Description:

Product Marketing Manager Principal (PMM)

Vertex is seeking a Product Marketing Manager Principal (PMM) to own the end-to-end market story for one of its product domains: from the market signal that shapes the roadmap, through positioning and launch, to the argument a seller makes in the room. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the VP, Global Product Marketing. The work is judgment-driven determining what Vertex says about a domain, to whom, and why, then moving Product, Sales, and Marketing to act on it. Year-one success is defined by a positioning document that serves as the single source of truth for Product, Sales, and Marketing; a competitive position visible in win/loss outcomes; and at least one product launch delivered on date with verified commercial readiness.

  • Own positioning and messaging for the domain, covering every claim and the proof behind it, authored so demand, creative, and enablement teams can build from it without interpretation.
  • Author the core sales narrative for the domain: the argument a seller makes in the room.
  • Translate win/loss data, customer conversations, competitive movement, and regulatory change into a roadmap-ready point of view Product can act on.
  • Own the go-to-market plan for every launch, from segment and offer decisions through to commercial readiness evidence for Sales, Partners, and Support on day one; run the launch team to the date.
  • Turn competitive intelligence into a winning position against incumbents and AI-native entrants; supply the claims and proof behind battlecards.
  • Carry the domain into partner and ERP routes to market; embed domain proof within joint narratives and conduct a channel conflict check in every launch plan.
  • Contribute to pricing and packaging decisions with commercial evidence; represent the domain with analysts, customers, and partners, and at internal leadership forums.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product marketing or an adjacent discipline, with the majority in enterprise B2B software sold through long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Demonstrated ownership of positioning for a product line, including messaging the field adopted and used in live deals, and the judgment to determine what to say and what to omit.
  • Experience marketing a product embedded in a customer's system of record and reaching part of its market through partners: ERP, procurement, billing, payments, or similar.
  • Proficiency working from pipeline data, deal cycles, and win/loss analysis; demonstrated ability to connect messaging decisions to win-rate outcomes.
  • Proven ability to get fluent quickly in a regulated, technical, detail-heavy domain.
  • Ability to write and present complex ideas with clarity, adapting the message for a tax or finance buyer, a seller in an active deal, or a leadership audience.
  • Active use of AI tools across core work, including research, synthesis, drafting, and competitive monitoring, with the ability to hold a competitive position against AI-native entrants in live deal situations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in indirect tax or another regulated category where rules change on a government's timetable.
  • Equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience accepted in lieu of a formal degree.

COMMENTS:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.



Vertex Values: Together We Win


We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.


Play to Win or We Don't Play — If we choose to do something, we're choosing to do it because we plan to win. That mindset raises our bar on product quality, customer outcomes, and how we show up for one another.


Work As a Team, Putting the Customer At the Core — Our customers are our true north. Whatever your role, ask: how will this help a customer succeed today? We earn trust through outcomes, not promises.


Achieve Excellence With Integrity, Speed, and Agility — The market isn't slowing down. We'll move faster, adapt quickly, and never compromise on doing things the right way — for teammates, customers, and partners.


Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value.


Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.

Pay Transparency Statement:

Annual Salary Range: kr818,100.00 - kr1,063,600.00

Pay Basis: Monthly

The posted range reflects the anticipated hiring range for successful candidates at the time of hire, based on relevant job‑related skills, experience, geographic location, and business needs. Base pay offered to new hires may vary within the posted range depending on individual qualifications and market considerations.

Employees may experience additional compensation growth over time through performance‑based increases, expanded responsibilities, role progression, or internal career opportunities, in accordance with company policies and local practices.


In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for other elements of Vertex’s total compensation package, which may include participation in the Vertex Bonus Plan (VOB), a role‑specific sales commission or bonus, and/or equity grants, where applicable.

Job Description:

Senior Director, External Communications (Solventum)

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As Senior Director, External Communications, you will set Solventum’s external communications strategy and work with leaders, teams and partners around the world to execute against it. We are seeking an experienced, results-driven individual to lead our company’s PR, media relations, social media and thought leadership efforts. As a key member of the Communications & Brand leadership team, reporting to the SVP, Chief Communications and Brand Officer, this role will be instrumental in helping to shape our external brand, protecting our reputation and driving our messaging to a variety of stakeholders, including media, regulators, customers and the public. This position will require a strategic thinker with hands-on expertise in executing external communications initiatives while navigating the complexities of a growing, global organization. The Senior Director will oversee the development and implementation of external communications strategies, working closely with executive leadership to ensure consistent, clear and impactful messaging. This position blends strategic oversight with day-to-day operational management, offering the opportunity to shape the external voice of a dynamic and evolving company.

Here, you will make an impact by:

External Communications Strategy Development:

  • Lead the creation and execution of a comprehensive global external communications strategy in collaboration with marketing and commercial teams that elevates Solventum’s brand, enhances its reputation and supports business objectives across earned media, social media and external influence.
  • Create a clear, differentiated corporate narrative and unified external voice that brings Solventum’s purpose and innovation to life for media, regulators, customers, healthcare professionals, patients and industry partners.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders, including marketing, legal, HR, investor relations and leadership, to align on key external communications initiatives and ensure consistency across all touchpoints.

Media Relations & Public Relations:

  • Build and nurture relationships with journalists, media outlets and relevant creators across healthcare, science, business, technology and consumer media to generate sustained, high-impact earned coverage and protect Solventum’s reputation.
  • Oversee the development and distribution of press releases, media statements and other external facing media materials.
  • Proactively create communications-led moments and campaigns around Solventum’s products, research, partnerships, data and point of view that earn attention, create conversation and build brand awareness. Manage media inquiries with sound judgment to mitigate reputational risk.
  • Partner closely with investor relations on corporate and financial communications strategy, financial media outreach and related activity.

Social Media & Digital Communications:

  • Lead Solventum’s social media strategy across multiple platforms, building a distinctive voice and point of view that engages audiences, while remaining aligned with business objectives.
  • Develop content and campaigns that resonate with target audiences, including thought leadership articles, blog posts, social media updates and videos.
  • Oversee community management and social listening, monitoring the conversations shaping healthcare and Solventum’s reputation, identifying emerging opportunities and responding to inquiries or concerns in a timely and professional manner.

Crisis Communications & Issues Management:

  • Lead the external communications strategy during crises or reputational issues, ensuring timely, transparent and empathetic communication to the public, media, employees, regulators and other key stakeholders. This includes incidents affecting the company’s operations, reputation or public perception.
  • Partner with investor relations and participate in the review process for issues tied to financial health, investor confidence or governance, with target audiences of investors, analysts, shareholders, etc.
  • Partner with internal leadership, investor relations, legal and HR teams to develop crisis communication plans and protocols, ensuring that the company is prepared for potential issues.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, providing counsel on sensitive situations that could impact the company’s external image.

Team Leadership & Development:

  • Lead and mentor a high-performing external communications team that moves quickly, maintains exceptional standards and measures success by impact—not activity. Provide guidance, professional development and a collaborative, results-driven environment.
  • Oversee the development of external communications talent, ensuring team members have the tools and support they need to succeed in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

Agency Oversight and Management:

  • Lead and manage relationships with external agencies, ensuring alignment with overall brand strategy, objectives and key messaging.
  • Shape Solventum’s external influence strategy through conferences, speaking opportunities, awards and industry relationships that advance the company’s narrative, reputation and business priorities.
  • Ensure that the company’s external communications align with the interests of key stakeholders while advancing the company’s strategic goals.
  • Partner with executives and executive communications team members to develop distinctive external voices and thought leadership through speaking opportunities, media engagements, social content, opinion pieces and major events. Capture each leader’s authentic voice and advise on when and how to engage in public conversations.
  • Partner with investor relations on quarterly earnings, investor days, analyst meetings, financial communications, etc.

Operational Excellence & Reporting:

  • Implement systems and processes to measure external communications beyond impressions and press hits, connecting media coverage, social engagement and other KPIs to brand awareness, consideration, reputation, advocacy and business outcomes. Provide regular reports and use insights to refine strategy.
  • Ensure the company is leveraging the latest tools and technologies to optimize external communications efforts, including media monitoring, social media listening and analytics.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in communications, public relations, journalism, business or a related field AND (twelve) 12 years of experience in corporate communications.

OR

  • High School Diploma/GED AND (sixteen) 16 years of experience in corporate communications.

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

  • 5 years of experience in a senior leadership role, ideally in PR, media relations, or corporate communications.
  • Experience in managing external communications strategies for a global organization.
  • Expertise in handling crisis communications and managing complex public relations challenges.
  • Experience in building and leading a high-performing external communications team in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Exceptional storytelling, writing and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information and business strategies into clear, memorable narratives for diverse audiences.
  • Experience in media relationships and a track record of generating sustained, high-impact earned coverage through ideas, trends, data, people and relevant moments—not just announcements. An understanding of what journalists and audiences care about and how brands earn attention.
  • Expertise in social media and modern communications channels, including creators, influencers, podcasts, events, communities and emerging platforms, with strong audience instincts and the ability to create content people notice, care about, share and remember.
  • Experience working in industries such as medtech, healthcare or highly regulated sectors is a plus.
  • Experience overseeing external agencies, ensuring timely execution and strong results.
  • Leadership skills, including team development, cross-functional collaboration and influencing senior executives, with the judgment to challenge and advise leaders and help them develop distinctive, authentic public voices.
  • Experience measuring communications impact and connecting the work to brand awareness, consideration, reputation, advocacy and business outcomes.
  • A global mindset, with the ability to adapt communications strategies to different cultural contexts and regions.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented leader who thrives in a dynamic, evolving environment, with high standards, strong editorial judgment, intellectual curiosity, low ego and a bias toward action.

Work location: Remote in USA

Travel: May include up to 30% domestic/international

Relocation Assistance: May not be authorized

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Supporting Your Well-being

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

raw.description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, & designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, & AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, & Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, & a fast-growing global community.

About The Role

Most of Kestra's pipeline starts with someone who already found us: a demo request, a Kestra Cloud trial, a webinar sign-up, or an engineer from the open-source community who wants to talk to Sales. We sell Kestra Enterprise, self-hosted in the customer's own infrastructure, & Kestra Cloud, our fully managed edition.

We're looking for our first inbound Sales Development Representative in Europe to turn that interest into qualified pipeline. You follow up on every inbound lead, qualify it honestly against our Ideal Customer Profile, & pass it to the right Account Executive.

You work closely with our Lead Growth Engineering team, who build & run the systems that capture, score, & route our inbound demand. Together you decide which signals matter, tighten routing, & make sure no good lead goes cold. You report to the Head of Sales & hand off daily to our European Account Executives.

Your buyers are technical: data engineers, platform engineers, & the leaders who run those teams. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be curious enough to learn the product & talk credibly about orchestration.

What You'll Own

Follow-up

  • Every inbound lead routed to you: demo & contact requests, Kestra Cloud trials & sign-ups, event & webinar follow-ups, & community hand-raises.

  • Speed to lead: a first personal reply within 1 business hour, & at least 4 follow-up attempts over 7 business days before closing a lead out.

  • Messages that read like a person wrote them: short, relevant, & clearly based on what the prospect actually asked for.

Qualification

  • Qualification calls that uncover the prospect's use case, current tooling (Airflow, cron, homegrown scripts, cloud-native schedulers), team, & timeline.

  • Honest qualification against our Ideal Customer Profile: a real business pain Kestra solves, & someone involved in evaluating or buying.

  • Clean disqualification: leads that don't fit go back to nurture with a clear reason, so the team learns which sources bring good demand.

Hand-off to Account Executives

  • Routing each qualified lead to the right Account Executive by territory & segment, or to the account owner when there is already an open opportunity or an existing customer.

  • First meetings that actually happen, with a written brief so the prospect never has to repeat themselves.

  • Accurate records in HubSpot: every lead, call, & disqualification reason logged, so forecasts & routing can be trusted.

Partnership with Lead Growth Engineering

  • Feedback on lead quality by source, campaign, & persona, so scoring & routing keep improving.

  • Shaping the inbound playbook: qualification questions, templates, objection handling, & the hand-off checklist.

  • Spotting gaps early: leads routed to the wrong place, signals the system misses, or steps that slow a prospect down.

What We're Looking For

  • 1+ year as an SDR, BDR, or in a similar customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS or software company.

  • Inbound experience: you have worked a lead queue against response-time targets & know how to qualify without losing a good prospect.

  • Curiosity about technical products: you enjoy learning how software works & can hold a credible conversation with an engineer.

  • Clear, concise writing: your emails get answered.

  • CRM discipline: you keep records accurate because you know other people rely on them.

  • Fluent in English; a second European language (especially French or German) is a plus.

raw.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

Homh is ServiceTitan's new consumer brand connecting homeowners with vetted, high-quality contractors for home service and improvement projects. We're building a look-and-book experience: homeowners request a service, get matched with top contractors (often same-day, within a 3-4 hour window), and can easily rebook people they trust. This is a 0-to-1 build inside an established company, a startup with ServiceTitan's resources behind it.

We're looking for a seasoned engineering leader to run a small, senior-heavy team, including staff engineers, shipping this product from the ground up. You'll need technical depth across mobile, backend, and frontend to make and defend architecture calls, and review hard design decisions. You'll work directly alongside the exec team, product, and design.


What you'll do:

  • Drive technical direction across the full stack, mobile app, backend services, and frontend, including geolocation-based matching logic and other core product systems
  • Set the bar on architecture and design decisions as a credible technical counterpart to a team that includes staff-level engineers
  • Own and communicate the team's roadmap, balancing fast iteration (this is early-stage, trial and error is expected) against a coherent long-term technical vision
  • Partner closely with B2B engineering teams to ensure Homh's architecture works well with ServiceTitan's existing contractor-side tools and systems
  • Champion AI tooling across the team's workflow, pushing for leverage in how the team builds, researches, and ships
  • Take accountability for delivery through discovery and implementation, including technical tradeoffs under ambiguity
  • Set development plans, run 1:1s, and assess progress, with an emphasis on technical mentorship and unblocking over process-building
  • Build team cohesion, celebrating wins and solving problems together
  • Partner with Recruiting on interviewing, sourcing, and screening to help build out the team
  • Communicate clearly and directly with engineers, product, design, and leadership in a fast-moving, cross-functional org

What you'll bring:

  • 7+ years managing software engineering teams, including experience managing senior or staff-level engineers directly
  • Hands-on technical background as a senior or staff engineer designing APIs, systems, and abstractions used by other engineers
  • Ability to go deep enough on architecture across frontend, backend, and mobile to make credible calls with a team that doesn't need hand-holding technically
  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration on an early-stage product without settled processes
  • Strong communication and technical writing skills

Ideal candidates also have experience with:

  • Our stack: React, TypeScript, C#/.NET, Next.js, Tailwind, Vite, Azure (Container Apps, Functions, Service Bus), PostgreSQL, Snowflake, LangGraph, MCP, Kafka
  • Consumer-facing (B2C) product experience, ideally 0-to-1 or early-stage
  • Mobile app development
  • Managing a team through a period of headcount growth (this role is expected to grow into an org with M1s reporting up as the team expands)
  • B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws.
