raw.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, serving patients across oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our Data & AI organization builds the enterprise data platform and AI systems that turn clinical, genomic, and operational data into products that improve patient care and accelerate the business.

We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Data Engineer to work directly with internal business stakeholders and domain teams to design, build, and deploy high-impact analytics and AI solutions. Reporting directly to the Data & AI Engineering Tech Lead, you will act as the technical point-of-contact and primary builder for stakeholder initiatives, translating business needs into production-ready data and AI products. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you will write production code, develop semantic layers, and implement agentic workflows and LLM pipelines.

As a forward deployed engineer, you are AI-native by design—using AI coding harnesses and agentic tooling to accelerate development, testing, and documentation. You will partner closely with the Tech Lead to adopt foundational architecture patterns while rapidly delivering tailored solutions in a regulated environment where data quality, lineage, and privacy are essential.

The ideal candidate combines strong engineering fundamentals with a customer-obsessed mindset, pragmatic problem-solving, and the communication skills needed to bridge complex technical solutions and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Stakeholder Engagement & Technical Ownership

  • Embed closely with business stakeholders to deeply understand their data and AI requirements, serving as their primary technical advisor and engineer.
  • Run launch discovery and impact analysis for new assays or products (models, views, dashboards touched), documented in Confluence and Jira.
  • Translate complex business challenges into clear technical specs and deliverable milestones, partnering with the Tech Lead to align with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Adhere to established engineering standards for pipeline design, data modeling, testing, version control (Git/GitLab branching, MRs, PRs) and CI/CD, ensuring deployed solutions are reliable and maintainable.

Hands-On Solutions Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformations on our cloud data platform, sourcing clinical, laboratory, operational, and commercial data to serve business analytics.
  • Develop governed data models and semantic layers that power self-service analytics, dashboards, and data products (e.g., Patient 360, Provider 360, Test 360) for business teams.
  • Develop AI solutions to enable business productivity and automation through use of agentic workflows, RAG/retrieval, and LLM pipelines (extraction/classification)
  • Write production-grade SQL and Python; contribute to shared frameworks, templates, and tooling that let the team deliver new analytics solutions faster.
  • Ensure the data layer supports performant, trustworthy analytics and LLM querying ; lead root-cause analysis on complex data issues and drive durable fixes.

AI-Native Execution & Continuous Learning

  • Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic tools daily across the full software development lifecycle to accelerate solution development and deployment speed.
  • Apply AI-native engineering best practices—such as prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and automated testing—to maximize individual output while upholding high quality.
  • Collaborate with the Tech Lead and peer engineers through code reviews, technical sharing, and feedback to continually refine forward deployed engineering practices.

Data Quality, Reliability & Compliance

  • Implement data quality checks, contracts, lineage, and monitoring so that downstream consumers can trust the data by default.
  • Own operational excellence for the team’s solutions: SLAs, incident response, and cost efficiency of compute and storage.
  • Ensure pipelines handling PHI and genomic data meet HIPAA, CLIA, and internal security and governance requirements, including access controls, auditability, and retention.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work directly with business stakeholders across functions to understand their questions, shape analytics solutions to their needs, and communicate technical tradeoffs in plain language.
  • Collaborate with core platform and AI teams under the guidance of the Tech Lead to build solutions on enterprise foundations rather than isolated silos.
  • Represent the team in architecture forums, data governance discussions, and tool evaluations.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of data or software engineering experience, with a track record of forward-deployed or customer-facing engineering roles delivering analytics and AI solutions directly to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to partner directly with non-technical business partners, translate technical concepts clearly, and manage project deliverables.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools in daily engineering work, with a point of view on how to use them well.
  • Expert-level SQL and strong Python, with a track record of shipping and operating production data pipelines and data models at scale.
  • Deep experience with a modern cloud data warehouse and cloud infrastructure (Snowflake/AWS preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with transformation frameworks (dbt or equivalent) and workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar).
  • 1-2 years of practical background building with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent) alongside managed AI services and model routing gateways like Snowflake Cortex, AWS Bedrock, and foundational APIs.
  • Strong grounding in analytical data modeling (dimensional or domain-driven), semantic layers, data quality engineering, and CI/CD for data systems.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated domain handling PHI or other sensitive data.
  • Experience with lab data management systems, lab informatics systems, bioinformatics pipelines is a plus
  • Snowflake experience, including performance tuning, cost management, and features such as dynamic tables, Snowpark, or Cortex.
  • Sigma experience, or experience with comparable BI and semantic-layer tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI), and an understanding of how to design data models for self-service consumption.
  • Working knowledge of Power BI, including dataset design, data source connectivity, and troubleshooting dashboards when upstream data changes.
  • Experience building and operating agentic or LLM-based workflows within the data development lifecycle.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and data observability tooling.
  • Experience integrating with Salesforce, laboratory information systems, or EHR data sources.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$125,000—$156,300 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Senior Project Manager

Full-time (40 hours per week), Remote (overlap with CET business hours required)

About Us

At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company

You will be joining a small, AI-first digital publisher that runs evidence-based review and comparison websites, monetised through affiliate partnerships. The team is focused on an independent publishing project in the prop trading space — reading the fine print on evaluation challenges, costs, drawdown limits, payout conditions and trading rules so that traders know exactly what they are signing up for. Editorial standards are strict: ratings can't be bought, every claim is checked against primary sources, and accuracy comes before volume.

The Role

As Senior Project Manager, you will run the project end to end — owning day-to-day delivery and content quality across research, content, SEO, website improvements and commercial initiatives. This is a full-ownership role: goals are agreed with you, and how you get there is your call. You choose the methods, the tools and the order of work, and you decide whether a piece meets the editorial standard or goes back for revision.

You'll work closely with the CEO, who sets business priorities, alongside a specialist SEO advisor, a developer and a Social Media & Community Manager whose output you hold to the same editorial standard. The project is AI-first: research, briefs, drafts, data checks and reporting start in AI tools by default, and you are the human who answers for every published word. This role is ideal for an independent, results-driven operator who measures themselves on outcomes and keeps going until the page ranks and the numbers move.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run delivery: keep a clear backlog and weekly priorities, manage capacity, clear blockers and follow every piece of work through to an agreed standard

  • Hold the quality line — review drafts written by people or models for clarity, structure, accuracy, originality and usefulness, fix the simple things and give precise revision feedback on the rest

  • Turn SEO recommendations into briefs, content improvements, internal links and page updates, and check each finished page meets search intent and the brief

  • Design, document and maintain the AI workflows behind research, drafting, updates and quality checks, with a human check wherever errors could reach a reader

  • Keep content current — manage research, drafting, revisions and WordPress preparation for reviews, comparisons, guides and offers, and make sure verified changes to fees, rules or payout terms reach every affected page and table

  • Translate requirements into clear developer tickets with acceptance criteria, coordinate priorities and test delivered changes on staging

  • Check finished pages for source-data consistency, links and desktop/mobile presentation, then coordinate release

  • Align research and publishing dates with the social content calendar and review social output for accuracy and consistency

  • Report on delivery, content quality, traffic, search and commercial performance using GA4, Search Console and affiliate reports, and act on what you find

Ideal Candidate

  • Proven record of running SEO projects — you owned the plan and the delivery and can show before-and-after numbers from Search Console, GA4 or Ahrefs

  • AI-first way of working: you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools daily for research, drafting, analysis and quality checks, know where their output fails, and own the final result

  • Track record of owning delivery on content-led digital projects, with clear examples of personal responsibility and results

  • Strong editorial judgment and excellent written English — you can spot weak, repetitive or unsupported content, explain what needs fixing and improve it

  • Working SEO knowledge across search intent, content structure, internal linking and content updates; confident with WordPress, spreadsheets, source data, GA4 and Search Console

  • Experience managing contributors, deadlines and handoffs in a PM tool such as Notion, ClickUp or Asana, plus enough technical understanding to brief a developer and test changes against requirements

  • Familiarity with prop trading concepts (evaluations, drawdown, payout conditions, trading restrictions), or evidence that you learn technical niches quickly

  • Able to work with consistent overlap with CET business hours

  • Independent thinker who forms their own view, pushes back when the evidence says otherwise, and starts on the next problem without waiting to be asked

  • High achiever who is comfortable in a role that isn't a 9-to-5 and measures success in results

Nice to Have

  • Experience in affiliate publishing

  • GitHub workflows

  • Data reconciliation

  • Workflow automation

Tools & Stack

Claude, ChatGPT, WordPress, GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, affiliate reporting, Notion / ClickUp / Asana, spreadsheets

Join Our Team Be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where your technical skills and product instincts can make a real impact. We offer competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, and a supportive remote work culture. Apply now and take the next step in your career.

At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they happen to be born in.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We are looking for a Director, Visual Design who is part visionary, part practitioner, and entirely uncompromising when it comes to quality. This is an embedded, high-impact role with an operational split of hands-on visual craft and team leadership. You will act as an autonomous "player-coach" who leads by doing—defining the work directly in working files, setting the bar for excellence, and solving complex design challenges in real time. Your experience and hands on skill will play a crucial role in leading craft teams to world-class work as well as guiding clients and partners toward successful outcomes. Your fluency in the world of design across brand, motion, and digital helps you lead large scale, integrated teams towards successful outcomes.

You will fully own major digital workstreams, product detail pages (PDPs), and large-scale interactive launches. Operating comfortably within established, robust design systems, you will translate high-level narratives and brand strategy into compelling, innovative web experiences. You are a tastemaker and strategic problem solver capable of navigating ambiguity, prioritizing deadlines, and fostering deep creative trust.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own Hands-On Craft: Lead from the front by sketching, designing, prototyping, and polishing in Figma. Define industry-leading visual standards, typography, narrative storytelling, and interaction design for high-traffic web pages and product launches.
  • Lead Within Design Systems: Creatively push boundaries while maintaining strict consistency and rigor within complex, multi-tiered design systems and digital component libraries.
  • Drive Embedded Client Collaboration: Flourish in a highly embedded, fast-paced environment. Collaborate directly and transparently with client creative leads through live co-creation, sprint-based ideation, shared working files, and regular standups.
  • Navigate Ambiguity & Prioritize: Operate with high autonomy, translating high-level, ambiguous briefs into clear, phased deliverables under strict launch timelines.
  • Team Guidance & Mentorship: Provide creative direction and support to the team. Elevate junior and mid-level talent through actionable feedback, design critiques, and structured mentorship.
  • Manage Deadlines & Production: Partner with project and client leadership to ensure workstreams exceed aesthetic standards while delivering strictly on schedule.

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 8+ years of proven experience in digital visual design, web design, and interactive work for world-class brands, including 2+ years in a design leadership or lead practitioner capacity.
  • Exceptional Portfolio: A proven track record demonstrating world-class digital craft, narrative web design, PDPs/e-commerce experiences, interactive storytelling, and sophisticated typographic hierarchy.
  • Design Systems Mastery: Deep expertise designing within and scaling robust, multi-brand digital design systems in Figma (auto-layout, nested components, design tokens, responsive variants).
  • Embedded Client Fluency: Extensive experience presenting work and working directly with enterprise client creative leads and cross-functional partners.
  • Agility & Autonomous Ownership: High comfort level working in rapid sprint cycles, live collaborative files, and fast-moving launch cadences.
  • Time Zone Flexibility: Ability to work core hours aligned with Pacific Time (PT) (candidates located across US time zones welcome, provided they can flex to PT hours when needed).
  • Tools: Mastery of Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; familiarity with modern collaboration tools (Slack, Google Workspace).

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401K plan, plus matching
  • PTO
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

raw.description:
Build our future together

We’re looking for a hands-on leader to own the platforms that give our security teams visibility across the enterprise. You’ll lead a team supporting the Security Monitoring function. The team builds and maintains the Splunk log ingestion pipeline, RBAC, searches, reporting, and dashboards. It also supports the systems that feed our Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platform, which correlates it all.

This is a player-coach role, roughly 50/50 technical work and team leadership. You’ll lead a mixed team of employees and vendor staff and act as the escalation point when monitoring platforms or security incidents need senior attention. You’ll also explain complex technical topics clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

At Regeneron, our SIEM has grown tremendously, and we support business functions beyond security, including Finance, IT, Manufacturing, and Research. We cautiously push the boundaries of the product, evaluating cutting-edge technology in our test environment and deploying capabilities that reshape how Regeneron and other users think about a SIEM.


Where and When
Location: 100% remote (US East Coast time zone).

Team: 4-10 employees and vendor resources.


Discover your role

Platform health and operations

  • Own the availability, performance, and data quality of the SIEM and log collection infrastructure.
  • Drive the team and platform toward zero skipped searches, zero unplanned downtime, and no logging errors that affect monitoring.
  • Forecast data growth and manage ingest and compute within licensed capacity.
  • Provide metrics, performance reports, and dashboards to leadership.
  • Apply ITIL practices to incident, request, and change management.

Vendor and service management

  • Manage vendor relationships and contracts, including SLA definition, performance reviews, and service review meetings.
  • Direct a mixed team of employees and external resources, assigning work in line with shared strategy and goals.
  • Lead responses to audit requests related to monitoring systems and controls.

Incident escalation and response

  • Escalate incidents and enhancement requests to internal owners and vendors as needed.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders during cybersecurity incidents.
  • Support triage and escalation of security events and threats, using SIEM data to assist investigations.

Improvement and engineering partnership

  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define requirements and set feasible timelines.
  • Deliver projects that improve security event collection, detection, analysis, correlation, and response.
  • Advise infrastructure and security teams on configuration changes that improve event collection.
  • Track emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and analytics for security monitoring, and recommend where they add value.

Team management

  • Align the team with common short- and long-term goals.
  • Make sure the team has the tools it needs, and remove blockers.
  • Give team members frequent performance feedback, so they know they’re valued and where they can improve.
  • Build a trusting environment where it’s safe to ask for support and to suggest better ways of working. 1 Team; 1 Platform.

This role requires:

  • 10+ years in IT, including 5+ years in security operations or as a monitoring system manager or lead engineer.
  • 5+ years leading or directing technical teams, including contractor staff.
  • Expert-level Splunk experience; Splunk Certified Consultant or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
  • Advanced Red Hat Linux skills.
  • Advanced scripting in Python and Bash.
  • Advanced rsyslog configuration experience.
  • Experience writing technical requirements and working with engineering teams to deliver them.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to build relationships and present to audiences from engineers to executives.
  • Sound judgment in weighing security controls against technical and administrative standards and making risk-appropriate tradeoffs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Splunk Enterprise Security and SOC operations, including triaging security incidents and threats.
  • Experience overseeing managed service delivery and vendor SLAs.
  • Experience with security telemetry sources such as syslog, Universal Forwarder and heavy forwarder deployments, Splunk DB Connect, and the VMware Data Collection Node.
  • Familiarity with modern detection technologies (EDR/XDR) and cloud security logging.
  • Experience in a large, complex organization working across multiple business lines.

Why Join Us

  • We share a common goal: to build the best Security Monitoring platform and SIEM, and to be trusted advisors to our partners on the Security team and across the business. We work regularly with Splunk product management to shape cutting-edge tools such as Ingest Processor, UEBA, Dashboard Studio, and SOAR, helping the platform become what Regeneron and the industry need.
  • 1 Team; 1 Platform; 1 Common Goal. Our sub-goals are ambitious, and we’re still working toward them: no skipped searches, no downtime, and no errors that affect logging or monitoring.
  • Our team members are regularly invited to speak at industry conferences.
  • Health, Family, Work (in that order).

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit . For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.


Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.


As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. raw.excerpt: Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English.
raw.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.

About the project

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.

About the roles

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience& skillsets.

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November

  • Languages: Japanese

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

  • Project compensation: varies depends on different programming language

  • Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

  1. Language test: short exercises in the target language.

  1. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

  1. Financial Onboarding & Role placement:complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

  1. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

Job Reference: #L1-CC1

Why Join Welo Data?

✨ Limitless Flexibility 

Project-based opportunities that fit your availability. Choose when and how much you want to contribute—fully remote, with complete autonomy. 
🌱 Limitless Growth 
Optional access to AI and Large Language Model workshops designed specifically for professionals like you. No coding required—just your expertise. 
🌍 Limitless Support 
Be part of a global contributor community with responsive guidance and support. 
💡 Real Impact 
Apply your expertise in the Legal field to influence the AI systems shaping the future of your industry—while collaborating with data professionals and expanding your skills.

How to Apply?

Apply now by answering a few quick questions to join our database and become part of our growing community.

About Welo Data

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.
At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

raw.excerpt: About Auris Practice Solutions, LLC Auris Practice Solutions is a remote audiology services company that partners with hearing care practices and ENT groups across the country.
raw.description:
About Auris Practice Solutions, LLC

Auris Practice Solutions is a remote audiology services company that partners with hearing care practices and ENT groups across the country. Through the MaestroAuD® and MaestroFusion® product lines, Auris delivers clinical capacity and practice support that allow partner practices to serve more patients. Our team of remote audiologists and hearing care providers works in a growing number of states, and our operations must keep pace with that growth.

Schedule: Part-time, 15 to 20 hours per week

Location: Remote (United States)

Classification: W-2 Part-Time, Hourly (Non-Exempt)

Compensation: $28 - $35 per hour, commensurate with experience

Reports to: Strategic Operations Manager

Position Summary

The Business Operations Administrator manages core business operations for Auris, working closely with the Strategic Operations Manager and the Managing Members. This individual manages monthly customer invoicing in QuickBooks, administers partner agreements once a practice has decided to move forward, supports the partner launch team, coordinates onboarding and offboarding, and maintains Auris registrations in the states where its people work. The position supports the business side of the company and collaborates with the clinical team and other departments. The role suits a highly organized, detail-driven professional who works independently, handles confidential information with discretion, and takes ownership of deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

Operations Coordination Prepare and finalize business correspondence, agreements, and internal documents.

  • Track operational action items and deadlines and follow up to keep open items moving.
  • Coordinate scheduling for partner, vendor, and internal meetings as requested.
  • Maintain organized digital filing for finance, contracts, HR, and compliance records.

Bookkeeping and Customer Invoicing

  • Prepare and send monthly invoices to partner practices in QuickBooks Online.
  • Confirm that all consumables used during the month are added to each partner practice monthly invoice.
  • Manage hearing aid fees due from partner practices to Auris, and confirm each fee is invoiced and collected.
  • Track accounts receivable and follow up on past-due balances.
  • Record transactions, process vendor bills, and reconcile bank and credit card accounts monthly.
  • Collect W-9s from contractors and vendors, prepare year-end 1099 filings, and provide records to the outside CPA.

Partner Contract Administration

  • Prepare partner agreements, schedules, and Business Associate Agreements from approved templates once a practice has decided to move forward.
  • Manage the exchange of drafts and revisions with the practice, track open items, and escalate substantive changes to the Managing Members.
  • Route final agreements for signature, file executed copies, and notify the launch team that the agreement is complete.
  • Maintain a contract tracker with effective dates, renewal dates, and notice deadlines.

Partner Launch Support

  • Complete assigned business-side launch tasks for new partner practices, including agreement completion, billing setup, and partner account records.
  • Collect partner information and documents required for contracting and invoicing, and track business launch checklist items to completion.

Onboarding, Offboarding, and HR Administration

  • Coordinate administrative onboarding and offboarding steps for employees and contractors, including agreements, equipment shipment and recovery, and system access requests.
  • Update the professional liability carrier roster for provider additions and separations.
  • Maintain confidential personnel and contractor files, and prepare employment verification letters.

State Registration and Compliance

  • Register Auris as a foreign entity when a remote employee resides in a new state, and establish state withholding and unemployment insurance accounts.
  • Maintain a compliance calendar of annual reports, registered agent renewals, and business license deadlines, and file on time.

Qualifications Required

  • Three or more years of experience in business operations, bookkeeping, or office management, preferably in a small or remote company.
  • Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online, including reconciliations and invoicing.
  • Experience with contract administration and electronic signature platforms.
  • Familiarity with state business registration and state tax account setup.
  • Strong organization, accuracy, and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines independently.
  • Proven discretion with confidential employee, financial, and health-related information.
  • Clear, professional written communication.

Preferred

  • Experience in a healthcare organization and familiarity with HIPAA.
  • Experience with DocuSign, Rippling, and Microsoft 365.
  • QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position. The individual must maintain a private, secure workspace with reliable high-speed internet and be available during standard business hours on a consistent weekly schedule. Hours may increase during partner launches and year-end close.

How to Apply

Submit your resume with 2-3 references, and a brief cover letter describing relevant operations, bookkeeping, and contract administration experience via the link above.

Auris Practice Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
En collaboration avec le Directeur, Planification de la gestion des revenus, la personne titulaire du poste est responsable de la performance des revenus du segment groupes. Elle dirige l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre des stratégies de tarification et de gestion de l’inventaire afin d’équilibrer la demande groupes et individuelle, de maximiser les revenus du réseau et d’assurer une contribution optimale. Elle mobilise une équipe d’analystes et travaille en étroite collaboration avec plusieurs partenaires afin d’améliorer la rentabilité, la précision des prévisions et la prise de décisions commerciales.

Responsabilités:

Leadership d’équipe:

  • Encadrer, mobiliser et développer une équipe d’analystes en gestion des revenus groupes.
  • Traduire la stratégie établie par la direction en actions concrètes et en assurer l’exécution.
  • Assurer l’atteinte des objectifs de revenus, de contribution, de conversion, de matérialisation et de précision des prévisions.
  • Offrir du coaching, de la rétroaction et des occasions de développement afin de renforcer les capacités analytiques, commerciales et décisionnelles de l’équipe.
  • Gérer la performance, la charge de travail et l’allocation des ressources, particulièrement durant les périodes de pointe.
  • Favoriser une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration, d’amélioration continue et de remise en question constructive.

Stratégie et optimisation des revenus groupes:

  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de tarification, d’allocation d’inventaire et d’acceptation des groupes selon les marchés, les saisons et les dates de départ.
  • Équilibrer la demande groupes et individuelle afin de maximiser les revenus et la contribution tout en préservant la capacité nécessaire pour répondre à la demande future à forte valeur.
  • Évaluer les opportunités d’affaires complexes ou stratégiques à l’aide d’analyses de contribution, de prévisions de la demande et d’évaluations d’impact réseau.
  • Définir et maintenir les lignes directrices analytiques encadrant l’évaluation des demandes groupes.
  • Suivre la performance du segment groupes, identifier les écarts et assurer la mise en place rapide des actions correctives requises.
  • Diriger les activités de planification saisonnière et de prévision, puis présenter les résultats, risques et recommandations à la direction.

Coordination interéquipes et alignement commercial:

  • Assurer l’alignement des équipes des ventes et des autres partenaires commerciaux sur les stratégies, priorités et critères décisionnels de la gestion des revenus groupes.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de tarification, de planification réseau, de marketing et des technologies afin d’optimiser la performance du segment groupes.
  • Évaluer et remettre en question de façon constructive les demandes commerciales en fonction de leur impact sur les revenus, la contribution et le réseau.
  • Maintenir à jour les conditions de vente groupes et les lignes directrices décisionnelles en partenariat avec les équipes de ventes.
  • Surveiller les tendances du marché, les mouvements de la concurrence et l’évolution des habitudes de réservation afin de soutenir la prise de décision.
  • Identifier et piloter des améliorations aux processus de cotation, de réservation et de gestion des groupes.

Outils, systèmes et amélioration continue:

  • Agir à titre d’expert.e fonctionnel.le du système GPS ainsi que des outils et processus de gestion des revenus groupes.
  • Valider et calibrer les paramètres des systèmes afin d’assurer la cohérence des stratégies mises en œuvre.
  • Définir les besoins d’affaires, prioriser les améliorations et coordonner les essais d’acceptation utilisateurs.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles visant à assurer la qualité des données, la performance des systèmes et la pertinence des recommandations automatisées.
  • Identifier et mettre en œuvre des occasions d’automatisation des activités d’analyse, de cotation et de production de rapports.
  • Favoriser l’adoption de nouveaux outils, méthodes de travail et pratiques novatrices au sein de l’équipe.

  • Diplôme universitaire en administration des affaires, en économie, en mathématiques, en ingénierie ou dans une discipline connexe.

  • Minimum de cinq (5) ans d’expérience en gestion des revenus, en tarification, en analytique d’affaires ou dans un domaine analytique connexe. Expérience en gestion d’employé.e.s, de projets ou d’initiatives interfonctionnelles.

  • Une expérience dans les secteurs de l’aviation, du voyage, de l’hôtellerie ou du transport constitue un atout. Une expérience en gestion des revenus groupes, en ventes groupes, en tarification ou en optimisation de l’inventaire est considérée comme un atout important.

  • Solide compréhension des principes de gestion des revenus, de tarification, de prévision et d’optimisation de l’inventaire. Capacité à travailler avec de grands volumes de données et à traduire les résultats d’analyses en recommandations d’affaires claires et pertinentes.

  • Maîtrise des outils d’intelligence d’affaires et de visualisation de données, notamment Power BI. Connaissance des langages d’analyse ou de traitement de données tels que SQL, Python ou R, un atout.

  • Expérience avec les systèmes de gestion des revenus aériens, tels que PROS, ainsi qu’avec les systèmes de cotation groupes ou de gestion de l’inventaire, un atout. Expérience en définition des besoins d’affaires, en essais d’acceptation utilisateurs et en implantation d’améliorations aux systèmes ou aux processus.

  • Solides aptitudes en leadership, mobilisation et développement des talents. Excellent jugement d’affaires, capacité d’influencer les décisions, de favoriser l’alignement entre les équipes et de remettre en question les hypothèses de façon constructive.

  • Excellentes habiletés en communication et en présentation. Capacité à prendre des décisions éclairées dans un contexte complexe ou évolutif, à établir les priorités efficacement et à promouvoir une culture d’innovation et d’amélioration continue.

  • Excellente maîtrise d’Excel, notamment pour la modélisation et l’analyse de scénarios. Capacité à intégrer et à promouvoir l’utilisation responsable des outils d’intelligence artificielle et d’automatisation, tels que Copilot.

  • Excellente maîtrise des outils MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams) et aisance démontrée avec les outils numériques collaboratifs et l’IA (ex. Copilot).

  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement et à s’adapter aux nouvelles technologies.

  • Maîtrise orale et écrite du français et de l’anglais *.

Une bonne maîtrise du français est requise pour les postes au Québec. La personne en poste devra communiquer fréquemment en anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit, avec des collègues, des clients ou d’autres parties prenantes, tant au Québec qu’à l’international.

Équité en emploi

Transat s’est engagée à favoriser un milieu inclusif et respectueux où l’équité a primauté. Nous nous efforçons de manière à rassembler un effectif qui reflète la diversité de nos clients ainsi que des communautés dans lesquelles nous voyageons. Nous encourageons alors les femmes, les minorités visibles, les minorités ethniques, les autochtones et les personnes avec des handicaps à soumettre leur candidature. Transat accommodera les personnes avec des handicaps tout au long du processus de sélection et d’embauche. Si vous avez besoin des mesures d’adaptation, communiquez avec nous afin que nous puissions ensemble combler vos besoins convenablement.

Faites partie du voyage!

Notre mission, c’est d’être la compagnie aérienne préférée de notre clientèle et de notre équipe.

L’ouverture d’esprit, le souci des autres, l’intelligence au travail et surtout une bonne dose de plaisir nous permettent chaque jour d’accomplir de grandes choses, comme devenir le premier voyagiste international à obtenir la certification Travelife pour notre engagement envers le tourisme durable. Nous avons aussi remporté plusieurs fois le titre de meilleure compagnie aérienne de loisirs au monde. Et ce n’est que le début.

Envie de vous joindre à nous? Dès l’embauche, vous profiterez de privilèges voyage pour découvrir le monde. Vous aurez aussi l’occasion d’œuvrer dans des environnements de travail modernes et inspirants.

At ModMed, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: we hired doctors and taught them how to code. This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

A Culture of Excellence

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. AIGCC is seeking a motivated and analytically strong Policy Analyst to support its policy engagement and market development activities in the Philippines, with a particular focus on energy transition, power infrastructure investment, and sustainable finance. The role will focus on identifying policy and regulatory opportunities to accelerate private capital mobilisation towards a credible, resilient, and investable energy transition, particularly in the power sector.
Working closely with AIGCC’s wider team, you will undertake market and policy research, support strategic engagement with policymakers and financial institutions, and contribute to investor-led policy advocacy initiatives. This will include examining the investment implications of energy and financial sector policies, identifying barriers to financing clean energy and enabling infrastructure, and helping translate investor perspectives into actionable policy recommendations. This position offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of climate and energy policy, financial markets, and infrastructure investment, with exposure to senior representatives from ministries, institutional investors, and the wider energy sector.

AIGCC welcomes applicants from diverse professional backgrounds, including public policy, sustainable finance, infrastructure and project finance, energy economics, financial regulation, and investment research.

Specific duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead AIGCC’s presence in the Philippines, acting as the organisation’s main representative with investors, policymakers, regulators, and industry bodies.
  • Conduct market scoping to establish a focused strategy for the Philippines, identifying key stakeholders, policy developments, investment opportunities, and financing barriers.
  • Monitor and analyse
    national energy policies, electricity market regulations, infrastructure development plans, and sustainable finance frameworks,
    assessing their implications for institutional investors
  • Evaluate investment-enabling conditions for renewable energy, electricity transmission and distribution, grid modernisation, energy storage, and other critical energy transition infrastructure.
  • Identify policy and regulatory gaps affecting project bankability, risk allocation, capital mobilisation, and long-term investment certainty.
  • Develop policy briefs, research papers, consultation submissions, and recommendations informed by institutional investor perspectives.
  • Build and grow AIGCC’s network in the Philippines, strengthening relationships with institutional investors, policymakers, utilities, and key market stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with AIGCC’s regional teams on cross-cutting areas, including infrastructure financing, sectoral transition pathways, sustainable finance frameworks, and investment policy.
  • Provide logistical support for high-level meetings, covering convenings with officials, experts, and stakeholders as well as AIGCC roadshows in the market.
  • Support programme planning, reporting, stakeholder mapping, and the development of strategic priorities for AIGCC’s Philippine market activities.

Qualifications, skills

and capabilities

  • A bachelor’s degree in economics, finance, environmental studies, energy studies, or a related discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated professional experience in one or more of the following areas: energy policy, power-sector regulation, infrastructure or project finance, sustainable finance, investment research, or public policy advisory.
  • Deep understanding of the Philippines’ financial markets, energy sector, regulatory landscape, and policy environment, with demonstrated ability to engage credibly with senior government and regulatory interlocutors.
  • Familiarity with the financial and regulatory considerations affecting energy infrastructure investment, including financing risks, revenue mechanisms, and project development barriers.
  • Ability to analyse complex policy, regulatory, and financial issues and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations for investors and policymakers.
  • Existing professional networks within the Philippines financial, energy, or public policy sectors.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder engagement skills, with the confidence and professionalism to interact with government officials, financial institutions, and senior industry representatives.
  • Experience in supporting and coordinating the delivery of outcomes from international collaborations across multiple time zones, markets and cultures;
  • Fluent spoken and written English and Tagalog. Business-level language skills in other major Asian languages regarded as a positive.
  • Strong organisational, project management, writing, verbal communication and interpersonal and skills and demonstrated use of integrating AI
    into workflow to enhance efficiency and maximise productivity.
  • Strong entrepreneurial skills with ability to work well independently and as a team member.
  • Desire to work in a mission-driven and non-profit environment.

Applying for the role

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis so we encourage early application.

Working at AIGCC

AIGCC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will not discriminate against any individual based on race, colour, sex, national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any factors prohibited by applicable law.

AIGCC empowers employees with flexible work and encourages work/life balance with a range of benefits including: 20 days annual leave, birthday leave, 3 days of recharge leave during Christmas and New Year, study leave of up to 5 days and an Employee Assistance Program.

raw.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

Cresta’s AI Receptionist answers the phone for small businesses that would otherwise miss the call. It handles millions of conversations a month today, making sure no call goes unanswered and helping owners complete the front-office tasks that keep their business running, and it does so across hundreds of customers. Whether those conversations are actually good is the single most important question in the business, and it deserves a full-time owner. That’s you.
As our first AI Agent Evaluation Engineer, you define what quality means for every agent we run, you build the systems that measure it across every conversation, and you are the person the company trusts when the question is “how good is it, really?”
The work combines hands-on conversation analysis, rigorous evaluation design, and engineering execution: reading and annotating real conversations to learn how the agent actually fails, building the automated evaluation systems (LLM-based judges, golden sets, regression suites) that measure those failures at scale, and keeping those systems honest by calibrating them against human judgment. Fixing what you find is welcome but not the core of the job; an accurate, prioritized picture of agent quality is.

What You'll Do :

Evaluation Design & Quality Definition

  • Define and maintain the evaluation rubric for the agent across three axes: adherence (did it follow its design, call the right tools, respect guardrails), outcome (did the conversation achieve its goal), and conversation experience (latency, turn-taking, tone, repetition).
  • Write the annotation guidelines and failure taxonomy the team uses to talk about failures precisely; run calibration sessions and measure inter-rater agreement.
    • Classify and prioritize failure modes by severity and frequency so engineering and product work on what matters most.

Conversation Analysis & Annotation

  • Review production conversations by hand every week, leverage QA partners; open-code failures, cluster them, and turn the clusters into the evaluations worth automating.
  • Trace each failure to its likely cause (prompt, knowledge gap, tool or flow bug, speech recognition) and route it to the right owner with enough evidence to act on.
  • Evaluate across languages and report quality by segment (language, accent, audio quality, intent), not just in aggregate.

Scalable Evaluation Systems

  • Build and operate the evaluation pipeline that scores every production conversation, combining automated checks, LLM-based judges, and human review.
  • Calibrate every automated judge against human labels before trusting it; treat judge error as the primary measurement risk.
  • Design sampling strategies (stratified by intent, language, caller type, audio conditions) so that reported changes in quality are real.
  • Build and maintain the golden set and regression suite that every prompt, model, knowledge, and flow change is validated against before release.

Coverage & Edge Cases

  • Maintain the failure-mode coverage map: which behaviors are tested, partially tested, or unmeasured; close the gaps.
  • Design evaluations for behaviors no standard harness covers: high-stakes conversation types such as handoffs to a human, misuse and unwanted-caller handling, and resilience under upstream failures.
  • Define the quality and latency thresholds the agent is held to.

Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Report quality trends to internal stakeholders and customers clearly, with uncertainty stated and without burying bad news.
  • Partner with forward-deployed engineers, backend engineers, product managers, and the voice/language engineering team to turn findings into prioritized recommendations.
  • Document methodology so results are reproducible and the evaluation practice outlives any one person.

What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, applied ML, or data-intensive research roles, including at least 1–2 years working hands-on with LLM-based systems in production.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, Cognitive Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Built and operated an end-to-end evaluation system for a production LLM product (agent or otherwise): rubric, human labels, automated judge, regression suite.
  • Deep understanding of evaluation methodology: what golden sets, judges, regression suites, and calibration are for, and when each fails. Tool-agnostic; you will work in our in-house tooling.
  • Fluent in how LLM agents work: prompts, tool calls, context handling, multi-turn state. You can read a trace and tell what the agent was doing and why.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with LLM APIs; able to build and ship evaluation tooling independently. Fine-tuning and ML frameworks are not required.
  • Able to write a rubric that independent reviewers would score the same way, and to measure whether they do.
  • Able to design a test from an open-ended quality question: you decide what to measure and how, rather than executing a predefined plan.
  • Willing to do non-scalable work weekly, both yourself and by directing our QA partners: listening to calls, labeling conversations, building a failure taxonomy from scratch.
  • Professional fluency in at least one language other than English, sufficient to evaluate multilingual agent behavior directly.
  • Strong written communication; you author the guidelines others follow.

Note on Our Hiring Process

We highly value your time and engineering craftsmanship. To ensure a streamlined and objective process, the first step for qualified applicants following an initial resume review is a self-paced CoderPad technical assessment. This allows you to showcase your practical coding and problem-solving skills in a real-world environment before moving into conversational interview rounds.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).
Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.
Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

Role Overview Penn Foster is seeking a strategic, commercially minded Client Success Manager to own a portfolio of high-value client relationships. This role is responsible for building trusted partnerships, driving client outcomes, protecting recurring revenue, identifying growth opportunities, and coordinating Penn Foster resources around each client’s priorities. The Strategic CSM serves as the day-to-day owner of the relationship and account plan, while partnering with the Director of Strategic Accounts on executive engagement, strategic risk, and complex growth opportunities. Strategic Account Leadership

Act as the business owner of a portfolio of assigned strategic accounts in the social purpose organization client portfolio, with responsibility for client outcomes, retention, and growth

Develop and maintain actionable account plans that connect client priorities to Penn Foster capabilities, outcomes, renewal objectives, and growth opportunities. Develop and maintain joint success plans that ensure that clients achieve their desired outcomes and realize value from their partnership with Penn Foster. Build multi-threaded relationships across client organizations, including business, operational, procurement, and executive stakeholders. Lead regular business reviews, planning conversations, and other client engagements that create shared accountability for outcomes. Serve as the primary client advocate and coordinator across Penn Foster teams.

Retention, Risk, and Growth

Maintain clear visibility into client health, adoption, stakeholder engagement, renewal timing, contractual commitments, and business outcomes. Identify and address risks early through specific action plans, owners, dates, and escalation paths. Lead renewal planning and coordinate internal actions required to protect recurring bookings. Identify, qualify, and advance expansion opportunities in partnership with Sales, the Director of Strategic Accounts, and relevant subject-matter experts. Connect client needs to the right Penn Foster products, services, and capabilities without overpromising or creating unmanaged commitments. Maintain accurate CRM records, forecasts, account status, and next steps.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Coordinate Client Success, Sales, Product, Operations, Academic Services, Finance, and other partners around client priorities. Translate client feedback, performance data, and market context into clear internal recommendations. Influence outcomes through preparation, clarity, follow-through, and accountability rather than relying on formal authority. Share patterns and best practices that improve strategic account management across the team.

Success Measures

Net Revenue Retention and renewal performance Reduction of client risk and churn exposure Client outcome achievement and adoption Executive and multi-threaded relationship depth Quality and execution of account plans Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline

Skills and Experience

Experience in enterprise client success, strategic account management, consultative sales, account management, or a related client-facing role. Demonstrated success managing complex client relationships and driving retention, adoption, or expansion. Strong business judgment and ability to connect client goals to measurable outcomes. Executive presence and strong written, verbal, and facilitation skills. Experience working across matrixed organizations and influencing cross-functional teams. Strong organization, prioritization, forecasting, and CRM discipline. Experience in education, workforce development, talent solutions, SaaS, healthcare, or enterprise services preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Builds trust while maintaining commercial clarity. Knows the client’s priorities, stakeholders, risks, commitments, and next best actions. Brings prepared, outcome-oriented conversations to clients and internal partners. Escalates early and constructively when client outcomes or revenue are at risk. Creates growth through client value rather than treating growth as a separate sales motion. Operates as the accountable owner of the relationship while using the broader Penn Foster team effectively.

Working Conditions & Hiring Process:

U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside in and perform work within the United States. We do not support international remote work arrangements for this role. Travel Expectations: While this is a remote position, occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, etc. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed. On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply. Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement. Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law. Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.

About Us: At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by uniting Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable them to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future. Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

We strive toward Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Penn Foster Group by intentionally building teams that are diverse – in identities, lived experiences, and ideas to create a culture where people feel connected to each other and have a sense of belonging. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion because it is the foundation that enables us to achieve what we set out to do as an organization – from maximizing the number of learners who can reach their goals while giving them the kinds of experiences we want them to have, to becoming the type of company we want to work in. What We Offer: We offer a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending, generous paid time off, sponsored volunteer opportunities, a 401K with a company match, plus free access to all of our online programs.

raw.excerpt: About SimpliFedSimpliFed is a virtual maternal health company.
raw.description:
About SimpliFed

SimpliFed is a virtual maternal health company. We start with feeding support (lactation care, pumping and supply help, and prescribing for breast pumps and related needs) and build from there into care across pregnancy and postpartum, including postpartum mood screening and connection to the right next level of care. Our clinicians see families by video across the U.S., working alongside health plans, health systems, and breast pump suppliers.

We believe the key to every happy, healthy baby is a happy, healthy parent.

How we think about feeding

We help families feed their babies in whatever way works for them: nursing, exclusive pumping, formula, combination feeding, donor milk, supplementing, or weaning. Our job is to give parents accurate information and real support for their goals, not to judge their choices. A confident, supported parent and a fed, growing baby are the outcomes we care about.

We hire clinicians who share this view and show it in how they talk with families.

The role

You'll see new and expecting parents by video for lactation and feeding visits: assessment, care planning, and ongoing support through their feeding journey. This is a lactation role and does not include prescribing. You'll work closely with our nurse practitioners, who handle breast pump orders and medications.

What you'll do

  • Run prenatal and postpartum video visits covering feeding assessment, latch and positioning, milk supply, pumping and flange fit, supplementing, bottle feeding, formula transitions, and weaning.
  • Build practical care plans around each family's own feeding goals.
  • Screen for red flags (infant weight and hydration, parental pain or infection, postpartum mood) and escalate or refer per SimpliFed protocols.
  • Hand off to our NP/APP team when a visit shows a need for a breast pump order or medication.
  • Document every visit clearly and on time in our EHR.
  • Follow families across multiple visits, not just one.

Required

  • Current IBCLC certification (IBLCE), in good standing.
  • Available at least 15 hours a week. 20+ hours preferred.
  • A private, quiet space for video visits, reliable high-speed internet, and a computer with a camera that meets our telehealth platform requirements.

Preferred

  • The same days and times each week (fixed weekly blocks).
  • 20+ hours a week, including evening or weekend blocks. We see families 8am to 10pm ET.
  • Telehealth lactation experience, including prenatal and pump consults.
  • An individual NPI and an active CAQH profile; current enrollment with major health plans.
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English (or another language our families speak).
  • Experience working alongside prescribers (NP or MD) in shared care.
  • A Connecticut or Rhode Island lactation consultant license. Both states license lactation consultants; tell us if you hold either.
  • An RN license? See our Registered Nurse, IBCLC role.

Where we're hiring

IBCLC is a national certification, so we hire from every state. Demand is highest for families in:

States

Demand

Florida, New York, California, Texas

Highest

New Jersey, North Carolina, Virginia, Georgia

Strong and steady

Illinois, Maryland, Arizona, Pennsylvania

Solid and growing

Because we cover families across time zones until 10pm ET, clinicians in Central, Mountain, and Pacific time who can take evening Eastern blocks are especially helpful.

Schedule and commitment

We're building a team of fewer, more committed clinicians rather than a large panel of low-hour contractors. It gets families seen faster and gives you a steadier caseload. We look for at least 15 hours a week of availability. Clinicians who can offer the same days and times each week, and more hours, get priority scheduling and more volume.

Getting started

After you accept an offer, you'll start an onboarding period: credentialing, systems setup, and training. Our aim is to have you seeing families as soon as possible, though please note that credentialing can take between 30 and 90 days.

Credentialing with licensing boards and health plans can take 30 to 90 days from your hire date to delivering care, depending on your licenses and which health plans you'll see patients under. We'll tell you up front what to expect for your situation and start the paperwork the day you accept.

Pay

Hourly rates for 1099 contract roles, by regional market tier (based on where you live):

  • Tier 1 (CA, NY, MA, NJ, HI, MD): $48–$53/hr
  • Tier 2 (IL, CO, OR, VA, PA, AZ, MN): $42–$46/hr
  • Tier 3 (NC, GA, FL, TX, TN, OH, MI, IN, SC, WI, MO, and states not listed): $38–$42/hr
  • Tier 4 (MS, AR, WV, KY, OK, AL, LA): $34–$38/hr

Part-time and full-time W2 roles are also available for clinicians who commit to more hours.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Senior Account Executive - Life Sciences (US, Remote)

➡️ Frustrated selling a product that's difficult to differentiate or competing purely on price?
