➡️ Looking for enterprise sales cycles that challenge you intellectually, create genuine customer impact, and reward high performance?

If this sounds like your next move, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Summary:

The Life Sciences industry is changing rapidly, and AI is becoming central to how the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies innovate. At Patsnap, we're at the heart of that transformation.

We're looking for a Senior Account Executive to help accelerate one of our fastest-growing business units. With 20%+ year-on-year growth, significant investment in AI, and ambitious expansion plans, there's never been a more exciting time to join our Life Sciences team.

This isn't about selling another point solution.

You'll represent one of the most comprehensive AI-powered Innovation Intelligence platforms on the market, bringing together patents, scientific literature, clinical trials, regulatory intelligence, market data and proprietary AI to help customers make smarter R&D and IP decisions.

Trusted by organisations including Pfizer, Moderna, Roche, Novartis, GSK, Bayer, Sanofi and Johnson & Johnson, you'll partner with global pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device companies to solve some of their most important innovation challenges—from accelerating drug discovery to reducing R&D risk and shaping long-term innovation strategy.

You'll own strategic enterprise opportunities from prospecting through to close, engaging senior stakeholders across R&D, Innovation, Intellectual Property and the C-suite. These are commercially significant, multi-stakeholder sales cycles where you'll build trusted relationships, influence complex buying decisions and deliver measurable business value.

If you're looking for a role where you can sell a genuinely differentiated product, own a strategic territory, and play a key role in one of Patsnap's highest-growth markets, we'd love to hear from you.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?

Check out this short overview:

This is a remote US-based position, ideally suited for candidates able to work flexibly across EST hours.

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle, using domain-specific AI to accelerate the creation of market-ready products. With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. Our $300M Series E funding round brings our valuation to a $1 billion unicorn status, and we still have a remarkable amount of growth ahead.

As the leading global Life Sciences intelligence platform, Patsnap helps pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and life sciences organisations make better innovation decisions. By connecting patents, scientific literature, clinical trials, regulatory data, and market intelligence, we enable our customers to identify white spaces, reduce R&D risk, and accelerate breakthrough innovation.

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in Singapore, Toronto, London, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

Why Join Patsnap?

  • Sell a platform customers genuinely want to buy. Trusted by leading Life Sciences organisations including Pfizer, Moderna, Roche, Novartis, GSK, Bayer, Sanofi and Johnson & Johnson, Patsnap helps customers solve mission-critical R&D and innovation challenges.

  • Join one of our fastest-growing business units. With 20%+ year-on-year growth, significant investment in AI, and ambitious expansion plans, there's never been a more exciting time to join our Life Sciences team.

  • Own a high-value territory with real opportunity. Take ownership of strategic enterprise accounts, combining new business with significant expansion potential across pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device organisations.

  • Sell a genuinely differentiated solution. Patsnap brings together AI, patents, scientific literature, clinical trials, regulatory intelligence and market data in one platform, helping customers make smarter innovation and R&D decisions.

  • Have conversations that matter. Partner with senior stakeholders across R&D, Innovation, Intellectual Property and Commercial leadership, influencing decisions that shape future products, portfolios and scientific breakthroughs.

  • Join a high-performance commercial team. Work alongside experienced sales leaders in a collaborative culture that values curiosity, ownership, continuous learning and shared success.

  • Accelerate your career. As Patsnap continues to invest in Life Sciences globally, you'll have the opportunity to grow into strategic account leadership, larger enterprise opportunities, or broader commercial leadership roles.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through to negotiation and close.

  • Build and execute a territory strategy to drive new logo acquisition across pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device organisations.

  • Develop executive relationships across R&D, Innovation, Intellectual Property and Commercial leadership teams.

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes, creating consensus across technical and commercial buyers.

  • Build, manage and accurately forecast a healthy pipeline of enterprise opportunities.

  • Partner closely with SDRs, Customer Success, Product and Marketing to maximise territory growth.

  • Become a trusted advisor by understanding customer innovation challenges and demonstrating measurable business value.

  • Consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets while contributing to the continued growth of the Life Sciences business.

Requirements

What We'd Love From You:

  • 3+ years of a proven track record of consistently hitting or exceeding quota in B2B SaaS or technology sales

  • Experience selling into Life Sciences organisations, including pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device or adjacent markets.

  • Confident in high-volume outbound outreach; from cold calling to pipeline building and engaging prospects.

  • Confidence managing complex, consultative enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Experience engaging senior decision-makers and executive buyers.

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value.

  • A proactive, self-motivated approach with experience building pipeline alongside inbound opportunities.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • A growth mindset, intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in AI, innovation and Life Sciences.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong sales culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • Unlimited vacation

  • 2 volunteer days for community volunteering

  • Health and dental benefits for you and your dependents from day one

  • 401K matching

  • Remote work environment + WFH stipend for your home office set-up

  • 24/7 employee assistance program which provides access to virtual healthcare, therapy, financial and legal assistance, wellness counselling and resources for family support.

Patsnap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer (EOE) that champions diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran/military, or disability status, or any other protected status in accordance with federal, provincial/state or local laws.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, we encourage you to apply and tell us why you’d be a great fit for this role! If you require any accommodations during the interview process, please email us at so we can best support you.

raw.description:
At Clover, the Business Enablement team leads our technological advancement while ensuring robust security and compliance. We deliver user-friendly corporate applications, manage complex data ecosystems, and provide efficient tech solutions across the organization. Our goal is simple: we make it easy for the business to do what’s right for Clover.

We’re hiring a Engineering Lead to build the systems that help our clinical teams deliver services in the field and in members’ homes. You will own technical direction and delivery for scheduling, dispatch, field and mobile workflows, and the software that connects equipment and home technology to the operation.

A likely first assignment is an “Air Traffic Control” system for field operations. A supervisor needs to understand what is happening and act when the plan breaks: a flat tire, a delayed visit, a missing piece of equipment, or a member whose availability changes. You will work with the people doing the job to decide what they need to see, what the system can help resolve, and when a human should intervene.

This is a hands-on role that spans product and engineering. You will understand the business problem, shape the solution, build useful increments, and see whether they work. You may start without direct reports and can expect to coach and eventually manage one or two engineers. You should enjoy building personally and helping others become more capable.

We value a tinkering instinct: try the unfamiliar tool, inspect the data, trace the failure, put a small improvement in front of a user, and learn from what happens. Hardware or connected-device experience can be a strong signal of that mindset, but it is not required. The central work is building dependable software for an operation that changes throughout the day.

As an Engineering Lead, Clinical Operations, you will:

  • Work directly with supervisors, clinical field staff, and operations leaders to understand schedules, travel, capacity, handoffs, and the exceptions that disrupt a day’s work.
  • Build field visibility and intervention tools that give supervisors useful context, distinguish current facts from missing information, and help them respond to changing conditions.
  • Develop scheduling and dispatch capabilities that match people and visits to practical constraints, with clear ways for operating staff to review and adjust the plan.
  • Build and debug APIs, mobile workflows, integrations, and data flows supporting field teams, connected equipment, and home technology.
  • Prototype quickly and ship focused increments. Make deliberate choices about what to build, integrate, or buy, and avoid committing to a large system before the operation has tested the approach.
  • Use AI actively for development, investigation, prototypes, analysis, and useful workflow capabilities. Check the behavior and make failures understandable and recoverable.
  • Coach engineers and take on a small number of direct reports as the team develops. Maintain clear ownership, sound engineering practices, and credible delivery commitments.
  • Partner with Product, Special Project Leads, IT, Counterpart, and the Engagement lead at the interfaces their work shares with field operations.

Success in this role looks like:

  • First 90 days: You understand how the field operation works, have shipped an improvement used by supervisors or field staff, and can show what it changed. You have a focused technical plan grounded in real constraints and exceptions.
  • First six months: Several useful increments are in place. Supervisors can understand and respond to disruptions more effectively, scheduling and field workflows are improving, and technical ownership is clear.

You should get in touch if:

  • You are a strong production software engineer who has owned meaningful work end-to-end and still builds regularly.
  • You can move across backend services, APIs, data flows, user interfaces, and operational workflows to solve a real problem.
  • You have strong product instincts, learn unfamiliar domains directly, and enjoy working with the people using what you build.
  • You have an iterative, curious approach to technology. You can describe an unfamiliar system you explored, a practical prototype you tried, or a failure you traced across boundaries.
  • You use AI in your own engineering work and have practical experience building or integrating AI-backed capabilities, with clear verification and evaluation.
  • You can coach engineers and are interested in responsibility for a small team as it develops. Formal management experience can help, but a strong record of Engineering Leadership and coaching also matters.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

$223,100—$290,000 USD

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off

raw.description:
Die Rolle auf einen Blick

Als Business Development Representative – bei uns auch Business Developer oder Sales Development Representative – gewinnst du Neukunden für die Compliance-Plattform von Bits und baust B2B-Beziehungen zu regulierten Finanzunternehmen in Europa auf: Banken, Neobanken, Payment-Anbieter, Kreditgeber sowie Investment- und Fondsgesellschaften. Dein wichtigstes Werkzeug ist das Telefon: Du bist ein echtes Call-Talent, das Entscheider in wenigen Minuten für ein Gespräch gewinnt.

Standort: Remote (Deutschland) · Start: ab sofort · Umfang: Vollzeit

Über Bits Technology

Bits Technology baut Compliance-Infrastruktur für regulierte Finanzunternehmen in der EU: KYB- und KYC-Onboarding, AML-Risikoscoring, laufende Sorgfaltspflichten (Ongoing Due Diligence), Transaktionsmonitoring und Case Management – alles in einer Plattform, ergänzt um Bits AI. Mit 60+ integrierten Datenquellen und Abdeckung in 100+ Märkten ist die Plattform für die EU-Geldwäscheverordnung AMLR gebaut, die ab Juli 2027 gilt.

Gegründet 2022 in Stockholm von Fintech-Buildern mit Hintergrund bei Klarna und Tink, haben wir bislang 17 Mio. € eingesammelt – zuletzt 12 Mio. € in einer Series A (Februar 2026) unter Führung von Alstin Capital. Zu unseren Kunden zählen u. a. Qliro, Alisa Bank, Brite Payments, Walley und Coinmotion. Wir sind ein Team von rund 20 Leuten, das stark wächst – und du baust den Vertrieb mit auf.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Neukundengewinnung am Telefon (Outbound & Inbound): Du greifst täglich zum Hörer und sprichst aktiv Entscheider bei regulierten Finanzunternehmen in Europa an – CEOs, COOs, Heads of Compliance, MLROs und CFOs von Fintechs, Banken, Neobanken, Payment- und Kreditanbietern. Cold Calls sind dein Heimspiel; E-Mail, LinkedIn und Events ergänzen deinen Mix.

  • Pitching & Demo-Vorbereitung:Du stellst die Bits-Plattform (Onboarding, Risikoscoring, ODD, Transaktionsmonitoring, Case Management, Bits AI) überzeugend vor und bereitest Demos gemeinsam mit den Account Executives vor.

  • Pipeline-Aufbau:Du qualifizierst Leads, generierst Termine für das Senior-Sales-Team und sorgst für einen sauber gepflegten Funnel im CRM – von der ersten Recherche bis zur Übergabe an den Abschluss.

  • Markt- und Account-Research:Du identifizierst Zielkunden nach Segment (Banks & Neobanks, Payments, Lenders, Investment & Fund Managers) und Markt, baust Zielkundenlisten auf und erkennst Trigger wie Marktexpansion, Lizenzierung oder AMLR-Vorbereitung.

  • Feedback-Schleife:Du gibst Markt- und Kundenfeedback direkt an Product, Marketing und die Gründer weiter – bei einem Team von rund 20 Leuten hat deine Stimme Gewicht.

Dein Profil

  • Call-Talent:Du telefonierst gern und gut – du gehst auf fremde Menschen zu, kommst schnell auf den Punkt, hörst aktiv zu und bleibst auch nach dem zehnten „Nein“ freundlich und hartnäckig. Erfahrung in Telesales, Cold Calling oder im SDR/BDR-Bereich ist ein klares Plus.

  • Qualifikation:(Fach-)Hochschulstudium, kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Quereinstieg mit klarer Vertriebsaffinität – erste Erfahrung im B2B-Sales oder in Fintech/RegTech ist willkommen, kein Muss.

  • Interesse an Fintech & Compliance:Du willst verstehen, wie KYC, KYB, AML und Transaktionsmonitoring funktionieren und warum die AMLR 2027 für Finanzunternehmen gerade jetzt ein Thema ist – Vorkenntnisse bringen wir dir bei.

  • Struktur & Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest sauber im CRM, planst deine Woche selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Zahlen (Bits-Wert: Personal Accountability).

  • Bias for Action:Du probierst lieber aus und lernst daraus, als auf die perfekte Information zu warten.

  • Sprachen:Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und sicheres Englisch (Arbeitssprache im Team); weitere europäische Sprachen sind ein Vorteil.

  • Remote-fit: Du arbeitest selbstorganisiert aus Deutschland, hältst engen Kontakt zum Team in Stockholm und hast Lust auf regelmäßige Besuche vor Ort.

Vergütung & Perspektiven

  • Gehalt: Fixes Grundgehalt plus variable, ungedeckelte Provision auf qualifizierte Termine und Abschlüsse.

  • Karrierepfad im Vertrieb:Klarer Weg vom BDR zum Account Executive (New Business) und weiter zu Senior-Sales- oder Führungsrollen, während das Commercial-Team mit der Series A wächst.

  • Weiterentwicklung:Strukturiertes Onboarding in Produkt, Compliance-Grundlagen (KYC, KYB, AML, AMLR 2027) und Sales-Methodik; enge Zusammenarbeit mit Account Executives, dem Head of Product & Compliance und den Gründern; regelmäßige Demos und Team-Sessions, in denen du dein Wissen ausbaust.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum:Du kommst früh in ein kleines, schnell wachsendes Team und prägst Prozesse, Playbooks und Zielmärkte des Vertriebs mit.

Was dich bei Bits erwartet

Bei Bits erwartet dich ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen einbringen und gemeinsam mit einem engagierten Team etwas bewegen kannst. Wir wachsen, entwickeln uns weiter und legen großen Wert auf eine Kultur, die von Vertrauen, Zusammenarbeit und Eigenverantwortung geprägt ist.

Darüber hinaus bieten wir dir:

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Ein Stock-Optionen-Programm: Wir möchten diejenigen am Unternehmenserfolg beteiligen, die ihn aktiv mitgestalten.

  • Moderne technische Ausstattung, abgestimmt auf deine individuellen Bedürfnisse.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem Unternehmen, in dem deine Ideen zählen.

The In-house CRA (IHCRA) provides centralized, non-site-facing support to CRAs and clinical project teams across the study lifecycle. The role supports consistent site oversight by maintaining study documentation and systems, reviewing and reconciling site-level data, preparing operational metrics, and completing agreed administrative follow-up activities. The IHCRA works in close collaboration with assigned CRAs and under the oversight of the CTM, escalating issues that require site-facing follow-up or clinical judgment.

This is a regional support role. Direct communication with investigator sites and travel to site visits are not part of the core scope. The role may support studies across European countries and therefore does not require a local language for each supported country.

Essential functions

  • Provide non-site-facing operational and administrative support to assigned CRAs and clinical project teams throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Prepare and maintain Investigator Site Files, including document distribution and coordination with shipping vendors where required. Route site communication and follow-up to the assigned CRA.
  • Where an electronic Investigator Site File is implemented, review it remotely for completeness and identify documents requiring CRA follow-up or filing in the Trial Master File.
  • Review documents received from CRAs and CTMs for legibility, completeness, correct orientation and filing readiness, and file documents in the eTMF in accordance with applicable processes.
  • Review the eTMF for missing or expiring site documents and provide clear follow-up lists to the assigned CRA.
  • Perform scheduled reconciliations between the Delegation of Authority Log, CTMS, eTMF and system-access records; create placeholders or update records as required by the agreed process.
  • Set up and maintain assigned site-level data, milestones and activities in CTMS and other study-specific systems based on information provided by the CRA and/or CTM.
  • Run available reports and provide assigned CRAs with agreed site metrics, including data-cleaning, enrollment and approval-status information where applicable.
  • Support sample tracking and other vendor or study reconciliations, identify discrepancies, and provide findings to the CRA for site-facing follow-up.
  • Complete agreed non-site-facing administrative actions arising from CRA site contacts or monitoring visits, such as coordinating supply orders, tracking completion and escalating delays.
  • Provide documentation and tracking support for audit and inspection readiness under CRA or CTM direction.
  • Support study tracking and reporting, maintain accurate activity status, and escalate risks, delays or data inconsistencies to the appropriate study team member.
  • Perform all activities in accordance with ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, company and sponsor SOPs, project plans and study-specific procedures.

Qualifications

Minimum required

  • Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent, preferably in a scientific, healthcare or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Initial experience in clinical research, clinical trial administration or study coordination within a CRO, pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment.
  • Practical experience using CTMS, eTMF and other clinical trial systems or tools.
  • Familiarity with ICH-GCP principles and clinical trial documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Skills and competencies

  • Strong organization, prioritization and follow-through across multiple studies, sites and deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to perform accurate document and data review for extended periods.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies, communicate findings clearly and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with CRAs, CTMs and cross-functional partners.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Self-motivation, flexibility, teamwork and commitment to delivering on agreed responsibilities.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting multiple studies or countries in a centralized or regional clinical operations model.
  • Experience with Veeva Clinical applications.

Please, apply in English.

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle PL/SQL Developer to design, develop, and optimize enterprise database solutions supporting high-volume transactional systems, financial applications, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical business operations. This role focuses on building scalable PL/SQL applications, optimizing complex SQL queries, developing database objects, and ensuring high availability and performance across large Oracle environments.
You will work closely with application developers, database administrators, data architects, QA engineers, and business analysts to build efficient database solutions that support enterprise applications, cloud modernization initiatives, and data integration platforms. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Oracle Database technologies, advanced PL/SQL programming, query optimization, and performance tuning while maintaining high standards for data integrity, security, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain complex PL/SQL packages, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and database objects supporting enterprise applications.
  • Develop highly optimized SQL queries for large transactional and analytical databases.
  • Design scalable database schemas, indexing strategies, partitioning models, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Build ETL processes and database integration components for enterprise data movement and synchronization.
  • Develop batch processing jobs and automated database workflows supporting business-critical operations.
  • Analyze execution plans, identify SQL bottlenecks, and optimize database performance for high-volume systems.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to design efficient database access patterns and API integrations.
  • Implement database security, auditing, role-based access controls, and data encryption standards.

  • Strong expertise in Oracle PL/SQL including packages, stored procedures, functions, cursors, triggers, collections, exceptions, and dynamic SQL.
  • Advanced SQL development skills with complex joins, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), analytical functions, window functions, and query optimization.
  • Extensive experience with Oracle Database 12c, 19c, or newer enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of Oracle indexing, partitioning, materialized views, execution plans, and optimizer statistics.
  • Experience optimizing high-volume OLTP and OLAP database workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle SQL Developer, TOAD, SQL*Plus, or similar Oracle development tools.
  • Experience developing ETL processes and integrating Oracle databases with external systems.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Data Pump, RMAN, and database migration methodologies.
  • Experience working with Oracle Advanced Queuing (AQ), Scheduler, and database jobs.
  • Experience integrating Oracle databases with Java, .NET, Python, or REST-based enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of database normalization, data modeling, and relational database design principles.
  • Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or CI/CD pipelines for database deployment automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Database Services or Autonomous Database.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Exadata, RAC (Real Application Clusters), and Data Guard environments.
  • Experience with Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), or Oracle SOA Suite.
  • Knowledge of Oracle APEX application development.
  • Experience developing financial, healthcare, insurance, retail, or government enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud migration strategies from on-premises Oracle databases to OCI, Azure, or AWS.
  • Experience with shell scripting, Python, or PowerShell for database automation.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts.
  • Oracle Database Administration or Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) certifications are highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting highly regulated environments requiring auditability, compliance, and data governance.

Project Environment
You will be joining an enterprise data engineering and application modernization team responsible for supporting mission-critical Oracle database platforms serving multiple business units. Current initiatives include:
  • Enterprise financial transaction processing systems
  • Healthcare claims and patient management platforms
  • Insurance policy administration and billing systems
  • Large-scale ERP and supply chain applications
  • Cloud migration of Oracle databases to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Regulatory reporting and compliance data platforms
  • Enterprise data integration and batch processing solutions
  • High-availability Oracle environments supporting millions of daily transactions
  • Performance optimization and modernization of legacy PL/SQL applications
This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to database architecture, PL/SQL development, SQL optimization, cloud migration, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise Oracle platforms.

How to Apply

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Korea. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Korea.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Position Summary: ESM Prep, a premier brand within Guidewell Education’s portfolio, delivers highly individualized academic tutoring, college counseling, and standardized test preparation to students globally. As we expand our instructional talent across the Latin American market, we are seeking dedicated SAT Verbal Tutors based in Mexico for remote tutoring across the Americas.

Sitting at the intersection of academic instruction and student mentorship, this role owns the full life cycle of the verbal sections of test preparation for an assigned caseload of students. You will deliver engaging one-on-one coaching, customize ESM’s curriculum to individual learning styles, and equip students with both the content mastery and testing strategies necessary to excel on the digital SAT.

Note: We hire SAT Math and SAT Verbal specialists on separate tracks. If you have strong mastery in both subjects, you are welcome and encouraged to apply for both positions.

Key Responsibilities

Instruction & Student Mentorship

  • Facilitate engaging, highly individualized one-on-one SAT Verbal sessions for a matched roster of students.
  • Teach Reading & Writing concepts alongside specific time-management and test-taking strategies.
  • Develop effective mentoring relationships, maintaining appropriate professional boundaries while actively managing student expectations and testing anxiety.
  • Submit consistent core instructional KPIs, progress metrics, and session data according to established reporting timelines.

Curriculum & Progress Management

  • Develop and adapt customized study plans, adjusting teaching methods to address individual student needs and learning styles.
  • Complete class summaries, progress reports, and study plans accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Provide practitioner feedback on student engagement and instructional curriculum effectiveness.

Client Communication & Administration

  • Maintain proactive, consistent communication with the office regarding student progress, flagging concerns and seeking support when needed.
  • Respond to student and parent inquiries in a timely, professional manner, accurately communicating the role of testing in the broader U.S. college admissions process.
  • Participate in initial program orientation, attend periodic instructional alignment and academic coordination sessions, and engage in quality assurance reviews regarding student progress metrics.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in English is strictly required.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; demonstrated mastery of the digital SAT Reading and Writing Section and strong working knowledge of U.S. higher-education testing expectations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in coaching, tutoring, or middle/high school English or humanities education.
  • Outstanding interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to confidently engage both students and parents.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with the broader academic team.

What Success Looks Like

  • Instructional Volume: Successfully managing and executing a full caseload of 15-30 instructional hours per week while maintaining high instructional quality.
  • Student Outcomes: Driving measurable score improvements on practice and official SAT verbal sections through effective study plan implementation.
  • Operational Excellence: Submitting all class summaries, progress reports, and parent communications accurately and within required timeframes.

Compensation & Engagement Detail

  • Competitive rate of $350–$400 MXN per hour (roughly $18–$22 USD equivalent), scaled to reflect candidate expertise and experience
  • Schedule & Caseload Flexibility: Contractors set their own availability within peak student hours (typically U.S. after-school and weekend windows) and accept caseload matches up to their preferred capacity (typically 15–30 hours/week)
  • Invoices will be submitted on a monthly schedule according to logged hours
  • Early access to new job listings within a high-growth, PE-backed organization

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

  • Application Review: Resume screening by our Talent Team (~1 business week)
  • Content Check: Candidates must achieve an acceptable score on a Test Prep Content Quiz
  • Recruiter Intro & Alignment: 30-minute video conversation on role fit, schedule availability, and logistics
  • Instructional Interview: Live video interview featuring a mock tutoring case study

About Guidewell Education & Our Core Values: Guidewell Education is a mission-driven organization representing a family of successful legacy brands in the education sector. Our mission is to deliver best-in-class, transformational educational experiences and resources, guiding every student with empathy and expertise.

Our portfolio includes some of the most trusted names in the educational services space, such as Applerouth Education, ESM Prep, College MatchPoint, mbaMission, Reach Summer Camps, Blue Ivy Coaching, and Guidewell Global, among others. Together, we provide a comprehensive suite of services including academic tutoring, standardized test preparation, executive function coaching, college counseling, graduate admissions, and summer enrichment.
Across our brands, we guide students and families at every stage of their academic journey. Our team is dedicated to helping students and professionals define their goals, develop confidence in their abilities, and achieve their full potential.

Our Culture & Values: At Guidewell Education, we're guided by values that shape how we support students and work together as colleagues — we are student-centered, empathetic, expert practitioners, and growth-oriented. These principles show up in every coaching relationship we build and every decision we make. You can read more about how our team lives these values at.

Our mission is to demonstrate the love of Jesus Christ by empowering excellent AEC professionals to provide superior service. raw.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
raw.excerpt: Who we are looking for:We’re looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to set the technical direction for reliability across ACV’s engineering organization.
raw.description:
Who we are looking for:

We’re looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to set the technical direction for reliability across ACV’s engineering organization. You’ll work alongside infrastructure, platform, quality, and product engineering teams to define how we build, deploy, observe, and operate production systems at scale. We value practical software engineering experience and computer science fundamentals, and we care less about which specific tools you’ve used than your ability to solve complex problems and apply engineering best practices. You’re an engineer other engineers seek out when something is hard: a failing service, an unclear architecture decision, or a reliability problem that crosses team boundaries. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you raise the bar by building paved roads, mentoring others, and making the right way the easy way. You can go from “why did this service fail?” to “here’s the systemic fix, here’s how we automate it for every service, and here’s how we keep it from happening again.”

What you will do:

Set the reliability strategy and technical standards for ACV’s engineering organization, including SLOs and error budgets, release practices, and production readiness.

Design, build, and scale infrastructure on AWS and/or GCP and Kubernetes, with an IaC-first approach (Terraform, Helm).

Build golden paths and self-service tooling that give every service dashboards, monitoring, logging, alerting, and deployment pipelines out of the box.

Partner with engineering teams to improve architecture for resiliency, scalability, and fault tolerance, including support for multi-region and international growth.

Drive standardization of observability, monitoring, and alerting practices to improve MTTD and MTTR and to shift problem detection left of production.

Simplify and harden the deployment process to lower change failure rate and shorten lead time for new products and services.

Lead incident response as an escalation point for live-site issues, and own Root Cause Analysis and Problem Management (ITIL) for major outages, ensuring corrective actions are completed.

Audit current systems, identify risks and opportunities to reduce incidents, and automate repetitive operational and administrative work.

Plan maintenance activity and write design documentation, standard procedures, and runbooks.

Evaluate and introduce modern technologies, such as OpenTelemetry, where they add clear value, and help retire legacy components.

Mentor SREs and software engineers, review designs and code, and contribute to a collaborative, continuously improving team culture.

Participate in an on-call rotation.

Perform additional duties as assigned.

What you will need:

BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

10+ years of experience in SRE, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or Observability Engineering, including a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams.

Deep experience building and managing production infrastructure on Amazon Web Services and/or Google Cloud Platform.

Experience building, maintaining, and scaling Kubernetes clusters for production workloads.

Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and deployment tooling such as Helm.

Experience designing CI/CD pipelines and build tooling (e.g., Jenkins), and driving improvements in deployment safety and speed.

Hands-on expertise with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g., Datadog), including metrics, logs, tracing, alerting, and SLOs.

Proven experience defining and operating SLOs and error budgets and using them to drive engineering priorities.

Highly proficient in version control, including trunk-based development, multiple release planning, cherry-picking, and rebase.

Strong software engineering skills and a solid grasp of fundamentals, including major data structures (arrays, dictionaries, strings).

Self-sufficient debugger who can diagnose and resolve complex problems in code and in distributed systems.

Strong problem-solving skills, with the confidence and resourcefulness to independently explore solutions thoroughly.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence technical direction and partner with engineering leadership.

Preferred:

Experience with OpenTelemetry and building internal developer platforms or golden paths.

Experience developing in Golang

Experience with high-volume, highly distributed production environments.

Experience with databases and data platforms.

Experience with observability cost optimization and usage governance.

Experience with multi-region or international cloud architectures.

raw.description:
Axalta steht durch kontinuierliche Investitionen in innovative Lösungen seit jeher an der Spitze der Lack- und Beschichtungsindustrie. Wir entwickeln Technologien, die die Produkte unserer Kunden schützen – sei es vor Hitze, Licht, Korrosion, Abrieb, Feuchtigkeit oder Chemikalien – und verleihen ihnen mit hochwertigen, farbigen Oberflächen zusätzliche Dimension und Ästhetik. Unser umfangreiches und stetig wachsendes Markenportfolio spielt eine wichtige Rolle in zahlreichen Anwendungen, von der Modernisierung der globalen Infrastruktur bis hin zur Unterstützung der nächsten Generation von Elektro- und autonomen Fahrzeugen.


Für unseren Standort in Köln, Deutschland (Remote), suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen hochmotivierten Distribution Specialist (Mainstream/Economy Segment) (m/w/d).


Diese Rolle fördert die Leistung der Axalta Handelspartner in den jeweiligen Vertriebsgebieten als Mitglied des Handelsvertriebsteams; mit Schwerpunkt auf die Mainstream / Economy Marken. Der Distribution Specialist ist vorrangig für die Erreichung der Vertriebsziele, der Rentabilität, des Wachstums, der Prognoseerstellung sowie für die Aufrechterhaltung des Markenimages und Einhaltung der Richtlinienstandards verantwortlich.


Ihre Aufgaben


  • Entwickelt ein Verständnis für Vertriebspartner sowie Marktanforderungen und setzt entsprechende Maßnahmen zur Erreichung der Verkaufsziele - unter Berücksichtigung sämtlicher Rahmenbedingungen - um.
  • Fungiert als primärer Ansprechpartner für die zugeordneten Vertriebspartner im deutschen Vertriebsgebiet.
  • Entwickelt und setzt einen effektiven Verkaufsplan unter Berücksichtigung der übergreifen Zielvorgaben-, Rentabilitäts- und Wachstumserfordernisse um.
  • Koordination des genannten Vertriebsplans und dessen Umsetzung in Zusammenarbeit mit dem erweiterten Vertriebsteam.
  • Sucht nach zusätzlichen Möglichkeiten die Vertriebslandschaft von Axalta durch neue Handelspartner auszubauen.
  • Setzt die Anforderungen durch Vernetzung mit anderen Vertriebseinheiten, Technikabteilungen, Logistik, Produktmanagement sowie Vertriebsinnendienst um.
  • Erfasst das aktuelle und mögliche zukünftige Geschäftsumfeld sowie Branchentrends.
  • Vermittelt die wichtigsten Eigenschaften und Vorteile von Axalta Produkten und Dienstleistungen.
  • Entdeckt neue, innovative Chancen und stellt sich den Herausforderungen, die zum Markterfolg beitragen.
  • Steht im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den Vertriebspartnern, um die gewünschten Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Ihr Profil


  • Kaufmännischer Abschluß und/oder >5 Jahre Vertriebserfahrung im Reparaturlack- bzw. Automotivebereich.
  • Fundierte Produktkenntnisse über Lackprodukte.
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in Vertrieb und Kundenbetreuung mit entsprechender Zielerreichung.
  • Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Handelspartnern oder Key Account Kunden.
  • Ausgeprägter Geschäftssinn sowie umfangreiche Kenntnisse über finanzielle Zusammenhänge und Kennziffern.
  • Ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikation sowie Präsentationsfähigkeiten in deutscher Sprache.
  • Fundierte mündliche und schriftliche Englischkenntnisse.
  • Verfügt über starke organisatorische, zwischenmenschliche und zeitliche Managementfähigkeiten.
  • Ausgeprägte Arbeitsmoral und Selbstdisziplin.
  • Reisebereitschaft (ca. 50 % der Arbeitszeit)

Our Company:


Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.

Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals.


Axalta may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain aspects of the recruitment and selection process. These tools may be used to help manage applications, identify job-related qualifications, and assist recruiter review. All hiring decisions involve human oversight and review.

More than 8,000 healthcare organizations trust us to deliver enterprise-ready solutions, making this possible with the right group of dedicated, thoughtful trailblazers. Today, private practice doctor’s offices, small and large hospice centers, and some of the largest healthcare organizations in the United States rely on TigerConnect. We’re a fun, hungry, smart, innovative group of eclectic people who are passionate about transforming the way clinical care teams work and communicate.

TigerConnect is seeking a part-time Senior Executive Assistant, engaged as a contingent worker for approximately 20 hours per week, to support the Chief Executive Officer. This role owns the logistics behind board and executive leadership team activity and serves as a discreet, trusted partner on confidential, time-sensitive strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate is a seasoned executive support professional who exercises sound judgment and keeps high-visibility, relationship-driven work moving.

  • Coordinate board of directors activity, including meeting scheduling, logistics, and action item follow-up

  • Support confidential, time-sensitive strategic initiatives as assigned, coordinating schedules,and communications across multiple internal and external parties on tight timelines
  • Coordinate logistics for customer and executive events as needed
  • Track commitments, deadlines, and open items for the CEO, and follow up proactively so nothing slips

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience supporting senior executives, including at least 2 years supporting C-level leaders
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating board meetings and investor-facing communications, ideally in a board-governed or investor-backed company
  • Exceptional discretion, and comfort working under strict confidentiality requirements, including signing an NDA

How You Will Use AI

  • Use AI to speed up scheduling, travel planning, and event logistics research

Our team in Mexico was recognized as a Great Place to Work and Best Place to Code in 2026. We were also honored to be named to Inc. 5000’s list of Fastest Growing Companies (2023).

About the opportunity

A UK-based creative agency is looking for an experienced Creator Manager to deliver influencer campaigns for major brands.

Your primary focus will be managing creators and their agents, from discovery and negotiation through to content approval and publication. You must also be comfortable taking on wider campaign-management responsibilities, coordinating stakeholders and keeping delivery on track against tight deadlines.

This is a hands-on assignment requiring strong organisation, confident communication and the judgement to resolve problems quickly. Some flexibility will be required around live events and fixed go-live dates, with working arrangements agreed before booking.

What you’ll do

  • Identify and engage suitable mid-tier, macro and VIP creators.

  • Manage creator and agent relationships, outreach, onboarding and negotiations.

  • Coordinate contracts, deliverables, approvals and publication dates.

  • Review creator content against briefs, brand standards and applicable advertising requirements.

  • Own campaign timelines, track dependencies and secure timely decisions from clients and internal teams.

  • Keep creators informed when schedules, access arrangements or filming requirements change.

  • Coordinate remote event logistics, including travel, accreditation and filming permissions where required.

  • Maintain accurate campaign dashboards, monitor performance and flag delivery risks early.

  • Work closely with strategy, data and client-service teams.

  • Support junior colleagues with creator selection, negotiations and quality control.


Requirements

What you’ll bring

  • At least three years’ influencer-marketing experience, including agency experience.

  • Proven personal responsibility for delivering creator campaigns from briefing through to completion.

  • Experience managing mid-tier, macro or VIP creators and their agents.

  • Strong negotiation, relationship-management and stakeholder-coordination skills.

  • Excellent organisation and the ability to manage competing deadlines independently.

  • Experience with campaign tracking, reporting and influencer-marketing platforms.

  • Familiarity with UK advertising disclosure requirements and creator-content approval processes.

  • Availability for the full booking and UK working hours.

Experience with live events, international campaigns and high-value creator contracts would be advantageous. Portuguese language skills are welcome but not essential.

What success looks like

Creators are well briefed, stakeholders know what is happening, approvals arrive on time and content goes live as agreed. You anticipate risks, communicate changes promptly and protect campaign quality, budgets and deadlines.

How to apply

Apply through NoSweat with:

  • Two or three creator campaigns you personally managed, naming the agency, brand and your contribution.

  • Examples of managing agents, negotiations, approvals or challenging delivery deadlines.

  • Relevant results and the platforms you use.

he Client Success Manager is the primary point of responsibility and accountability for assigned client relationships and related Client Success activities to ensure clients realize value from D&B solutions. The role acts as a trusted advisor within an assigned Sales Channel, bringing D&B’s best ideas, innovations and service capabilities to Clients.

The Client Success Manager supports D&B clients through Driving Adoption and Value Realisation activities, Client Satisfaction, customer health visibility, customer maturity support, value plan execution, risk mitigation and supporting renewals. The role contributes customer health, adoption, maturity, value and risk input into retention readiness and T-Minus planning in partnership with Sales.

Commercial ownership, pricing, contract negotiation, sales quotas and expansion contracting remain with Sales. Technical implementation, integrations, workflow configuration, solution architecture and technical AI assessments remain with Technical Client Success Managers, Technical Advisory resources or other specialist functions.

Essential Key Responsibilities

  • Be accountable for the assigned Client’s overall success with D&B, including Driving Adoption and Value Realisation activities, Client Satisfaction, customer health visibility, customer maturity support and supporting renewals.
  • Monitor and capture customer health indicators, maturity signals, adoption activity, risk indicators and growth signals, and share relevant insight with Sales, Client Success leadership and internal stakeholders.
  • Support customer maturity progression by identifying adoption barriers, use-case gaps and practical next steps that help Clients increase adoption, value realisation and business outcomes.
  • Contribute customer health, adoption, maturity, value and risk input into T-Minus retention planning in partnership with Sales, while commercial ownership remains with Sales.

  • Deliver external service reviews to review solution adoption, value progress, Client sentiment and agreed practical next steps.

  • Identify risks to Clients achieving their stated business goals and work with the virtual team to build a risk mitigation or get-well plan.
  • Coordinate relevant internal and external stakeholders across Sales, Product, Data, Technology, Delivery, Customer Service, Finance, Legal and other teams to support agreed customer success outcomes.

The Client Success Manager remains focused on customer relationship management, adoption support, value realisation, customer health, customer maturity support, retention readiness and execution of Client Success playbooks.

Monitor performance and adjust resources and priorities to achieve results. (30%)

Ensure disciplined prospecting, opportunity qualification, account planning, consultative discovery, business case development, proposal execution, negotiation, and closing. raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION OVERVIEW 

The Managing Director, Workforce Transformation leads CREO's workforce transformation service line. The service line covers workforce transformation, change management, employee productivity, people enablement, workforce/organization strategy. The Managing Director sets the direction for the service line, builds the team that delivers it, and works with leaders across the firm to build workforce and people capabilities into the full CREO service portfolio.

The role is both a seller and a doer. The Managing Director wins large transformation engagements with client executives and then stays close to the work, leading delivery alongside the engagement teams. We are looking for a leader with consulting experience in life sciences and/or healthcare and a record of selling large transformation programs.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES 

1. Lead the workforce transformation service line
  • Set the strategy, offerings, and investment priorities for workforce transformation.
  • ​​​​​​​Turn client demand into repeatable offerings, methods, and tools that the firm can sell and deliver at scale.
  • Own the service line's revenue, margin, utilization, and quality targets.
  • Track how AI and automation change the way people work, and shape offerings that help clients prepare their workforce for that change.
2. Sell large transformation engagements
  • Build and maintain senior relationships with CHROs, COOs, CIOs, and other executives at life sciences and healthcare clients.
  • Originate new business and expand existing accounts. Lead pursuits, including solution design, executive positioning, negotiation, and close.
  • Shape large transformation programs in which the workforce and people work is central to the client's business case.
  • Maintain a qualified pipeline and report on it to the firm's leadership team.
3. Lead client delivery
  • Advise client executives and stay involved in the work, including executive workshops, steering committees, and key deliverables.
  • Design and lead programs in change management, workforce planning, organization design, skills and reskilling, and productivity improvement.
  • Oversee engagement quality, economics, risk, and client satisfaction.
  • Help clients measure whether employees adopt new systems, processes, and ways of working after launch.
4. Integrate workforce and people capabilities across the firm
  • Work with the leaders of other CREO service lines to build workforce, change, and people enablement work into their engagements and offerings.
  • Identify where workforce and people work can extend an existing client relationship, and prepare joint proposals with the relevant service line leaders.
  • Share methods, case examples, and talent across service lines so clients see one consistent approach from the firm.
5. Build the team and the firm's reputation
  • Recruit, coach, and retain consultants in the service line.
  • Develop future leaders through staffing decisions, mentoring, and regular performance feedback.
  • Represent CREO at industry events, and publish a point of view on workforce topics in life sciences and healthcare.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, AND EXPERIENCE 

  • 12 or more years of management consulting experience, including time at the Director, Managing Director, or Partner level, or an equivalent senior leadership role.

  • Consulting experience in life sciences, healthcare, or both.

  • A track record of selling large transformation engagements, including originating new business, growing accounts, and leading complex pursuits through close.

  • Experience leading workforce transformation, change management, organization design, employee productivity, or workforce strategy engagements.

  • Executive presence to advise the C-Suite on workforce and organization strategic issues.

  • Experience building and leading consulting teams and managing engagement economics, risk, and quality.

  • A working knowledge of how AI and automation are changing work, and how to prepare a workforce for that change.

  • Strong written and verbal communication and negotiation skills.

  • Willingness to travel to client sites as engagements require.

  • Bachelor's degree required. An MBA or other advanced degree is preferred.

raw.description:
Remote · Hourly contract · 30–40 hours per week · Initial 60–90 days

About us

iSpeedToLead runs a US lead marketplace for real estate investors. Investors, wholesalers, and agents use the marketplace to buy phone-verified seller leads by location, motivation, and budget.

About the role

You’ll manage and coach our existing sales team, join live demos and customer calls, and improve how reps qualify buyers, handle objections, and follow up. You’ll own team performance and give leadership a reliable weekly revenue forecast.

What you’ll do

  • Set weekly goals for each rep, run regular one-on-ones, and address performance gaps early. Agree on what each rep will change and check whether it improved results.

  • Build on our existing coaching cadence, AI-assisted call scoring, and demo goals. Review recordings, join live demos, and run role-plays. Turn recurring findings into specific feedback reps can apply on their next call.

  • Track booked demos, held demos, and closed deals by rep and lead source. Identify where deals stall and test changes to qualification, discovery, offers, and follow-up.

  • Keep the CRM pipeline and forecast current. Run the weekly sales meeting and report expected revenue, risks, and next actions to leadership.

  • Update scripts, demo flows, objection responses, and follow-up sequences based on what works in real calls.

  • Coach reps through promotions, work with Customer Success on onboarding and account growth, and share recurring buyer feedback with Marketing and Product.

What success looks like

  • Day 30: You’ve reviewed calls from every rep, audited the pipeline, and identified where deals are being lost. Each rep has a weekly goal and a regular coaching session.

  • Day 60: Reps use a shared demo playbook and follow-up process, log demo outcomes within 24 hours, and show measurable improvement in conversion or revenue per booked demo.

  • Day 90: The team meets its weekly revenue target in most weeks, and leadership can see rep performance and the forecast directly in the CRM.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience directly managing quota-carrying reps, setting goals, running one-on-ones, and addressing underperformance.

  • A specific example of coaching that measurably improved a rep’s or team’s performance.

  • Experience managing short, phone-led sales cycles with demos and follow-up for US small businesses or independent operators.

  • Hands-on CRM experience reviewing pipelines, spotting stalled deals, and forecasting revenue. GoHighLevel experience is preferred.

  • Fluent English for live customer calls and availability during US business hours.

Experience hiring and onboarding reps, selling to US real estate investors or agents, or working in lead generation, marketplaces, or subscription businesses is a plus.

Engagement details

This remote hourly contract starts at approximately 30–40 hours per week for 60–90 days, with the potential to transition to full-time. We’re looking for someone who can start as soon as possible. An NDA is required before access to the CRM and call recordings.

How to apply

  1. Tell us about a sales team you directly managed. How many reps reported to you, and how did you run weekly coaching and performance reviews?

  2. Describe one rep or team you helped improve. What was the starting metric, what did you change, and what result did you see?

  3. If the team’s demo-to-close rate dropped by a third, what would you check in your first week?

  4. Write the first 30 seconds of a demo opener for a real estate investor who signed up but hasn’t bought a lead yet.
