We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Designer to shape intuitive, high-quality product experiences across BJAK's financial products.

This role is for someone who enjoys solving product problems through thoughtful interface design. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to simplify complex financial workflows into experiences that feel fast, intuitive and trustworthy.

What You'll Own

  • Design end-to-end product experiences from concept to production.

  • Transform product requirements into user flows, wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.

  • Design intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial products.

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems and reusable UI components.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

  • Improve usability through rapid iteration using product data and user feedback.

  • Maintain consistency across mobile and web experiences.

  • Continuously refine interactions, accessibility and overall product quality.


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience designing digital products.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking and excellent visual design.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Strong understanding of design systems, component libraries and responsive design.

  • Strong understanding of information architecture and user flows.

  • Excellent visual design skills including typography, spacing, layout and interaction design.

  • Ability to simplify complex workflows into intuitive experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout

  • Component Libraries


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks about solving customer problems, not just designing screens.

  • Balances business goals with user experience.

  • Obsesses over clarity, simplicity and consistency.

  • Works collaboratively with engineers and product teams.

  • Takes ownership from idea through launch.

  • Continuously improves products using real user insights.


This Role Is Not For

  • Designers who only focus on visuals without considering usability.

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in US. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in US.

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper / Accounting Operations Specialist to manage financial records and support accounting operations. You will be responsible for keeping the books accurate, reconciling 10+ accounts, managing vendor and customer payments, tracking trip profitability, and maintaining accurate financial and booking records. You will also help improve systems, reporting, and automation to reduce manual work. The role requires strong Xero, Excel and Google Sheets experience, along with the ability to work independently and handle confidential financial information.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Reconciliation

  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ bank, credit card, HubSpot and accounting accounts.
  • Review and categorize expenses in Xero.
  • Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions, unusual charges, and discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

Payments & Vendor Management

  • Track vendor and customer payments, outstanding balances, and payment status.
  • Coordinate domestic and international payments, including foreign currency transactions.
  • Manage payments through platforms such as Convera (GlobalPay).
  • Work with vendors, operators, and internal teams to resolve payment issues.

Trip Profitability & Reporting

  • Track gross and net margins by trip or flight.
  • Monitor trip-related costs including aircraft, catering, transportation, and other operational expenses.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense and financial reports.
  • Maintain vendor variance and fixed-cost reports.
  • Provide management with clear reporting on expenses, margins, and payments.

CRM & Systems Management

  • Keep HubSpot deal stages and booking information up to date.
  • Maintain accurate trip details, pricing, invoicing, and payment status.
  • Reconcile HubSpot data with Xero and other financial records.
  • Organize financial documents and shared accounting folders.

Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Use formulas, pivot tables, and data validation to improve reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting tasks.
  • Improve processes to reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial analysis.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, including reconciliation, expense coding, and reporting.
  • Experience reconciling 10+ accounts on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Experience handling international payments and foreign currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and account reconciliation.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Convera GlobalPay and international payment workflows.
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.
  • Experience in private aviation, charter, luxury travel, or hospitality.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies and USD accounting.
  • Experience building automated reports or workflows.
  • Xero Advisor Certification.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Remote & Availability Requirements

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, secure workspace.
  • Must be available during 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, Monday–Friday.
  • Occasional after-hours, weekend, or holiday availability is required for urgent matters such as operator payments, declined cards, or vendor issues affecting active flights.
  • Must be reachable by phone and able to respond promptly during urgent situations.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to learn the company's systems and vendor network, reconcile all 10+ accounts, align HubSpot records with the books, complete a monthly close, and deliver trip-level margin reporting.

Over time, you will help make the accounting and reporting process faster, more accurate, and more automated while providing leadership with reliable financial information for business decisions.

Interview Process

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

The Senior Finance Manager, Market LCC Finance serves as a strategic finance business partner responsible for driving financial performance, profitability, and sustainable growth of Local Contract Customers (LCC) across the Market. This role provides financial leadership, analytical insights, and strategic recommendations to optimize gross profit, contract compliance, unfunded spend, brand performance, and new business opportunities.

Partners closely with the Market Vice President of Contract Sales, Regional Finance leadership, Revenue Management, and GSC Finance to develop and execute financial strategies that achieve LCC volume, sales, and gross profit objectives. Responsible for identifying financial risks and opportunities, evaluating business performance, influencing commercial decisions, and driving accountability to financial commitments and market growth initiatives.

20%Strategic Financial Planning & Profitability Management

  • Lead comprehensive profitability analysis for LC1/LC2 customers, identifying key financial trends, margin improvement opportunities, and potential business risks.
  • Develop and recommend actionable strategies to optimize gross profit, revenue growth, and overall customer profitability.
  • Evaluate financial performance against established targets, identifying underlying drivers of variances and implementing corrective action plans.
  • Provide strategic financial insights and recommendations to Market leadership to support informed business decisions.

15%Financial Modeling & New Business Evaluation

  • Lead financial modeling, business case development, and profitability assessments for new business opportunities, contract renewals, and customer growth initiatives.
  • Evaluate pricing structures, cost assumptions, financial risks, and projected returns to ensure alignment with profitability objectives.
  • Partner with Contract Sales and Revenue Management to assess commercial opportunities and recommend financially sustainable solutions.
  • Monitor actual financial performance against approved business cases and recommend adjustments to protect profitability.

15%Contract Compliance & Financial Risk Management

  • Oversee financial performance and contract compliance for LCC customers, identifying significant areas of non-compliance and financial exposure.
  • Develop and implement strategies to address compliance gaps, recover margin opportunities, and strengthen financial accountability.
  • Monitor unfunded spend and partner with Revenue Management to ensure adherence to approved business cases and contractual commitments.
  • Proactively identify financial risks and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to implement mitigation strategies.

15%Strategic Business Partnership & Commercial Finance Leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic finance advisor to the Market Vice President of Contract Sales, providing financial guidance on business performance and growth strategies.
  • Partner with Regional Finance, GSC Finance, and commercial leadership to align LCC financial priorities with broader Market objectives.
  • Influence business decisions through data-driven recommendations, financial analysis, and evaluation of commercial opportunities.
  • Support leadership in balancing customer growth, competitive positioning, and long-term profitability.

10%Financial Reporting, Forecasting & Performance Insights

  • Lead the development and analysis of daily, weekly, and monthly financial reporting and key performance indicators for LC1/LC2 customers.
  • Ensure financial forecasts accurately reflect business trends, contract performance, customer activity, and strategic initiatives.
  • Analyze financial variances and communicate key performance drivers, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.
  • Recommend improvements to reporting processes, financial visibility, and forecasting accuracy to enhance decision-making.

10%Pricing, Brand & Margin Optimization

  • Analyze the financial impact of PGM events, pricing adjustments, brand initiatives, and customer-specific programs on LCC profitability.
  • Partner with Revenue Management and commercial teams to identify opportunities for margin expansion and improved financial performance.
  • Evaluate customer and product-level profitability to identify unfavorable trends and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support the development and execution of strategies that optimize pricing effectiveness, brand performance, and customer profitability.

10% Annual Growth Planning & Market Strategy Execution

  • Play a key leadership role in developing the LCC Annual Growth Plan (AGP), including volume, sales, gross profit, and profitability objectives.
  • Partner with Market and Regional leadership to establish financial targets, evaluate growth opportunities, and align execution plans with business priorities.
  • Drive the implementation of LCC financial strategies, standardized processes, and best practices across the Market.
  • Monitor progress against strategic objectives and recommend adjustments to improve financial outcomes and operational execution.

5%Financial Transformation & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead strategic projects and cross-functional initiatives designed to improve LCC profitability, financial processes, and overall business performance.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance financial controls, reporting capabilities, and analytical effectiveness.
  • Drive process improvements and standardization to increase efficiency, accuracy, and financial transparency.

Head of Commercial Marketing | £80,000–£90,000

ICS.AI is the UK's market leader in AI for local government and the public sector, and we're looking for a senior commercial marketing leader to own one of our priority growth engines from market insight to pipeline and revenue.

This is not a traditional marketing communications role. It's a go-to-market leadership position with real autonomy, real budget and real accountability for results.

Location: UK – remote, with travel to events, ICS.AI offices and customer sites

Salary: £80,000–£90,000

Contract: Full Time, Permanent

Department: Marketing

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

About ICS.AI

We're one of the UK's largest and fastest-growing AI providers to the public sector, and a truly AI-native organisation where every team uses AI daily as a trusted copilot. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, we deliver AI Contact Centres, Staff Copilots and Social Care AI through our SMART: Platform, with guaranteed, measurable outcomes for 20+ public sector partners across the UK. Ranked #19 in TechRound's AI45 2026 and recognised in Parliament for responsible AI innovation.

The Role

As Head of Commercial Marketing, you'll take end-to-end ownership of a commercial growth engine: understanding the market, defining the proposition, deciding where ICS.AI can win, and turning that strategy into qualified pipeline and revenue.

You'll work across Marketing, Sales, Product, Partnerships and Customer Success, and act as the strategic and commercial client for our marketing channels team, who deliver the campaigns, content, events, PR, digital and nurture programmes. You'll be trusted to make decisions, prioritise investment and deliver outcomes without every decision going back to the CMO.

What you'll own:

- Commercial marketing strategy and go-to-market plan for your engine
- Market, customer, competitor and buying-group insight
- Proposition, positioning and commercial narrative
- Priority segments, accounts and audiences (account-based marketing)
- Marketing-generated and marketing-influenced pipeline
- Conversion from awareness to engagement, qualification and opportunity
- Sales enablement, performance reporting and continuous improvement

What You'll Bring

  • Significant senior B2B marketing, product marketing, growth, demand generation or go-to-market experience
    - Ownership of a proposition, market, sector or commercial programme
    - A track record of generating and progressing complex B2B pipeline
    - Experience working with Sales against shared revenue targets
    - Understanding of long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles
    - Skill in turning complex products into clear, differentiated propositions
    - Confidence presenting to senior customers, executives and technical specialists
    - Strong use of CRM, pipeline and campaign data to make decisions

Advantageous: enterprise tech, SaaS, AI or digital transformation; UK public sector, local government or education; account-based marketing; scale-up environments; partner-led go-to-market.

Direct sector experience is helpful, but less important than evidence that you can understand a complex market and take genuine commercial ownership.

What We Offer

  • £80,000–£90,000 salary
    - Remote-first working – work flexibly from anywhere in the UK

    - £1,200 annual work-from-home allowance

    - 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

    - Enhanced pension scheme – 5% employer contribution
    - Private healthcare (Vitality)
    - Work at the cutting edge of public sector AI
    - Real social impact – transforming how public services are delivered
    - Autonomy, influence and a seat at the table in a fast-scaling company

raw.excerpt: ABOUT STORD Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands.
raw.description:
ABOUT STORD


Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About the role

Stord is building out its Content and Communications function, and we're looking for a Senior Manager of Content & Thought Leadership to shape how Stord leads the conversation in commerce.

As agentic commerce changes how products are discovered, bought, and fulfilled, we want to build real authority on physical intelligence: the layer that connects digital intent to physical outcomes. You'll be the editorial mind behind that effort and a senior partner to the Head of Content & Comms across PR, content, and social.

This isn't a conversion-content role, though you'll care about conversion. We're looking for someone who can build a more dynamic, point-of-view-driven home for Stord's ideas and make sure that work performs. You'll report directly to the Director of Content & Comms and work closely with our social lead, the Brand team, marketing, sales, and internal subject matter experts.

What you'll do


Thought leadership & editorial strategy

  • Develop and defend Stord's point of view on agentic commerce, physical intelligence, fulfillment, supply chain, and omnichannel strategy.
  • Spot emerging conversations where Stord has a credible, differentiated perspective, and decide when to lead, join, or stay out.
  • Own the editorial calendar from planning to publication: bylines, executive content, contributed articles, long-form, and owned-channel programming.
  • Interview executives and subject matter experts and turn deep operational knowledge into writing that's clear without being oversimplified.
  • Reimagine the home for Stord's content (format, structure, cadence, and experience) so it reads as a destination rather than a blog archive.

Editorial leadership across Comms

  • Act as the editorial #2 to the Director of Content & Comms, setting the narrative and quality bar across content, PR, and social.
  • Shape how Stord's stories show up in earned media: pitch angles, contributed content, and executive visibility.
  • Partner with the social lead on content production and distribution for key assets, and with the Brand team to keep voice and storytelling consistent.

Content production & enablement

  • Write and edit across formats: essays, case studies, web copy, email, sales collateral, and executive materials.
  • Partner with demand gen, product marketing, and sales to keep content tied to campaigns and pipeline goals.
  • Help shape decks and presentations for marketing, sales, and executive audiences.

Distribution, discoverability & performance

  • Build content for both people and machines: AEO/SEO, answer-engine visibility, and clear conversion paths.
  • Track content performance and use it to sharpen editorial priorities over time, knowing which metrics matter and which don't.
  • Coordinate publication across owned channels and manage relationships with third-party outlets and publication partners.

Team & stakeholder leadership

  • Build relationships across sales, product, operations, and the executive team to surface new thought leaders and story opportunities.
  • Manage and provide editorial direction to freelancers, contract writers, and agency partners, with the potential to build out a team over time.
  • Act as an editorial resource for the broader Brand and Comms teams, reviewing, sharpening, and elevating written work across the function.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of experience in content, editorial, communications, or brand storytelling, ideally across B2B tech, media, or commerce.
  • A distinct editorial voice and the judgment to know when a piece is ready and when it isn't.
  • Experience developing a point of view or thought leadership program, not just executing one.
  • Comfort across PR, content, and social, with a sense of how stories travel between them.
  • Experience with AEO/SEO, lead generation, and content performance metrics, and a clear view of what they do (and don't) tell you.
  • Ability to translate complex, technical subject matter into writing that's clear and compelling without oversimplifying.
  • A track record of working cross-functionally and building relationships with people who aren't marketers, including executives and technical experts.
  • Experience managing an editorial calendar across multiple content types and stakeholders.
  • Experience managing freelancers or agency partners; people management experience is a plus.
  • A background in journalism, media, or brand creative is a plus. A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field is preferred.

Work Location: Remote in Malaysia

Engagement model: Independent Contractor/Freelance

Project start: November 2026

Estimated project duration: until end of 2026

Estimated workload: up to 20 hours in total

Required Languages: English

About the Role

We are looking for experienced professionals and subject-matter experts to contribute to an AI training and evaluation project focused on the creation of realistic professional knowledge-based tasks.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in the IT and Software sector and understands how real workplace assignments are completed.

The ideal candidate is also comfortable using modern LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop realistic professional task scenarios based on your work experience in different roles within the above-mentioned sectors.

  • Create and review supporting business materials such as spreadsheets, reports, presentations, documents, datasets, or other occupation-specific files.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional qualification, where appropriate.

  • Minimum 3 years of relevant professional work experience in relevant role in the IT and Software sector.

  • Be located in Malaysia.

  • Strong practical knowledge of workflows, tools, terminology, standards, and deliverables used in your profession.

  • Have experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar AI tools.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working with multiple documents, data sources, reports, spreadsheets, presentations, or similar professional materials.

  • Strong written English (all the project related task creation will be done in English).

  • High attention to detail and ability to produce accurate, internally consistent work.

  • Ability to distinguish realistic professional work from overly simplified or artificial scenarios.

  • Experience creating, reviewing, validating, auditing, or quality-checking professional work is a plus.

  • Experience developing training materials, case studies, or professional assessments is a plus.

DataForce by TransPerfect is part of the TransPerfect family of companies, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business, with offices in more than 100 cities worldwide.

We offer high-quality data for Human-Machine Interaction to some of the most prestigious technology companies in the world. Our department focuses on gathering, enriching, and processing data for Machine Learning in different AI domains.
